meta.source: hand-authored demo narratives (4) + archetype-generated narratives (from 35 root-cause patterns) + algorithmic event synthesis + 30 real-post-mortem incidents (see scripts/augment-with-postmortems.py)

incidents.title: Elevated 5xx on PaymentService.charge in EU region
incidents.description: Error rate on PaymentService.charge spiked 8x starting 09:12 UTC. EU customers primarily affected. Stripe webhook retries amplifying load into fraud-service.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Retry loop added in commit b82a11c lacks exponential backoff, amplifying 429s from Stripe under elevated load.
incidents.resolution_text: Wrap Stripe retry loop in exponential backoff so 429s don't amplify into downstream fraud-service load.

incidents.title: NullPointerException in PaymentService.charge for EU customers
incidents.description: Charge requests failing with NPE for customers without a resolved billing country. Errors swallowed by generic catch and logged as timeouts. Masked the real cause for 2h.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Missing null-check on `request` / `request.getCreditCard()` before `controller.clearPayment(request)`; generic `catch(Exception e)` swallows the NPE and surfaces it as a gRPC UNAVAILABLE, masking the real cause.
incidents.resolution: Added an INC-4402 null-check guard on `request` and `request.getCreditCard()` before the `clearPayment` call; rejects with `IllegalArgumentException("credit card required")` when either is null.
incidents.resolution_text: Guard against INC-4402 NPE regression by null-checking the credit card before the clearPayment call.

incidents.title: InventoryService.reserve over-counts during concurrent checkouts
incidents.description: Race condition reserved same SKU twice under concurrent order load. ~40 orders affected.
incidents.root_cause: Missing row-level lock on inventory_item.quantity update path.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
int current = repo.getQuantity(sku);
repo.setQuantity(sku, current - qty); // no lock
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in SELECT ... FOR UPDATE transaction.
incidents.resolution_text: Wrap the quantity update in a SELECT ... FOR UPDATE row-lock so concurrent checkouts cannot double-decrement the same SKU.

incidents.title: Refund webhooks dropped during Stripe outage
incidents.description: ~200 refund webhooks missed during Stripe's 30-min outage. Customer refunds delayed 24h.
incidents.root_cause: Webhook handler lacked retry queue; failures dropped silently.
incidents.resolution: Added durable webhook queue with DLQ + replay endpoint.
incidents.resolution_text: Enqueue every Stripe webhook to a durable DLQ-backed queue before acking so transient outages don't silently drop refunds.

incidents.title: CatalogService.serialize TLS verification broken after CA rotation
incidents.description: Expired intermediate cert caused TLS handshake failures on CatalogService.serialize's egress to search-service. All downstream calls failed for 40 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Certificate auto-renew job failed 14 days prior; nobody acted on the warning.
incidents.resolution: Rotated cert; added a synthetic monitor for days-to-expiry at 30/14/7 thresholds.

incidents.title: FraudClient.resolve mishandles DST transition
incidents.description: Reports for 2400 customers showed events attributed to the wrong day. FraudClient.resolve did date arithmetic in local time then wrote UTC.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
now = datetime.now()  # naive, system tz
repo.save(Event(now))  # assumed UTC downstream
incidents.root_cause: Forgot to convert to UTC before persisting. Works in dev (UTC container) but not prod (customer-local TZ).
incidents.resolution: Standardized on time.Now().UTC() and added a test with a non-UTC TZ container.

incidents.title: Deadlock in InventoryService.release during high-concurrency writes
incidents.description: Two transactions acquired locks in reverse order on the event and related child tables, producing a classic AB/BA deadlock. Postgres aborted 3800 of them per minute.
incidents.root_cause: InventoryService.release performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.
incidents.resolution: Moved the external call outside the transaction; replaced with outbox pattern.

incidents.title: Field typo in PaymentResolver.handle silently drops data
incidents.description: Analytics team reported 0 for a metric because PaymentResolver.handle emitted a mistyped field name.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: Map.of("user_Id", id); // should be userId — consumer drops
incidents.root_cause: Field renamed in schema but not in PaymentResolver.handle's hand-rolled serializer.
incidents.resolution: Added consumer-side strict validation on unknown/missing keys.

incidents.title: CORS preflight failures on UserGateway.deserialize endpoint
incidents.description: Wildcard CORS config tightened for security; legitimate marketing origin not allowlisted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in UserGateway.deserialize missed PATCH after API migration.
incidents.resolution: Extended allowlist to cover all swagstore.com subdomains via regex; lint-rule banning wildcards.

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits postgres when UserService.authenticate cache expires
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 40 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered postgres. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.root_cause: UserService.authenticate uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped loader in singleflight.Group so duplicate in-flight misses share a single origin call.

incidents.title: SQL injection protection regression in PaymentService.refund
incidents.description: A security audit flagged PaymentService.refund for concatenating user input into a SQL query. No confirmed exploits but disclosure deadline imposed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
String sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'";
stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: PaymentService.refund switched to string concatenation when a prepared-statement wrapper was deleted.

incidents.title: Duplicate processing in AnalyticsScheduler.refresh on retry
incidents.description: Clients retrying after transient errors produced duplicate side effects in AnalyticsScheduler.refresh. ~1500 records affected; remediation required manual refund.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: idemKey := uuid.NewString() // not stable across retries
incidents.root_cause: Idempotency key generated per-attempt in AnalyticsScheduler.refresh instead of per-order.
incidents.resolution: Derived idempotency key from (orderId, attempt-bucket).

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate silently swallows downstream failures
incidents.description: Orders succeeded from the caller's perspective even when downstream elasticsearch failed. A catch block in UserService.authenticate logged the error at DEBUG but returned success.
incidents.root_cause: Empty catch block left over from scaffolding.
incidents.resolution: Propagated failure as a domain exception; added contract test.

incidents.title: Field typo in InventoryHandler.render silently drops data
incidents.description: A field rename went through inventory-service but missed InventoryHandler.render. Messages with the new field were dropped at serialization; messages with the old name silently passed through.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: Map.of("user_Id", id); // should be userId — consumer drops
incidents.root_cause: Field renamed in schema but not in InventoryHandler.render's hand-rolled serializer.
incidents.resolution: Switched to a generated DTO; typo impossible.

incidents.title: PaymentService.captureWebhook async callback swallows errors
incidents.description: An async task in PaymentService.captureWebhook fired and forgot; failures never surfaced to callers.
incidents.root_cause: PaymentService.captureWebhook didn't await the inner promise — rejections escaped the try/catch.
incidents.resolution: Added await; top-level try/catch; sentry.captureException on reject.

incidents.title: Circular service dependency involving CatalogHandler.emit
incidents.description: Boot-time dependency cycle prevented catalog-service from starting for 15 minutes after deploy.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
class A(private val b: B) { fun a() = b.b() }
class B(private val a: A) { fun b() = a.a() } // cycle
incidents.root_cause: sqs added a synchronous callback to CatalogHandler.emit, forming a cycle.
incidents.resolution: Refactored to injected interface; broke the tight Spring cycle.

incidents.title: CartService.checkout TLS verification broken after CA rotation
incidents.description: Expired intermediate cert caused TLS handshake failures on CartService.checkout's egress to inventory-service. All downstream calls failed for 40 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Certificate auto-renew job failed 14 days prior; nobody acted on the warning.
incidents.resolution: Rotated cert; added a synthetic monitor for days-to-expiry at 30/14/7 thresholds.

incidents.title: OrderService.cancel drops items across page boundaries
incidents.description: Consumers of OrderService.cancel paginated API saw ~0.5% of items silently skipped at page boundaries. Cursor computed from a non-unique sort key.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: OrderService.cancel sorts by created_at only — non-unique; cursor-based pagination unstable.
incidents.resolution: Switched to keyset pagination: ORDER BY (created_at, id).

incidents.title: SearchService.query drops items across page boundaries
incidents.description: ORDER BY non-unique column caused page 2+ to rehash order and skip items in SearchService.query.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: rows, _ := db.Query("SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY created_at LIMIT ? OFFSET ?", size, n*size)
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Offset-based pagination used for mutating list; items inserted between pages cause drift.

incidents.title: Catch-and-log in PaymentHandler.validate masks real errors
incidents.description: Exceptions from sqs in PaymentHandler.validate were swallowed by a generic catch (Exception). Bug lived undetected for weeks.
incidents.root_cause: Generic catch (Exception) in PaymentHandler.validate logged and continued instead of propagating.
incidents.resolution: Replaced generic catch with specific TransientException handling.

incidents.title: Duplicate processing in OrderHandler.enrich on retry
incidents.description: Clients retrying after transient errors produced duplicate side effects in OrderHandler.enrich. ~120 records affected; remediation required manual refund.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: String idemKey = UUID.randomUUID().toString(); // new per attempt
incidents.root_cause: Idempotency key generated per-attempt in OrderHandler.enrich instead of per-order.
incidents.resolution: Derived idempotency key from (orderId, attempt-bucket).

incidents.title: Off-by-one in RecommendationsService.forUser pagination
incidents.description: Customers on page boundary saw duplicate entries on the last page and missing entries on the first. 300 reports filed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
for i in range(len(items) - 1):  # drops last
    process(items[i])
incidents.root_cause: Pagination offset calculation uses (page - 1) * size + 1 instead of page * size.
incidents.resolution: Switched to explicit iterator; removed magic -1 / +1.

incidents.title: InventoryService.reserve timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: catalog-service latency went from 100ms to 4s. InventoryService.reserve's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: Client timeout on catalog-service > ingress timeout on InventoryService.reserve; pool starvation guaranteed.
incidents.resolution: Tightened catalog-service client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: PaymentService.charge first-request latency crosses SLO
incidents.description: New pods on payment-service served p99 > 8s for first 60 seconds. JIT + cache warmup missing in PaymentService.charge.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
// no warmup queries on pod start
@PostConstruct public void init() { /* nothing */ }
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: No readiness-probe warmup in payment-service; autoscaler-added pods received traffic immediately.

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits user-service when FraudResolver.render cache expires
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 1500 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered user-service. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
p = cache.get(sku)
if p is None:
    p = db.load(sku)  # stampede on concurrent miss
    cache.set(sku, p)
incidents.root_cause: FraudResolver.render uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped loader in singleflight.Group so duplicate in-flight misses share a single origin call.

incidents.title: NotificationsService.send silently swallows downstream failures
incidents.description: Exceptions from rabbitmq in NotificationsService.send were swallowed by a generic catch (Exception). Bug lived undetected for weeks.
incidents.root_cause: Empty catch block left over from scaffolding.
incidents.resolution: Replaced generic catch with specific TransientException handling.

incidents.title: PaymentService.refund drops last element of batch
incidents.description: Customers on page boundary saw duplicate entries on the last page and missing entries on the first. 500 reports filed.
incidents.root_cause: Pagination offset calculation uses (page - 1) * size + 1 instead of page * size.
incidents.resolution: Fixed bound to items.size() inclusive; added boundary test.

incidents.title: order-service heap grows unbounded in OrderProcessor.render cache
incidents.description: A cache added to OrderProcessor.render used request IDs as keys. Entries never expired. After 36h the retained size exceeded 2 GB.
incidents.root_cause: Listener added to OrderProcessor.render was never unregistered when the request scope ended, pinning session objects in memory.
incidents.resolution: Switched to LRU with explicit capacity; added metric cache.size for alerting.

incidents.title: Timeout cascade from snowflake saturates UserHandler.validate
incidents.description: snowflake latency went from 100ms to 4s. UserHandler.validate's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: Client timeout on snowflake > ingress timeout on UserHandler.validate; pool starvation guaranteed.
incidents.resolution: Tightened snowflake client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: PaymentService.lookup scaling linearly with input size
incidents.description: A recent refactor from batch fetch to per-item fetch in PaymentService.lookup regressed latency by ~15x on high-volume requests.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Lazy-loaded association triggers a SELECT per element inside PaymentService.lookup's loop.

incidents.title: Log-on-log recursion in AnalyticsService.refresh fills disk
incidents.description: analytics-service logs grew from 50 MB/h to 50 GB/h within minutes. An appender sent logs to AnalyticsService.refresh, which itself logged on every call.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
log.error("failed: {}", req, e);
// log appender HTTP-posts to /log which calls this very method → infinite
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Error handler logged the exception, but the log emitter itself threw the same exception.

incidents.title: Variable shadowing in ShippingService.createLabel overrides caller value
incidents.description: Inside ShippingService.createLabel, a local variable shadowed the argument of the same name. The caller's value was effectively ignored.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in ShippingService.createLabel after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Enabled -Werror=shadow; caught two more instances in review.

incidents.title: OutOfMemoryError in catalog-service after CatalogWorker.aggregate introduces leak
incidents.description: catalog-service heap usage grew linearly over 18 hours until OOM. Heap dump fingered a HashMap in CatalogWorker.aggregate with no eviction policy.
incidents.root_cause: Listener added to CatalogWorker.aggregate was never unregistered when the request scope ended, pinning session objects in memory.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with Caffeine cache (max size 10k, 10-min TTL) and added heap-usage SLO.

incidents.title: Goroutine leak in FraudService.evaluate eats memory
incidents.description: A thread-pool executor in FraudService.evaluate spawned threads but its submitted tasks never completed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: CompletableFuture in FraudService.evaluate is never completed on the cancellation path.

incidents.title: ShippingWorker.resolve first-request latency crosses SLO
incidents.description: Post-deploy, cold-started instances of shipping-service handled traffic before ShippingWorker.resolve had loaded its models.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: // readiness probe returns OK as soon as port binds — no warmup
incidents.root_cause: ShippingWorker.resolve lazily loads models on first request; initialization takes 40s.
incidents.resolution: Added 30s warmup phase with representative query replay on readiness probe.

incidents.title: Catch-and-log in SearchService.query masks real errors
incidents.description: Orders succeeded from the caller's perspective even when downstream kafka failed. A catch block in SearchService.query logged the error at DEBUG but returned success.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Empty catch block left over from scaffolding.

incidents.title: Variable shadowing in PaymentService.charge overrides caller value
incidents.description: Linter caught a shadowed variable in PaymentService.charge that had masked a config-override path for 3 weeks.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in PaymentService.charge after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Enabled -Werror=shadow; caught two more instances in review.

incidents.title: Inconsistent pagination cursor in UserService.commit
incidents.description: ORDER BY non-unique column caused page 2+ to rehash order and skip items in UserService.commit.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: UserService.commit sorts by created_at only — non-unique; cursor-based pagination unstable.
incidents.resolution: Switched to keyset pagination: ORDER BY (created_at, id).

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits notifications-service when PaymentService.charge cache expires
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 500 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered notifications-service. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.root_cause: TTL jitter missing; thousands of cache entries expire at the same second after a bulk warmup.
incidents.resolution: Added TTL jitter ±20% and per-key lock on cache miss.

incidents.title: Enum value mismatch between fraud-service and snowflake
incidents.description: FraudService.evaluate received an enum value snowflake had added but fraud-service did not know about. Deserialization threw; requests 500'd.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: snowflake added the PENDING_REVIEW status; fraud-service was never updated.

incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag on cart-service from CartService.addItem bottleneck
incidents.description: cart-service consumer lag grew to 120 messages. CartService.addItem's per-message processing time exceeded poll interval; single-partition concurrency starved.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Consumer concurrency set to 1; topic has 8 partitions but only 1 worker thread.

incidents.title: Lost updates in OrderService.place under parallel load
incidents.description: Concurrent callers of OrderService.place produced inconsistent reservation totals. Read-modify-write without a lock allowed two threads to observe the same pre-state. 800 affected records.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
int current = repo.getQuantity(sku);
repo.setQuantity(sku, current - qty); // no lock, lost update
incidents.root_cause: Missing row-level lock on reservation update path in OrderService.place.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped OrderService.place in SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and added a concurrent-writer integration test.

incidents.title: Circular service dependency involving UserService.authenticate
incidents.description: Boot-time dependency cycle prevented user-service from starting for 15 minutes after deploy.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: A Spring-injected bean introduced a constructor-level circular dependency through UserService.authenticate.

incidents.title: Goroutine leak in FraudService.evaluate eats memory
incidents.description: fraud-service goroutine count grew to 120k over 6 hours. FraudService.evaluate spawned a goroutine per request but never drained the blocking channel.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause: Unbuffered channel in FraudService.evaluate; goroutine blocks on send when receiver exits early.
incidents.resolution: Switched to virtual threads; added metric for thread count.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on inventory-service
incidents.description: Expired intermediate cert caused TLS handshake failures on InventoryService.release's egress to elasticsearch. All downstream calls failed for 40 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Pinned truststore not updated after elasticsearch rotated its CA.
incidents.resolution: Replaced pinned truststore with system default; acme-renew scheduled weekly.

incidents.title: Contention on event table blocks FraudService.evaluate
incidents.description: Postgres reported lock_wait_timeout on the event table during peak traffic. FraudService.evaluate held a row lock while calling a remote service inside the same transaction.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
with session.begin():
    row = session.query(Entity).with_for_update().get(id)
    external_client.notify(row)  # network call inside txn
    session.add(row)
incidents.root_cause: FraudService.evaluate performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.
incidents.resolution: Enforced a canonical lock-acquisition order across FraudService.evaluate and the batch job.

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits s3 when FraudService.evaluate cache expires
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 800 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered s3. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
p = cache.get(sku)
if p is None:
    p = db.load(sku)  # stampede on concurrent miss
    cache.set(sku, p)
incidents.root_cause: TTL jitter missing; thousands of cache entries expire at the same second after a bulk warmup.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped loader in singleflight.Group so duplicate in-flight misses share a single origin call.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in AnalyticsScheduler.cache for non-UTC customers
incidents.description: Reports for 1500 customers showed events attributed to the wrong day. AnalyticsScheduler.cache did date arithmetic in local time then wrote UTC.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
now := time.Now() // system TZ
repo.Save(Event{Timestamp: now}) // later treated as UTC
incidents.root_cause: AnalyticsScheduler.cache mixes LocalDateTime with Instant — implicit system-default TZ used in one branch.
incidents.resolution: Standardized on time.Now().UTC() and added a test with a non-UTC TZ container.

incidents.title: OutOfMemoryError in inventory-service after InventoryScheduler.match introduces leak
incidents.description: A cache added to InventoryScheduler.match used request IDs as keys. Entries never expired. After 36h the retained size exceeded 2 GB.
incidents.root_cause: Listener added to InventoryScheduler.match was never unregistered when the request scope ended, pinning session objects in memory.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with Caffeine cache (max size 10k, 10-min TTL) and added heap-usage SLO.

incidents.title: Inconsistent pagination cursor in OrderService.place
incidents.description: ORDER BY non-unique column caused page 2+ to rehash order and skip items in OrderService.place.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: Offset-based pagination used for mutating list; items inserted between pages cause drift.
incidents.resolution: Added id as tiebreaker to sort; cursor now stable.

incidents.title: CORS preflight failures on NotificationsController.poll endpoint
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach NotificationsController.poll endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in NotificationsController.poll missed PATCH after API migration.
incidents.resolution: Extended allowlist to cover all swagstore.com subdomains via regex; lint-rule banning wildcards.

incidents.title: FraudService.evaluate issues one DB call per item — p99 degradation
incidents.description: FraudService.evaluate loads a collection then issues one DB call per item. With input sizes ~200, p99 crossed 8s. Evidence: trace span count scaling linearly with input size.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
for txn in user.transactions:
    score += risk_db.lookup(txn.id)  # N queries
incidents.root_cause: Batch fetch helper removed during cleanup; FraudService.evaluate reverted to per-item lookup.
incidents.resolution: Batched into a single risk_db.lookup_batch(txn_ids) call.

incidents.title: user-service fell behind topic by 120 messages
incidents.description: A sudden traffic surge overwhelmed the single-threaded consumer in UserService.authenticate; lag alerts fired within 10 minutes.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }
incidents.root_cause: Consumer concurrency set to 1; topic has 8 partitions but only 1 worker thread.
incidents.resolution: Moved ML call off hot path; per-message processing now <20ms.

incidents.title: Thread leak from ShippingService.createLabel saturates shipping-service
incidents.description: shipping-service goroutine count grew to 120k over 6 hours. ShippingService.createLabel spawned a goroutine per request but never drained the blocking channel.
incidents.root_cause: Unbuffered channel in ShippingService.createLabel; goroutine blocks on send when receiver exits early.
incidents.resolution: Switched to buffered channel; guaranteed drain on ctx.Done().

incidents.title: Inconsistent pagination cursor in OrderService.cancel
incidents.description: Consumers of OrderService.cancel paginated API saw ~0.5% of items silently skipped at page boundaries. Cursor computed from a non-unique sort key.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: OrderService.cancel sorts by created_at only — non-unique; cursor-based pagination unstable.
incidents.resolution: Added id as tiebreaker to sort; cursor now stable.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in PaymentService.captureWebhook for non-UTC customers
incidents.description: Scheduled job in PaymentService.captureWebhook fired at 01:00 local but skipped on DST-spring-forward day.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(); // system-default TZ
repo.save(new Event(now)); // saved as UTC — off by offset
incidents.root_cause: PaymentService.captureWebhook mixes LocalDateTime with Instant — implicit system-default TZ used in one branch.
incidents.resolution: Switched to Instant/UTC throughout; added lint rule banning LocalDateTime.now().

incidents.title: Circular service dependency involving UserRepository.authorize
incidents.description: A newly added call from UserRepository.authorize into stripe triggered stripe to call back into user-service, which looped through UserRepository.authorize again. Stack overflow after ~12 calls.
incidents.root_cause: A Spring-injected bean introduced a constructor-level circular dependency through UserRepository.authorize.
incidents.resolution: Broke cycle by introducing an event bus between user-service and stripe.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in CartService.addItem for non-UTC customers
incidents.description: Reports for 12 customers showed events attributed to the wrong day. CartService.addItem did date arithmetic in local time then wrote UTC.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(); // system-default TZ
repo.save(new Event(now)); // saved as UTC — off by offset
incidents.root_cause: CartService.addItem mixes LocalDateTime with Instant — implicit system-default TZ used in one branch.
incidents.resolution: Standardized on time.Now().UTC() and added a test with a non-UTC TZ container.

incidents.title: OrderGateway.dispatch ignores input argument due to shadow
incidents.description: Inside OrderGateway.dispatch, a local variable shadowed the argument of the same name. The caller's value was effectively ignored.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in OrderGateway.dispatch after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Renamed shadow to localUser; added lint rule flagging shadowed params.

incidents.title: Shared list default in NotificationsService.send accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Every invocation of NotificationsService.send appended to the same shared list, producing cross-call leakage.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
def process(items=[]):  # shared across calls
    items.append(fetch())
    return items
incidents.root_cause: Static List initializer in NotificationsService.send was shared by all instances.
incidents.resolution: Default to None and construct a fresh list inside the function.

incidents.title: Cache stampede on InventoryService.release following cache flush
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 500 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered catalog-service. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.root_cause: InventoryService.release uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped loader in singleflight.Group so duplicate in-flight misses share a single origin call.

incidents.title: Timeout cascade from user-service saturates FraudScheduler.resolve
incidents.description: Ingress requests timed out because FraudScheduler.resolve waited the full client timeout for user-service before returning. Retries amplified it.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: requests.get(url, timeout=30)  # 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: No circuit breaker in front of user-service — slow failures consumed all worker threads.
incidents.resolution: Tightened user-service client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on notifications-service
incidents.description: Expired intermediate cert caused TLS handshake failures on NotificationsService.send's egress to elasticsearch. All downstream calls failed for 40 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Certificate auto-renew job failed 14 days prior; nobody acted on the warning.
incidents.resolution: Rotated cert; added a synthetic monitor for days-to-expiry at 30/14/7 thresholds.

incidents.title: InventoryService.release drops last element of batch
incidents.description: Customers on page boundary saw duplicate entries on the last page and missing entries on the first. 12 reports filed.
incidents.root_cause: Loop bound changed from <= to < during a refactor at services/inventory-service/src/main/java/com/swagstore/inventory/InventoryService.java:118.
incidents.resolution: Fixed bound to items.size() inclusive; added boundary test.

incidents.title: CartRepository.apply retry loop amplifies rabbitmq load
incidents.description: A transient rabbitmq failure triggered CartRepository.apply's retry loop, which fired back-to-back requests with no backoff. Load amplified 8x and rabbitmq returned 429s for 3800 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Retry loop added in commit 9ab5dc5 lacks exponential backoff, amplifying transient errors into sustained load.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a Resilience4j retry policy with 500ms base + jitter and circuit breaker on rabbitmq.

incidents.title: Stale config in OrderService.place after secret rotation
incidents.description: OrderService.place cached the config at boot; operators rotated the flag but order-service wasn't restarted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: @Value("${api.key}") private String apiKey; // resolved once at boot
incidents.root_cause: Feature-flag SDK polling interval is 1 hour; OrderService.place missed the flip.
incidents.resolution: Moved secret lookup inside the request path; fetched from Vault per-minute cache.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on payment-service
incidents.description: A CA rotation removed an old root that our pinned truststore still listed. PaymentWorker.aggregate's user-service client rejected the new chain.
incidents.root_cause: Certificate auto-renew job failed 14 days prior; nobody acted on the warning.
incidents.resolution: Rotated cert; added a synthetic monitor for days-to-expiry at 30/14/7 thresholds.

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves search-service in broken state
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in SearchService.query already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.root_cause: App + schema deployed together; rollback of app didn't include DOWN migration.
incidents.resolution: Decoupled schema from app deploy; expand-contract pattern enforced.

incidents.title: Enum value mismatch between payment-service and notifications-service
incidents.description: PaymentProcessor.rollback received an enum value notifications-service had added but payment-service did not know about. Deserialization threw; requests 500'd.
incidents.root_cause: Strict enum deserializer in PaymentProcessor.rollback has no default branch for unknown values.
incidents.resolution: Added default: return unknown() branch; emit metric on unseen enum.

incidents.title: NotificationsRepository.apply serves stale reservation after config change
incidents.description: Search index refresh tied to cron every 24h missed price-update events.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Cache invalidation event listener for reservation was removed during a refactor.

incidents.title: DB connections leaking from UserService.dispatch under error paths
incidents.description: Pool usage on user-service ramped linearly from 20% to 100% over 4h. UserService.dispatch's error path never released the acquired connection. Once saturated, all requests blocked on pool.getConnection().
incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of UserService.dispatch — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: Circular service dependency involving SearchService.query
incidents.description: Boot-time dependency cycle prevented search-service from starting for 15 minutes after deploy.
incidents.root_cause: A Spring-injected bean introduced a constructor-level circular dependency through SearchService.query.
incidents.resolution: Broke cycle by introducing an event bus between search-service and catalog-service.

incidents.title: Shared list default in SearchService.query accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Calls to SearchService.query started seeing data from previous calls. A default [] argument kept accumulating appends across invocations.
incidents.root_cause: Static List initializer in SearchService.query was shared by all instances.
incidents.resolution: Default to None and construct a fresh list inside the function.

incidents.title: Deadlock in PaymentService.charge during high-concurrency writes
incidents.description: Two transactions acquired locks in reverse order on the record and related child tables, producing a classic AB/BA deadlock. Postgres aborted 800 of them per minute.
incidents.root_cause: PaymentService.charge performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.
incidents.resolution: Enforced a canonical lock-acquisition order across PaymentService.charge and the batch job.

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves cart-service in broken state
incidents.description: Rollback of cart-service left the schema mid-migration. Writes via CartService.checkout hit 500s on missing column.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@Column(name = "ext_id", nullable = false) // column not present after rollback
private String extId;
incidents.root_cause: App + schema deployed together; rollback of app didn't include DOWN migration.
incidents.resolution: Added DOWN migration + test; rollout gated on migration success.

incidents.title: UserResolver.refresh first-request latency crosses SLO
incidents.description: New pods on user-service served p99 > 8s for first 60 seconds. JIT + cache warmup missing in UserResolver.refresh.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
// no warmup queries on pod start
@PostConstruct public void init() { /* nothing */ }
incidents.root_cause: UserResolver.refresh lazily loads models on first request; initialization takes 40s.
incidents.resolution: Eager-loaded models in init; readiness probe blocks until ready.

incidents.title: Unknown field crashes PaymentService.refresh JSON parse
incidents.description: PaymentService.refresh crashed on messages from a newer producer that added a field. Jackson configured with FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=true.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
mapper.configure(FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES, true);
var msg = mapper.readValue(body, Message.class); // throws on new field
incidents.root_cause: PaymentService.refresh used strict deserialization; broke compatibility when producer added a non-nullable field.
incidents.resolution: Gated producer rollout behind schema-registry check; made new field optional with default.

incidents.title: Shared list default in RecommendationsWorker.fetch accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Calls to RecommendationsWorker.fetch started seeing data from previous calls. A default [] argument kept accumulating appends across invocations.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
def process(items=[]):  # shared across calls
    items.append(fetch())
    return items
incidents.root_cause: Mutable default argument (e.g., items=[]) in RecommendationsWorker.fetch retained state across calls.
incidents.resolution: Replaced static BUFFER with a per-request instance variable.

incidents.title: RecommendationsService.forUser timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: Ingress requests timed out because RecommendationsService.forUser waited the full client timeout for stripe before returning. Retries amplified it.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: requests.get(url, timeout=30)  # 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: No circuit breaker in front of stripe — slow failures consumed all worker threads.
incidents.resolution: Enforced timeout-budget rule: client timeout < ingress timeout / 2.

incidents.title: Unknown field crashes SearchResolver.commit JSON parse
incidents.description: SearchResolver.commit crashed on messages from a newer producer that added a field. Jackson configured with FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=true.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
dec := json.NewDecoder(r)
dec.DisallowUnknownFields() // breaks on producer adding field
var msg Message
dec.Decode(&msg)
incidents.root_cause: SearchResolver.commit used strict deserialization; broke compatibility when producer added a non-nullable field.
incidents.resolution: Relaxed to FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=false; documented forward-compat expectation.

incidents.title: Cache stampede on PaymentService.refund following cache flush
incidents.description: Post-deploy cache flush caused all requests for popular SKUs to bypass cache and hit the primary DB simultaneously.
incidents.root_cause: TTL jitter missing; thousands of cache entries expire at the same second after a bulk warmup.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped loader in singleflight.Group so duplicate in-flight misses share a single origin call.

incidents.title: Deserialization failure in CatalogGateway.aggregate after schema change
incidents.description: A Kafka producer rolled out a new field. Consumers in CatalogGateway.aggregate broke because the schema registry was not updated.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().configure(FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES, true)
val msg = mapper.readValue<Message>(body)
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Schema evolution rule broken: new non-optional field was added without a default.

incidents.title: DB connections leaking from ShippingResolver.index under error paths
incidents.description: Pool usage on shipping-service ramped linearly from 20% to 100% over 4h. ShippingResolver.index's error path never released the acquired connection. Once saturated, all requests blocked on pool.getConnection().
incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of ShippingResolver.index — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: order-service not reloaded after config change
incidents.description: OrderService.place cached the config at boot; operators rotated the flag but order-service wasn't restarted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: @Value("${api.key}") private String apiKey; // resolved once at boot
incidents.root_cause: OrderService.place reads the secret once at boot; no refresh hook.
incidents.resolution: Added SIGHUP handler that reloads config.

incidents.title: Inconsistent pagination cursor in PaymentService.refund
incidents.description: Consumers of PaymentService.refund paginated API saw ~0.5% of items silently skipped at page boundaries. Cursor computed from a non-unique sort key.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: PaymentService.refund sorts by created_at only — non-unique; cursor-based pagination unstable.
incidents.resolution: Added id as tiebreaker to sort; cursor now stable.

incidents.title: Cache stampede on RecommendationsService.forUser following cache flush
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 12 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered user-service. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
p = cache.get(sku)
if p is None:
    p = db.load(sku)  # stampede on concurrent miss
    cache.set(sku, p)
incidents.root_cause: TTL jitter missing; thousands of cache entries expire at the same second after a bulk warmup.
incidents.resolution: Added TTL jitter ±20% and per-key lock on cache miss.

incidents.title: JWT verification drift in PaymentService.captureWebhook
incidents.description: JWT signature verification in PaymentService.captureWebhook fell back to HS256 when RS256 key lookup failed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: verifier.acceptLeeway(3600); // was 30, changed by mistake
incidents.root_cause: Leeway changed from 30s to 3600s in PaymentService.captureWebhook via a "debug fix" that was never reverted.
incidents.resolution: Reverted leeway to 30s; unit test asserts < 60s.

incidents.title: OrderProcessor.release timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: Ingress requests timed out because OrderProcessor.release waited the full client timeout for kafka before returning. Retries amplified it.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: No circuit breaker in front of kafka — slow failures consumed all worker threads.
incidents.resolution: Tightened kafka client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in PaymentService.captureWebhook for non-UTC customers
incidents.description: Scheduled job in PaymentService.captureWebhook fired at 01:00 local but skipped on DST-spring-forward day.

LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(); // system-default TZ
repo.save(new Event(now)); // saved as UTC — off by offset
incidents.root_cause: PaymentService.captureWebhook mixes LocalDateTime with Instant — implicit system-default TZ used in one branch.
incidents.resolution: Standardized on time.Now().UTC() and added a test with a non-UTC TZ container.

incidents.title: Appender loop in FraudWorker.handle crashes fraud-service
incidents.description: fraud-service logs grew from 50 MB/h to 50 GB/h within minutes. An appender sent logs to FraudWorker.handle, which itself logged on every call.
incidents.root_cause: HTTP appender in Logback posted to FraudWorker.handle; that method logged the request, recursing.
incidents.resolution: Excluded the logging endpoint from the HTTP appender's path filter.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on inventory-service

incidents.root_cause: Certificate auto-renew job failed 14 days prior; nobody acted on the warning.
incidents.resolution: Rotated cert; added a synthetic monitor for days-to-expiry at 30/14/7 thresholds.

incidents.title: Contention on record table blocks NotificationsService.send
incidents.description: Postgres reported lock_wait_timeout on the record table during peak traffic. NotificationsService.send held a row lock while calling a remote service inside the same transaction.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
with session.begin():

    session.add(row)
incidents.root_cause: NotificationsService.send performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.
incidents.resolution: Moved the external call outside the transaction; replaced with outbox pattern.

incidents.title: payment-service not reloaded after config change

incidents.offending_code_snippet: @Value("${api.key}") private String apiKey; // resolved once at boot

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate concatenates user input into SQL

String sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'";
stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: Dynamic query builder escaped single quotes but not other metacharacters.

incidents.title: Unknown enum value crashes OrderResolver.serialize
incidents.description: OrderResolver.serialize received an enum value inventory-service had added but order-service did not know about. Deserialization threw; requests 500'd.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Strict enum deserializer in OrderResolver.serialize has no default branch for unknown values.

incidents.title: ShippingGateway.process async callback swallows errors
incidents.description: An async task in ShippingGateway.process fired and forgot; failures never surfaced to callers.
incidents.root_cause: Fire-and-forget pattern in ShippingGateway.process with no .catch(); rejected promise unhandled.
incidents.resolution: Replaced create_task with awaited call; added error callback.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in ShippingService.createLabel for non-UTC customers

now := time.Now() // system TZ
repo.Save(Event{Timestamp: now}) // later treated as UTC
incidents.root_cause: ShippingService.createLabel mixes LocalDateTime with Instant — implicit system-default TZ used in one branch.

incidents.title: PII leak through RecommendationsResolver.deserialize debug logs

incidents.title: Unknown enum value crashes InventoryHandler.apply

incidents.title: NotificationsController.release over-counts during concurrent requests
incidents.description: Concurrent callers of NotificationsController.release produced inconsistent order totals. Read-modify-write without a lock allowed two threads to observe the same pre-state. 500 affected records.

row = session.query(Inventory).get(id)
row.count += delta
session.commit()  # no SELECT ... FOR UPDATE

incidents.title: PaymentService.captureWebhook mishandles DST transition

incidents.title: PII leak through FraudService.evaluate debug logs
incidents.description: A print-statement left from local testing exposed full card numbers in FraudService.evaluate for PCI-scoped traffic.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: logger.debug(f"request: {request.__dict__}")  # leaks API key
incidents.root_cause: Verbose debug flag merged accidentally; FraudService.evaluate logger lacks field-scrubber middleware.
incidents.resolution: Added PCI-aware log scrubber; banned raw request in logger.

incidents.title: Retry storm from SearchService.query takes down catalog-service
incidents.description: A transient catalog-service failure triggered SearchService.query's retry loop, which fired back-to-back requests with no backoff. Load amplified 8x and catalog-service returned 429s for 40 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: MAX_RETRIES bumped from 3 to 10 without corresponding backoff; under partial failure the amplification crossed the rate-limit threshold.
incidents.resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms, cap 5s) in SearchService.query.

incidents.title: CartService.addItem exceeded user-service quota during burst
incidents.description: CartService.addItem fan-out multiplied incoming request volume 12x into user-service. user-service returned 429s for 25 minutes. Customer-visible as slow checkouts.
incidents.root_cause: Rate limit config on the client side raised from 50 to 500 rps without coordination with user-service team.
incidents.resolution: Added a token-bucket limiter at the client edge with 100 rps ceiling.

incidents.title: Goroutine leak in InventoryService.release eats memory
incidents.description: inventory-service goroutine count grew to 120k over 6 hours. InventoryService.release spawned a goroutine per request but never drained the blocking channel.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: CompletableFuture in InventoryService.release is never completed on the cancellation path.

incidents.title: user-service fell behind topic by 300 messages
incidents.description: user-service consumer lag grew to 300 messages. UserHandler.handle's per-message processing time exceeded poll interval; single-partition concurrency starved.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }
incidents.root_cause: Consumer concurrency set to 1; topic has 8 partitions but only 1 worker thread.
incidents.resolution: Moved ML call off hot path; per-message processing now <20ms.

incidents.title: Token validation weakened in OrderService.place
incidents.description: JWT signature verification in OrderService.place fell back to HS256 when RS256 key lookup failed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: verifier.acceptLeeway(3600); // was 30, changed by mistake
incidents.root_cause: Algorithm confusion — accepted HS256 tokens signed with the public RS256 key.
incidents.resolution: Pinned algorithm to RS256 explicitly; rejected unexpected algs.

incidents.title: Rate-limit amplification from AnalyticsRepository.enrich into redis
incidents.description: AnalyticsRepository.enrich fan-out multiplied incoming request volume 12x into redis. redis returned 429s for 25 minutes. Customer-visible as slow checkouts.
incidents.root_cause: No request-coalescing in AnalyticsRepository.enrich; per-sub-item calls instead of batch API.
incidents.resolution: Added a token-bucket limiter at the client edge with 100 rps ceiling.

incidents.title: Catch-and-log in AnalyticsScheduler.fetch masks real errors
incidents.description: Orders succeeded from the caller's perspective even when downstream s3 failed. A catch block in AnalyticsScheduler.fetch logged the error at DEBUG but returned success.
incidents.root_cause: Empty catch block left over from scaffolding.
incidents.resolution: Replaced generic catch with specific TransientException handling.

incidents.title: N+1 query in ShippingService.createLabel blows up latency
incidents.description: ShippingService.createLabel loads a collection then issues one DB call per item. With input sizes ~200, p99 crossed 8s. Evidence: trace span count scaling linearly with input size.
incidents.root_cause: Lazy-loaded association triggers a SELECT per element inside ShippingService.createLabel's loop.
incidents.resolution: Added JPA @EntityGraph to eager-fetch the association.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in NotificationsWorker.consume for non-UTC customers
incidents.description: Reports for 12 customers showed events attributed to the wrong day. NotificationsWorker.consume did date arithmetic in local time then wrote UTC.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
now = datetime.now()  # naive, system tz
repo.save(Event(now))  # assumed UTC downstream
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Forgot to convert to UTC before persisting. Works in dev (UTC container) but not prod (customer-local TZ).

incidents.title: DB connections leaking from CartService.checkout under error paths
incidents.description: A code path in CartService.checkout returned early on validation error but skipped the finally block that returns the connection. Pool leaked ~800 connections per hour.
incidents.root_cause: Switched to try-with-resources but the Connection was pulled out into a field, bypassing the auto-close.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: Stale cache in InventoryScheduler.rollback after catalog-service update
incidents.description: Search index refresh tied to cron every 24h missed price-update events.
incidents.root_cause: Cache invalidation event listener for reservation was removed during a refactor.
incidents.resolution: Subscribed InventoryScheduler.rollback to the update-event stream; TTL reduced to 5m.

incidents.title: Catch-and-log in SearchGateway.consume masks real errors
incidents.description: Orders succeeded from the caller's perspective even when downstream dynamo failed. A catch block in SearchGateway.consume logged the error at DEBUG but returned success.
incidents.root_cause: Empty catch block left over from scaffolding.
incidents.resolution: Replaced generic catch with specific TransientException handling.

incidents.title: cart-service fell behind topic by 500 messages
incidents.description: cart-service consumer lag grew to 500 messages. CartHandler.resolve's per-message processing time exceeded poll interval; single-partition concurrency starved.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }
incidents.root_cause: Consumer concurrency set to 1; topic has 8 partitions but only 1 worker thread.
incidents.resolution: Increased consumer concurrency to 8; matched topic partition count.

incidents.title: AnalyticsService.verify TLS verification broken after CA rotation
incidents.description: A CA rotation removed an old root that our pinned truststore still listed. AnalyticsService.verify's dynamo client rejected the new chain.
incidents.root_cause: Certificate auto-renew job failed 14 days prior; nobody acted on the warning.
incidents.resolution: Rotated cert; added a synthetic monitor for days-to-expiry at 30/14/7 thresholds.

incidents.title: Thread leak from InventoryHandler.resolve saturates inventory-service
incidents.description: A thread-pool executor in InventoryHandler.resolve spawned threads but its submitted tasks never completed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause: Unbuffered channel in InventoryHandler.resolve; goroutine blocks on send when receiver exits early.
incidents.resolution: Switched to buffered channel; guaranteed drain on ctx.Done().

incidents.title: CartWorker.match idempotency key missing
incidents.description: At-least-once queue + no idempotency check in CartWorker.match produced duplicate emails/charges/orders.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: String idemKey = UUID.randomUUID().toString(); // new per attempt
incidents.root_cause: Idempotency key generated per-attempt in CartWorker.match instead of per-order.
incidents.resolution: Derived idempotency key from (orderId, attempt-bucket).

incidents.title: CartService.checkout TLS verification broken after CA rotation
incidents.description: A CA rotation removed an old root that our pinned truststore still listed. CartService.checkout's user-service client rejected the new chain.
incidents.root_cause: Pinned truststore not updated after user-service rotated its CA.
incidents.resolution: Rotated cert; added a synthetic monitor for days-to-expiry at 30/14/7 thresholds.

incidents.title: FraudRepository.enrich re-entrancy produces infinite loop
incidents.description: A newly added call from FraudRepository.enrich into sqs triggered sqs to call back into fraud-service, which looped through FraudRepository.enrich again. Stack overflow after ~3800 calls.
incidents.root_cause: A Spring-injected bean introduced a constructor-level circular dependency through FraudRepository.enrich.
incidents.resolution: Broke cycle by introducing an event bus between fraud-service and sqs.

incidents.title: Duplicate processing in FraudClient.index on retry
incidents.description: Clients retrying after transient errors produced duplicate side effects in FraudClient.index. ~800 records affected; remediation required manual refund.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: idem_key = str(uuid.uuid4())  # new every attempt
incidents.root_cause: At-least-once consumer in FraudClient.index lacks dedup on messageId.
incidents.resolution: Derived idempotency key from (orderId, attempt-bucket).

incidents.title: Unknown enum value crashes PaymentResolver.reserve
incidents.description: payment-service and fraud-service drifted on the Status enum. PaymentResolver.reserve crashed whenever the new value was observed.
incidents.root_cause: Strict enum deserializer in PaymentResolver.reserve has no default branch for unknown values.
incidents.resolution: Standardized on string-typed enums with a forward-compatible default.

incidents.title: PaymentService.refund mishandles DST transition
incidents.description: Reports for 3800 customers showed events attributed to the wrong day. PaymentService.refund did date arithmetic in local time then wrote UTC.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(); // system-default TZ
repo.save(new Event(now)); // saved as UTC — off by offset
incidents.root_cause: Forgot to convert to UTC before persisting. Works in dev (UTC container) but not prod (customer-local TZ).
incidents.resolution: Standardized on time.Now().UTC() and added a test with a non-UTC TZ container.

incidents.title: Enum value mismatch between payment-service and fraud-service
incidents.description: PaymentService.captureWebhook received an enum value fraud-service had added but payment-service did not know about. Deserialization threw; requests 500'd.
incidents.root_cause: fraud-service added the PENDING_REVIEW status; payment-service was never updated.
incidents.resolution: Added default: return unknown() branch; emit metric on unseen enum.

incidents.title: ShippingWorker.aggregate drops items across page boundaries
incidents.description: ORDER BY non-unique column caused page 2+ to rehash order and skip items in ShippingWorker.aggregate.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: rows, _ := db.Query("SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY created_at LIMIT ? OFFSET ?", size, n*size)
incidents.root_cause: ShippingWorker.aggregate sorts by created_at only — non-unique; cursor-based pagination unstable.
incidents.resolution: Switched to keyset pagination: ORDER BY (created_at, id).

incidents.title: DB connections leaking from PaymentRepository.consume under error paths
incidents.description: Pool usage on payment-service ramped linearly from 20% to 100% over 4h. PaymentRepository.consume's error path never released the acquired connection. Once saturated, all requests blocked on pool.getConnection().
incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of PaymentRepository.consume — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: Off-by-one in NotificationsService.send pagination
incidents.description: Last element of each batch in NotificationsService.send was silently dropped. Downstream aggregator under-counted by ~0.2%.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
for i in range(len(items) - 1):  # drops last
    process(items[i])
incidents.root_cause: Loop bound changed from <= to < during a refactor at services/notifications-service/src/notifications_service/sender.py:74.
incidents.resolution: Switched to explicit iterator; removed magic -1 / +1.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in OrderService.cancel for non-UTC customers
incidents.description: Reports for 40 customers showed events attributed to the wrong day. OrderService.cancel did date arithmetic in local time then wrote UTC.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(); // system-default TZ
repo.save(new Event(now)); // saved as UTC — off by offset
incidents.root_cause: Forgot to convert to UTC before persisting. Works in dev (UTC container) but not prod (customer-local TZ).
incidents.resolution: Standardized on time.Now().UTC() and added a test with a non-UTC TZ container.

incidents.title: JWT verification drift in AnalyticsResolver.execute
incidents.description: JWT signature verification in AnalyticsResolver.execute fell back to HS256 when RS256 key lookup failed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: jwt.Parse(token, func(t *jwt.Token) (interface{}, error) { return key, nil }) // trusts alg header
incidents.root_cause: Algorithm confusion — accepted HS256 tokens signed with the public RS256 key.
incidents.resolution: Pinned algorithm to RS256 explicitly; rejected unexpected algs.

incidents.title: Field typo in CartHandler.refresh silently drops data

incidents.root_cause: Typo `user_Id` vs `userId` in CartHandler.refresh's JSON emitter.
incidents.resolution: Switched to a generated DTO; typo impossible.

incidents.title: PaymentService.charge drops last element of batch

incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Loop bound changed from <= to < during a refactor at services/payment-service/src/main/java/com/swagstore/payment/PaymentService.java:145.

incidents.title: Mismatched field name in RecommendationsService.forUser after rename

incidents.title: Deadlock in PaymentResolver.emit during high-concurrency writes
incidents.description: Postgres reported lock_wait_timeout on the token table during peak traffic. PaymentResolver.emit held a row lock while calling a remote service inside the same transaction.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: PaymentResolver.emit performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.

incidents.title: Exponential backoff missing in PaymentService.emit retry path
incidents.description: A transient elasticsearch failure triggered PaymentService.emit's retry loop, which fired back-to-back requests with no backoff. Load amplified 8x and elasticsearch returned 429s for 500 minutes.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: MAX_RETRIES bumped from 3 to 10 without corresponding backoff; under partial failure the amplification crossed the rate-limit threshold.

incidents.title: Mutable default argument causes state bleed in PaymentProcessor.lookup
incidents.description: Calls to PaymentProcessor.lookup started seeing data from previous calls. A default [] argument kept accumulating appends across invocations.
incidents.root_cause: Static List initializer in PaymentProcessor.lookup was shared by all instances.
incidents.resolution: Default to None and construct a fresh list inside the function.

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves recommendations-service in broken state

class Item(Base):
    ext_id = Column(String, nullable=False)  # missing after rollback
incidents.root_cause: Non-transactional DDL meant the failed migration left an orphaned column.
incidents.resolution: Decoupled schema from app deploy; expand-contract pattern enforced.

incidents.title: FraudHandler.authorize ignores input argument due to shadow
incidents.description: Linter caught a shadowed variable in FraudHandler.authorize that had masked a config-override path for 3 weeks.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in FraudHandler.authorize after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Renamed shadow to localUser; added lint rule flagging shadowed params.

incidents.title: Sensitive token logged in SearchService.query

incidents.offending_code_snippet: log.Printf("req: %+v", req) // leaks auth token
incidents.root_cause: Struct printed with %+v in SearchService.query, exposing sensitive fields.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a redact() helper + CI lint rule blocking %+v on request types.

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate rejects legitimate cross-origin requests

@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: CORS allowlist regex missed the marketing subdomain UserService.authenticate serves.
incidents.resolution: Added marketing.swagstore.com to the allowlist; added integration test.

incidents.title: Exponential backoff missing in PaymentProcessor.release retry path
incidents.description: When notifications-service started returning slow 5xx, PaymentProcessor.release retried aggressively. The retry storm starved the thread pool and cascaded to upstream callers.
incidents.root_cause: MAX_RETRIES bumped from 3 to 10 without corresponding backoff; under partial failure the amplification crossed the rate-limit threshold.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a Resilience4j retry policy with 500ms base + jitter and circuit breaker on notifications-service.

incidents.title: Thread leak from FraudRepository.serialize saturates fraud-service

rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous

incidents.title: Stale config in UserService.authenticate after secret rotation
incidents.description: UserService.authenticate cached the config at boot; operators rotated the flag but user-service wasn't restarted.

incidents.title: Race condition in AnalyticsWorker.process yields duplicate order rows
incidents.description: Concurrent callers of AnalyticsWorker.process produced inconsistent order totals. Read-modify-write without a lock allowed two threads to observe the same pre-state. 500 affected records.

current := repo.GetQuantity(sku)
repo.SetQuantity(sku, current-qty) // no lock
incidents.root_cause: @Transactional removed from AnalyticsWorker.process during a refactor, exposing the read-modify-write race.
incidents.resolution: Re-added @Transactional and added @Version optimistic locking on the entity.

incidents.title: ReDoS in PaymentService.captureWebhook regex triggers CPU spike

p.matcher(userInput).matches(); // catastrophic

incidents.title: CartWorker.cache over-counts during concurrent requests

repo.setQuantity(sku, current - qty); // no lock, lost update
incidents.root_cause: Missing row-level lock on token update path in CartWorker.cache.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped CartWorker.cache in SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and added a concurrent-writer integration test.

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits s3 when AnalyticsResolver.cache cache expires
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 300 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered s3. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
if p, ok := cache.Get(sku); ok { return p }
p := db.Load(sku) // no singleflight
cache.Set(sku, p)
return p
incidents.root_cause: AnalyticsResolver.cache uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped loader in singleflight.Group so duplicate in-flight misses share a single origin call.

incidents.title: Gradual heap growth tied to PaymentService.refund cache
incidents.description: A cache added to PaymentService.refund used request IDs as keys. Entries never expired. After 36h the retained size exceeded 2 GB.
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded cache in PaymentService.refund — no size cap, no TTL.
incidents.resolution: Switched to LRU with explicit capacity; added metric cache.size for alerting.

incidents.title: DB connections leaking from FraudGateway.dispatch under error paths
incidents.description: Pool usage on fraud-service ramped linearly from 20% to 100% over 4h. FraudGateway.dispatch's error path never released the acquired connection. Once saturated, all requests blocked on pool.getConnection().
incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of FraudGateway.dispatch — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: AnalyticsProcessor.dispatch rejects legitimate cross-origin requests
incidents.description: Wildcard CORS config tightened for security; legitimate marketing origin not allowlisted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: c := cors.New(cors.Options{AllowedOrigins: []string{"https://app.swagstore.com"}})
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in AnalyticsProcessor.dispatch missed PATCH after API migration.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in CartHandler.validate for non-UTC customers
incidents.description: Reports for 2400 customers showed events attributed to the wrong day. CartHandler.validate did date arithmetic in local time then wrote UTC.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(); // system-default TZ
repo.save(new Event(now)); // saved as UTC — off by offset
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: CartHandler.validate mixes LocalDateTime with Instant — implicit system-default TZ used in one branch.

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves recommendations-service in broken state
incidents.description: Rollback of recommendations-service left the schema mid-migration. Writes via RecommendationsService.forUser hit 500s on missing column.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
class Item(Base):
    ext_id = Column(String, nullable=False)  # missing after rollback
incidents.root_cause: App + schema deployed together; rollback of app didn't include DOWN migration.
incidents.resolution: Added DOWN migration + test; rollout gated on migration success.

incidents.title: CartController.render exceeded inventory-service quota during burst
incidents.description: A loop in CartController.render called inventory-service per sub-item. At p95 input size, quota tripped within 90 seconds.
incidents.root_cause: Rate limit config on the client side raised from 50 to 500 rps without coordination with inventory-service team.
incidents.resolution: Added a token-bucket limiter at the client edge with 100 rps ceiling.

incidents.title: Goroutine leak in OrderScheduler.enrich eats memory
incidents.description: A thread-pool executor in OrderScheduler.enrich spawned threads but its submitted tasks never completed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause: Unbuffered channel in OrderScheduler.enrich; goroutine blocks on send when receiver exits early.
incidents.resolution: Switched to buffered channel; guaranteed drain on ctx.Done().

incidents.title: Log-on-log recursion in RecommendationsService.forUser fills disk
incidents.description: A custom Logback appender that posted to an internal HTTP endpoint hit RecommendationsService.forUser, which logged incoming requests — infinite loop.
incidents.root_cause: Error handler logged the exception, but the log emitter itself threw the same exception.
incidents.resolution: Added recursion detection in the appender; bounded depth 1.

incidents.title: UserResolver.rollback rejects legitimate cross-origin requests
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach UserResolver.rollback endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: CORS allowlist regex missed the marketing subdomain UserResolver.rollback serves.
incidents.resolution: Added marketing.swagstore.com to the allowlist; added integration test.

incidents.title: Variable shadowing in CatalogController.aggregate overrides caller value
incidents.description: Linter caught a shadowed variable in CatalogController.aggregate that had masked a config-override path for 3 weeks.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in CatalogController.aggregate after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Enabled -Werror=shadow; caught two more instances in review.

incidents.title: Circular service dependency involving NotificationsWorker.serialize
incidents.description: Boot-time dependency cycle prevented notifications-service from starting for 15 minutes after deploy.
incidents.root_cause: sqs added a synchronous callback to NotificationsWorker.serialize, forming a cycle.
incidents.resolution: Refactored to injected interface; broke the tight Spring cycle.

incidents.title: NotificationsService.send mishandles DST transition
incidents.description: Scheduled job in NotificationsService.send fired at 01:00 local but skipped on DST-spring-forward day.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
now = datetime.now()  # naive, system tz
repo.save(Event(now))  # assumed UTC downstream

incidents.resolution: Standardized on time.Now().UTC() and added a test with a non-UTC TZ container.

incidents.title: ShippingRepository.verify drops items across page boundaries

incidents.resolution: Added id as tiebreaker to sort; cursor now stable.

incidents.title: Connection pool exhausted in analytics-service after AnalyticsWorker.authorize leak

incidents.root_cause: Switched to try-with-resources but the Connection was pulled out into a field, bypassing the auto-close.
incidents.resolution: Added defer conn.Release() at top of function and instrumented acquire/release counters.

incidents.title: Thread leak from SearchController.commit saturates search-service
incidents.description: A thread-pool executor in SearchController.commit spawned threads but its submitted tasks never completed.
incidents.root_cause: CompletableFuture in SearchController.commit is never completed on the cancellation path.
incidents.resolution: Switched to buffered channel; guaranteed drain on ctx.Done().

incidents.title: CatalogHandler.validate mishandles DST transition

val now = LocalDateTime.now() // system-default TZ

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits payment-service when OrderProcessor.execute cache expires

incidents.title: ReDoS in CatalogWorker.authorize regex triggers CPU spike

Pattern p = Pattern.compile("^(a+)+$");
p.matcher(userInput).matches(); // catastrophic
incidents.root_cause: Regex `^(a+)+$` in CatalogWorker.authorize backtracks exponentially on non-matching input.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with a linear-time parser; banned user-input regex matching.

incidents.title: PaymentService.poll concatenates user input into SQL

stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi

incidents.resolution: Reverted to PreparedStatement with ? placeholders. Added SAST gate to CI.

incidents.title: Off-by-one in PaymentService.charge pagination

incidents.title: Duplicate processing in NotificationsResolver.render on retry

incidents.title: Circular service dependency involving CatalogController.aggregate

class A(private val b: B) { fun a() = b.b() }
class B(private val a: A) { fun b() = a.a() } // cycle

incidents.title: RecommendationsController.execute concatenates user input into SQL

incidents.title: Rate-limit amplification from RecommendationsService.forUser into catalog-service
incidents.description: A loop in RecommendationsService.forUser called catalog-service per sub-item. At p95 input size, quota tripped within 90 seconds.

for item in request.items:

incidents.root_cause: No request-coalescing in RecommendationsService.forUser; per-sub-item calls instead of batch API.

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits stripe when OrderService.place cache expires

incidents.title: Timeout cascade from elasticsearch saturates InventoryWorker.refresh

rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: No circuit breaker in front of elasticsearch — slow failures consumed all worker threads.
incidents.resolution: Tightened elasticsearch client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: Deadlock in FraudService.evaluate during high-concurrency writes
incidents.description: Two transactions acquired locks in reverse order on the reservation and related child tables, producing a classic AB/BA deadlock. Postgres aborted 800 of them per minute.

with session.begin():

    external_client.notify(row)  # network call inside txn
    session.add(row)
incidents.root_cause: Lock acquisition order inconsistent between FraudService.evaluate and the batch job — produces AB/BA deadlock.
incidents.resolution: Enforced a canonical lock-acquisition order across FraudService.evaluate and the batch job.

incidents.title: Enum value mismatch between payment-service and notifications-service

incidents.title: CatalogProcessor.verify concatenates user input into SQL

incidents.title: JWT verification drift in PaymentService.captureWebhook

incidents.title: FraudProcessor.deserialize TLS verification broken after CA rotation

incidents.title: Gradual heap growth tied to ShippingService.createLabel cache

incidents.title: SQL injection protection regression in CartController.consume

incidents.title: Connection pool exhausted in order-service after OrderClient.apply leak
