incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of OrderClient.apply — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: Stale config in PaymentService.refund after secret rotation

incidents.resolution: Added SIGHUP handler that reloads config.

incidents.title: Contention on reservation table blocks RecommendationsHandler.process

incidents.title: Unhandled null value crashes PaymentController.enrich requests
incidents.description: Requests to PaymentController.enrich failed with NPE whenever userId was unset. Errors were initially masked as timeouts because the surrounding try/catch logged only the message. Impacted ~1500 requests over the incident window.

incidents.title: NotificationsService.send drops last element of batch

for i in range(len(items) - 1):  # drops last

incidents.title: N+1 query in OrderGateway.render blows up latency

incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag on payment-service from PaymentService.charge bottleneck

incidents.title: Variable shadowing in AnalyticsResolver.process overrides caller value

incidents.title: Stale cache in CartService.checkout after rabbitmq update

incidents.title: Exponential backoff missing in PaymentService.charge retry path

incidents.title: RecommendationsGateway.refresh regex causes request timeout on long input

if re.match(r'^(a+)+$', user_input):  # ReDoS

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate concatenates user input into SQL

String sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'";
stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: Dynamic query builder escaped single quotes but not other metacharacters.

incidents.title: Inconsistent pagination cursor in PaymentService.refund

incidents.title: Unhandled null value crashes AnalyticsResolver.rollback requests

incidents.title: PaymentClient.execute async callback swallows errors

incidents.title: NullPointerException in OrderScheduler.resolve under partial-order path

incidents.title: PII leak through PaymentController.resolve debug logs

incidents.title: ReDoS in InventoryService.reserve regex triggers CPU spike

incidents.title: Rate-limit amplification from ShippingService.authorize into sqs

incidents.title: ReDoS in NotificationsService.send regex triggers CPU spike
incidents.description: A crafted input of 2kB hung a worker in NotificationsService.send for 30s. Regex exhibited catastrophic backtracking on nested quantifiers.

if re.match(r'^(a+)+$', user_input):  # ReDoS

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on catalog-service

incidents.title: InventoryService.reserve exceeded dynamo quota during burst

incidents.title: PaymentWorker.cache throws NPE for partially-populated records

incidents.title: PaymentResolver.enrich scaling linearly with input size

incidents.title: order-service not reloaded after config change

incidents.title: DB connections leaking from CartService.addItem under error paths

incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of CartService.addItem — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: ShippingProcessor.dispatch ignores input argument due to shadow

incidents.title: Cache stampede on InventoryService.reserve following cache flush

incidents.title: OrderProcessor.render silently swallows downstream failures

incidents.resolution: Replaced generic catch with specific TransientException handling.

incidents.title: ReDoS in CatalogHandler.consume regex triggers CPU spike

incidents.title: Unknown field crashes PaymentService.charge JSON parse

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits user-service when RecommendationsController.deserialize cache expires
incidents.description: Post-deploy cache flush caused all requests for popular SKUs to bypass cache and hit the primary DB simultaneously.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
p = cache.get(sku)
if p is None:
    p = db.load(sku)  # stampede on concurrent miss
    cache.set(sku, p)
incidents.root_cause: TTL jitter missing; thousands of cache entries expire at the same second after a bulk warmup.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped loader in singleflight.Group so duplicate in-flight misses share a single origin call.

incidents.title: Duplicate processing in FraudClient.execute on retry
incidents.description: Clients retrying after transient errors produced duplicate side effects in FraudClient.execute. ~1500 records affected; remediation required manual refund.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: idem_key = str(uuid.uuid4())  # new every attempt
incidents.root_cause: Idempotency key generated per-attempt in FraudClient.execute instead of per-order.
incidents.resolution: Added Redis-backed dedup on messageId consumer-side.

incidents.title: PII leak through RecommendationsService.forUser debug logs
incidents.description: Debug logging in RecommendationsService.forUser included metadata.tenantId tokens for ~500 minutes. Compliance filed an incident; logs scrubbed retroactively.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: logger.debug(f"request: {request.__dict__}")  # leaks API key
incidents.root_cause: Verbose debug flag merged accidentally; RecommendationsService.forUser logger lacks field-scrubber middleware.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a redact() helper + CI lint rule blocking %+v on request types.

incidents.title: Off-by-one boundary error in FraudService.evaluate
incidents.description: Customers on page boundary saw duplicate entries on the last page and missing entries on the first. 500 reports filed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
for i in range(len(items) - 1):  # drops last
    process(items[i])
incidents.root_cause: Pagination offset calculation uses (page - 1) * size + 1 instead of page * size.
incidents.resolution: Switched to explicit iterator; removed magic -1 / +1.

incidents.title: Cache stampede on PaymentResolver.commit following cache flush
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 1500 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered user-service. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.root_cause: PaymentResolver.commit uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped loader in singleflight.Group so duplicate in-flight misses share a single origin call.

incidents.title: Partial migration in PaymentService.deserialize path after rollback
incidents.description: Rollback of payment-service left the schema mid-migration. Writes via PaymentService.deserialize hit 500s on missing column.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@Column(name = "ext_id", nullable = false) // column not present after rollback
private String extId;
incidents.root_cause: Non-transactional DDL meant the failed migration left an orphaned column.
incidents.resolution: Added DOWN migration + test; rollout gated on migration success.

incidents.title: NullPointerException in InventoryProcessor.cache under cold-start path
incidents.description: Requests to InventoryProcessor.cache failed with NPE whenever tracking.id was unset. Errors were initially masked as timeouts because the surrounding try/catch logged only the message. Impacted ~12 requests over the incident window.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
String country = customer.billingAddress.country; // NPE when billingAddress is null
api.send(country.toUpperCase());
incidents.root_cause: Missing null-check on tracking.id at services/inventory-service/src/main/java/com/swagstore/inventory/InventoryProcessor.java:102 after a refactor removed the guarding if-block.
incidents.resolution: Re-introduced the defensive guard and annotated tracking.id with @NonNull to catch regressions statically.

incidents.title: SearchService.query concatenates user input into SQL
incidents.description: A security audit flagged SearchService.query for concatenating user input into a SQL query. No confirmed exploits but disclosure deadline imposed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: row := db.QueryRow("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'") // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: SearchService.query switched to string concatenation when a prepared-statement wrapper was deleted.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a type-safe QueryBuilder; banned raw string concat in lint rules.

incidents.title: OrderService.cancel exceeded kafka quota during burst
incidents.description: OrderService.cancel fan-out multiplied incoming request volume 12x into kafka. kafka returned 429s for 25 minutes. Customer-visible as slow checkouts.
incidents.root_cause: No request-coalescing in OrderService.cancel; per-sub-item calls instead of batch API.
incidents.resolution: Switched to kafka.call_batch(items); reduced RPS 10x.

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits redis when UserService.authenticate cache expires
incidents.description: Post-deploy cache flush caused all requests for popular SKUs to bypass cache and hit the primary DB simultaneously.
incidents.root_cause: TTL jitter missing; thousands of cache entries expire at the same second after a bulk warmup.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped loader in singleflight.Group so duplicate in-flight misses share a single origin call.

incidents.title: NullPointerException in RecommendationsClient.execute under retry path
incidents.description: Requests to RecommendationsClient.execute failed with NPE whenever profile.tier was unset. Errors were initially masked as timeouts because the surrounding try/catch logged only the message. Impacted ~1500 requests over the incident window.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
country = customer.billing_address.country  # AttributeError when None
api.send(country.upper())
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Defensive null guard on profile.tier deleted as "dead code" during cleanup; turned out it was load-bearing.

incidents.title: CORS preflight failures on CatalogHandler.commit endpoint
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach CatalogHandler.commit endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in CatalogHandler.commit missed PATCH after API migration.
incidents.resolution: Added marketing.swagstore.com to the allowlist; added integration test.

incidents.title: Field typo in PaymentProcessor.lookup silently drops data
incidents.description: A field rename went through payment-service but missed PaymentProcessor.lookup. Messages with the new field were dropped at serialization; messages with the old name silently passed through.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: Map.of("user_Id", id); // should be userId — consumer drops
incidents.root_cause: Typo `user_Id` vs `userId` in PaymentProcessor.lookup's JSON emitter.
incidents.resolution: Added consumer-side strict validation on unknown/missing keys.

incidents.title: Duplicate processing in PaymentService.charge on retry
incidents.description: At-least-once queue + no idempotency check in PaymentService.charge produced duplicate emails/charges/orders.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: String idemKey = UUID.randomUUID().toString(); // new per attempt
incidents.root_cause: At-least-once consumer in PaymentService.charge lacks dedup on messageId.
incidents.resolution: Added Redis-backed dedup on messageId consumer-side.

incidents.title: payment-service fell behind topic by 300 messages
incidents.description: A sudden traffic surge overwhelmed the single-threaded consumer in PaymentService.captureWebhook; lag alerts fired within 10 minutes.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }
incidents.root_cause: Per-message processing in PaymentService.captureWebhook includes an expensive ML call; latency > poll interval.
incidents.resolution: Increased consumer concurrency to 8; matched topic partition count.

incidents.title: CartController.verify mishandles DST transition
incidents.description: Reports for 12 customers showed events attributed to the wrong day. CartController.verify did date arithmetic in local time then wrote UTC.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(); // system-default TZ
repo.save(new Event(now)); // saved as UTC — off by offset
incidents.root_cause: Forgot to convert to UTC before persisting. Works in dev (UTC container) but not prod (customer-local TZ).
incidents.resolution: Standardized on time.Now().UTC() and added a test with a non-UTC TZ container.

incidents.title: Stale cache in NotificationsService.send after stripe update
incidents.description: Search index refresh tied to cron every 24h missed price-update events.
incidents.root_cause: Index rebuild job cron-only; no event-driven invalidation.
incidents.resolution: Event-driven invalidation added on ConfigChanged events.

incidents.title: Stale cache in InventoryProcessor.dispatch after postgres update
incidents.description: InventoryProcessor.dispatch served stale event values for up to 120 hours after the source was updated. Cache invalidation hook was removed during a cleanup.
incidents.root_cause: Cache invalidation event listener for event was removed during a refactor.
incidents.resolution: Subscribed InventoryProcessor.dispatch to the update-event stream; TTL reduced to 5m.

incidents.title: NullPointerException in PaymentService.refund under fallback path
incidents.description: Null values on tracking.id weren't defended against PaymentService.refund's hot path. Stack traces showed up in fraud-service and fraud-service, notifications-service too because of shared request-context propagation.
incidents.root_cause: Missing null-check on tracking.id at services/payment-service/src/main/java/com/swagstore/payment/PaymentService.java:292 after a refactor removed the guarding if-block.
incidents.resolution: Added null-check at services/payment-service/src/main/java/com/swagstore/payment/PaymentService.java:292 and a unit test covering the unset-tracking.id path.

incidents.title: Token validation weakened in PaymentService.charge
incidents.description: PaymentService.charge accepted expired tokens for ~120 minutes. Clock skew leeway widened by accident.

incidents.root_cause: Leeway changed from 30s to 3600s in PaymentService.charge via a "debug fix" that was never reverted.
incidents.resolution: Reverted leeway to 30s; unit test asserts < 60s.

incidents.title: Deserialization failure in CartHandler.release after schema change
incidents.description: CartHandler.release crashed on messages from a newer producer that added a field. Jackson configured with FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=true.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
mapper.configure(FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES, true);
var msg = mapper.readValue(body, Message.class); // throws on new field
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Schema evolution rule broken: new non-optional field was added without a default.

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves fraud-service in broken state
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in FraudWorker.process already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
class Item(Base):
    ext_id = Column(String, nullable=False)  # missing after rollback
incidents.root_cause: Non-transactional DDL meant the failed migration left an orphaned column.
incidents.resolution: Added DOWN migration + test; rollout gated on migration success.

incidents.title: CatalogProcessor.release concatenates user input into SQL

val sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '$email'"
stmt.executeQuery(sql) // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: CatalogProcessor.release switched to string concatenation when a prepared-statement wrapper was deleted.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a type-safe QueryBuilder; banned raw string concat in lint rules.

incidents.title: RecommendationsResolver.execute rejects legitimate cross-origin requests

@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain

incidents.root_cause: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in RecommendationsResolver.execute missed PATCH after API migration.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on notifications-service

incidents.resolution: Rotated cert; added a synthetic monitor for days-to-expiry at 30/14/7 thresholds.

incidents.title: OrderService.cancel timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: payment-service latency went from 100ms to 4s. OrderService.cancel's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.

RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: No circuit breaker in front of payment-service — slow failures consumed all worker threads.
incidents.resolution: Enforced timeout-budget rule: client timeout < ingress timeout / 2.

incidents.title: Token validation weakened in PaymentResolver.consume

incidents.title: SQL injection protection regression in PaymentService.captureWebhook

String sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'";
stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi

incidents.title: Unknown enum value crashes UserGateway.handle
incidents.description: user-service and rabbitmq drifted on the Status enum. UserGateway.handle crashed whenever the new value was observed.
incidents.root_cause: Strict enum deserializer in UserGateway.handle has no default branch for unknown values.
incidents.resolution: Added default: return unknown() branch; emit metric on unseen enum.

incidents.title: Enum value mismatch between cart-service and s3
incidents.description: CartService.addItem received an enum value s3 had added but cart-service did not know about. Deserialization threw; requests 500'd.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: s3 added the PENDING_REVIEW status; cart-service was never updated.

incidents.title: Deserialization failure in CatalogClient.dispatch after schema change
incidents.description: CatalogClient.dispatch crashed on messages from a newer producer that added a field. Jackson configured with FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=true.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().configure(FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES, true)
val msg = mapper.readValue<Message>(body)
incidents.root_cause: CatalogClient.dispatch used strict deserialization; broke compatibility when producer added a non-nullable field.

incidents.title: UserProcessor.build silently swallows downstream failures

incidents.title: Inconsistent pagination cursor in PaymentClient.aggregate
incidents.description: Consumers of PaymentClient.aggregate paginated API saw ~0.5% of items silently skipped at page boundaries. Cursor computed from a non-unique sort key.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: PaymentClient.aggregate sorts by created_at only — non-unique; cursor-based pagination unstable.
incidents.resolution: Added id as tiebreaker to sort; cursor now stable.

incidents.title: Connection pool exhausted in search-service after SearchService.commit leak
incidents.description: Pool usage on search-service ramped linearly from 20% to 100% over 4h. SearchService.commit's error path never released the acquired connection. Once saturated, all requests blocked on pool.getConnection().
incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of SearchService.commit — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: ShippingService.createLabel mishandles DST transition
incidents.description: Scheduled job in ShippingService.createLabel fired at 01:00 local but skipped on DST-spring-forward day.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
now := time.Now() // system TZ
repo.Save(Event{Timestamp: now}) // later treated as UTC
incidents.root_cause: ShippingService.createLabel mixes LocalDateTime with Instant — implicit system-default TZ used in one branch.
incidents.resolution: Switched to Instant/UTC throughout; added lint rule banning LocalDateTime.now().

incidents.title: Timeout cascade from dynamo saturates RecommendationsService.forUser
incidents.description: dynamo latency went from 100ms to 4s. RecommendationsService.forUser's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: requests.get(url, timeout=30)  # 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: No circuit breaker in front of dynamo — slow failures consumed all worker threads.

incidents.title: Cache stampede on ShippingHandler.deserialize following cache flush
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 2400 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered order-service. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.

if p, ok := cache.Get(sku); ok { return p }
p := db.Load(sku) // no singleflight
cache.Set(sku, p)
return p
incidents.root_cause: ShippingHandler.deserialize uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped loader in singleflight.Group so duplicate in-flight misses share a single origin call.

incidents.title: Shared list default in UserService.authenticate accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Calls to UserService.authenticate started seeing data from previous calls. A default [] argument kept accumulating appends across invocations.
incidents.root_cause: Mutable default argument (e.g., items=[]) in UserService.authenticate retained state across calls.
incidents.resolution: Replaced static BUFFER with a per-request instance variable.

incidents.title: Thread leak from RecommendationsService.forUser saturates recommendations-service
incidents.description: recommendations-service goroutine count grew to 120k over 6 hours. RecommendationsService.forUser spawned a goroutine per request but never drained the blocking channel.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause: CompletableFuture in RecommendationsService.forUser is never completed on the cancellation path.
incidents.resolution: Switched to buffered channel; guaranteed drain on ctx.Done().

incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag on payment-service from PaymentService.charge bottleneck

incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }
incidents.root_cause: Consumer concurrency set to 1; topic has 8 partitions but only 1 worker thread.
incidents.resolution: Moved ML call off hot path; per-message processing now <20ms.

incidents.title: ReDoS in PaymentScheduler.handle regex triggers CPU spike
incidents.description: A crafted input of 2kB hung a worker in PaymentScheduler.handle for 30s. Regex exhibited catastrophic backtracking on nested quantifiers.

Pattern p = Pattern.compile("^(a+)+$");
p.matcher(userInput).matches(); // catastrophic
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded quantifier in email validator in PaymentScheduler.handle.
incidents.resolution: Rewrote regex with atomic groups; added timeout-guarded matcher.

incidents.title: DB lock wait timeouts on OrderService.cancel
incidents.description: Postgres reported lock_wait_timeout on the record table during peak traffic. OrderService.cancel held a row lock while calling a remote service inside the same transaction.
incidents.root_cause: OrderService.cancel performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.
incidents.resolution: Moved the external call outside the transaction; replaced with outbox pattern.

incidents.title: Unknown enum value crashes InventoryService.release
incidents.description: InventoryService.release received an enum value catalog-service had added but inventory-service did not know about. Deserialization threw; requests 500'd.

incidents.resolution: Added default: return unknown() branch; emit metric on unseen enum.

incidents.title: Deserialization failure in OrderGateway.consume after schema change
incidents.description: A Kafka producer rolled out a new field. Consumers in OrderGateway.consume broke because the schema registry was not updated.

mapper.configure(FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES, true);
var msg = mapper.readValue(body, Message.class); // throws on new field
incidents.root_cause: OrderGateway.consume used strict deserialization; broke compatibility when producer added a non-nullable field.
incidents.resolution: Gated producer rollout behind schema-registry check; made new field optional with default.

incidents.title: UserScheduler.release first-request latency crosses SLO

// no warmup queries on pod start

incidents.title: AnalyticsGateway.resolve re-entrancy produces infinite loop
incidents.description: Boot-time dependency cycle prevented analytics-service from starting for 15 minutes after deploy.

incidents.title: Variable shadowing in FraudService.evaluate overrides caller value

incidents.resolution: Renamed shadow to localUser; added lint rule flagging shadowed params.

incidents.title: RecommendationsHandler.render drops items across page boundaries
incidents.description: ORDER BY non-unique column caused page 2+ to rehash order and skip items in RecommendationsHandler.render.

incidents.resolution: Added id as tiebreaker to sort; cursor now stable.

incidents.title: CartService.checkout scaling linearly with input size

incidents.title: RecommendationsHandler.reserve first-request latency crosses SLO

incidents.title: catalog-service heap grows unbounded in CatalogScheduler.index cache
incidents.description: A cache added to CatalogScheduler.index used request IDs as keys. Entries never expired. After 36h the retained size exceeded 2 GB.
incidents.root_cause: Listener added to CatalogScheduler.index was never unregistered when the request scope ended, pinning session objects in memory.
incidents.resolution: Switched to LRU with explicit capacity; added metric cache.size for alerting.

incidents.title: Enum value mismatch between user-service and redis
incidents.description: user-service and redis drifted on the Status enum. UserService.authenticate crashed whenever the new value was observed.
incidents.root_cause: redis added the PENDING_REVIEW status; user-service was never updated.
incidents.resolution: Standardized on string-typed enums with a forward-compatible default.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in PaymentService.refund for non-UTC customers
incidents.description: Reports for 300 customers showed events attributed to the wrong day. PaymentService.refund did date arithmetic in local time then wrote UTC.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(); // system-default TZ
repo.save(new Event(now)); // saved as UTC — off by offset
incidents.root_cause: Forgot to convert to UTC before persisting. Works in dev (UTC container) but not prod (customer-local TZ).
incidents.resolution: Switched to Instant/UTC throughout; added lint rule banning LocalDateTime.now().

incidents.title: ReDoS in PaymentService.refund regex triggers CPU spike
incidents.description: A crafted input of 2kB hung a worker in PaymentService.refund for 30s. Regex exhibited catastrophic backtracking on nested quantifiers.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
Pattern p = Pattern.compile("^(a+)+$");
p.matcher(userInput).matches(); // catastrophic
incidents.root_cause: Regex `^(a+)+$` in PaymentService.refund backtracks exponentially on non-matching input.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with a linear-time parser; banned user-input regex matching.

incidents.title: Contention on shipment table blocks PaymentService.charge
incidents.description: Postgres reported lock_wait_timeout on the shipment table during peak traffic. PaymentService.charge held a row lock while calling a remote service inside the same transaction.
incidents.root_cause: Lock acquisition order inconsistent between PaymentService.charge and the batch job — produces AB/BA deadlock.
incidents.resolution: Enforced a canonical lock-acquisition order across PaymentService.charge and the batch job.

incidents.title: PaymentService.charge rejects legitimate cross-origin requests

@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in PaymentService.charge missed PATCH after API migration.
incidents.resolution: Extended allowlist to cover all swagstore.com subdomains via regex; lint-rule banning wildcards.

incidents.title: OrderService.cancel concatenates user input into SQL

stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi

incidents.title: JWT verification drift in OrderService.place

stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi

incidents.title: SearchService.query concatenates user input into SQL

incidents.title: Stale config in RecommendationsService.forUser after secret rotation

incidents.title: Unhandled null value crashes CartService.checkout requests

var region = request.getShipping().getRegion();

incidents.title: SQL injection protection regression in NotificationsResolver.apply

incidents.title: Off-by-one in InventoryService.release pagination

incidents.title: FraudService.evaluate re-entrancy produces infinite loop

incidents.title: N+1 query in UserService.authenticate blows up latency

incidents.title: PaymentService.charge drops items across page boundaries

incidents.title: CORS preflight failures on PaymentService.refund endpoint

incidents.title: Cache stampede on FraudRepository.match following cache flush

p = cache.get(sku)
if p is None:

incidents.title: Deadlock in FraudService.evaluate during high-concurrency writes
incidents.description: Two transactions acquired locks in reverse order on the reservation and related child tables, producing a classic AB/BA deadlock. Postgres aborted 800 of them per minute.

with session.begin():

    external_client.notify(row)  # network call inside txn
    session.add(row)
incidents.root_cause: Lock acquisition order inconsistent between FraudService.evaluate and the batch job — produces AB/BA deadlock.
incidents.resolution: Enforced a canonical lock-acquisition order across FraudService.evaluate and the batch job.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on user-service

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate idempotency key missing

incidents.title: Lost updates in AnalyticsResolver.deserialize under parallel load

incidents.title: CartService.checkout ignores input argument due to shadow

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves fraud-service in broken state

class Item(Base):

incidents.title: CatalogClient.render over-counts during concurrent requests

val row = repo.findById(id).get()
row.count += delta

incidents.title: OutOfMemoryError in payment-service after PaymentHandler.lookup introduces leak

incidents.resolution: Replaced with Caffeine cache (max size 10k, 10-min TTL) and added heap-usage SLO.

incidents.title: Variable shadowing in NotificationsController.index overrides caller value

incidents.title: PaymentService.captureWebhook rejects legitimate cross-origin requests

incidents.title: Cache stampede on SearchResolver.refresh following cache flush

if p, ok := cache.Get(sku); ok { return p }

incidents.root_cause: Lock acquisition order inconsistent between UserClient.emit and the batch job — produces AB/BA deadlock.
incidents.resolution: Enforced a canonical lock-acquisition order across UserClient.emit and the batch job.

incidents.title: Field typo in RecommendationsService.forUser silently drops data

incidents.root_cause: MAX_RETRIES bumped from 3 to 10 without corresponding backoff; under partial failure the amplification crossed the rate-limit threshold.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a Resilience4j retry policy with 500ms base + jitter and circuit breaker on user-service.

incidents.resolution: Wrapped UserService.authenticate in SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and added a concurrent-writer integration test.

incidents.title: OrderHandler.release re-entrancy produces infinite loop
incidents.description: A newly added call from OrderHandler.release into inventory-service triggered inventory-service to call back into order-service, which looped through OrderHandler.release again. Stack overflow after ~12 calls.
incidents.root_cause: inventory-service added a synchronous callback to OrderHandler.release, forming a cycle.
incidents.resolution: Broke cycle by introducing an event bus between order-service and inventory-service.

incidents.title: AnalyticsController.authorize timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: stripe latency went from 100ms to 4s. AnalyticsController.authorize's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: client := &http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Client timeout on stripe > ingress timeout on AnalyticsController.authorize; pool starvation guaranteed.

incidents.title: UserClient.index re-entrancy produces infinite loop
incidents.description: Boot-time dependency cycle prevented user-service from starting for 15 minutes after deploy.
incidents.root_cause: redis added a synchronous callback to UserClient.index, forming a cycle.
incidents.resolution: Broke cycle by introducing an event bus between user-service and redis.

incidents.title: CatalogGateway.authenticate idempotency key missing
incidents.description: At-least-once queue + no idempotency check in CatalogGateway.authenticate produced duplicate emails/charges/orders.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: val idemKey = UUID.randomUUID().toString() // re-created on retry
incidents.root_cause: Idempotency key generated per-attempt in CatalogGateway.authenticate instead of per-order.
incidents.resolution: Added Redis-backed dedup on messageId consumer-side.

incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag on cart-service from CartProcessor.rollback bottleneck
incidents.description: A sudden traffic surge overwhelmed the single-threaded consumer in CartProcessor.rollback; lag alerts fired within 10 minutes.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }
incidents.root_cause: Per-message processing in CartProcessor.rollback includes an expensive ML call; latency > poll interval.
incidents.resolution: Increased consumer concurrency to 8; matched topic partition count.

incidents.title: UserWorker.release rejects legitimate cross-origin requests
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach UserWorker.release endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in UserWorker.release missed PATCH after API migration.
incidents.resolution: Extended allowlist to cover all swagstore.com subdomains via regex; lint-rule banning wildcards.

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves user-service in broken state
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in UserService.authenticate already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@Column(name = "ext_id", nullable = false) // column not present after rollback
private String extId;
incidents.root_cause: Non-transactional DDL meant the failed migration left an orphaned column.
incidents.resolution: Added DOWN migration + test; rollout gated on migration success.

incidents.title: OutOfMemoryError in analytics-service after AnalyticsClient.enrich introduces leak
incidents.description: analytics-service heap usage grew linearly over 18 hours until OOM. Heap dump fingered a HashMap in AnalyticsClient.enrich with no eviction policy.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Listener added to AnalyticsClient.enrich was never unregistered when the request scope ended, pinning session objects in memory.

incidents.title: Stale cache in UserClient.reserve after rabbitmq update
incidents.description: UserClient.reserve served stale event values for up to 1500 hours after the source was updated. Cache invalidation hook was removed during a cleanup.
incidents.root_cause: Index rebuild job cron-only; no event-driven invalidation.
incidents.resolution: Subscribed UserClient.reserve to the update-event stream; TTL reduced to 5m.

incidents.title: RecommendationsService.forUser first-request latency crosses SLO
incidents.description: New pods on recommendations-service served p99 > 8s for first 60 seconds. JIT + cache warmup missing in RecommendationsService.forUser.
incidents.root_cause: No readiness-probe warmup in recommendations-service; autoscaler-added pods received traffic immediately.
incidents.resolution: Added 30s warmup phase with representative query replay on readiness probe.

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate throws NPE for partially-populated records
incidents.description: Null values on shipping.region weren't defended against UserService.authenticate's hot path. Stack traces showed up in fraud-service and downstream services too because of shared request-context propagation.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
String country = customer.billingAddress.country; // NPE when billingAddress is null
api.send(country.toUpperCase());
incidents.root_cause: Defensive null guard on shipping.region deleted as "dead code" during cleanup; turned out it was load-bearing.
incidents.resolution: Validated shipping.region at the request boundary so UserService.authenticate can safely assume non-null.

incidents.title: Stale cache in UserService.authenticate after postgres update
incidents.description: UserService.authenticate served stale event values for up to 12 hours after the source was updated. Cache invalidation hook was removed during a cleanup.
incidents.root_cause: Cache invalidation event listener for event was removed during a refactor.
incidents.resolution: Subscribed UserService.authenticate to the update-event stream; TTL reduced to 5m.

incidents.title: Log-on-log recursion in InventoryService.reserve fills disk

log.error("failed: {}", req, e);
// log appender HTTP-posts to /log which calls this very method → infinite

incidents.resolution: Added recursion detection in the appender; bounded depth 1.

incidents.title: Catch-and-log in FraudService.evaluate masks real errors
incidents.description: Exceptions from kafka in FraudService.evaluate were swallowed by a generic catch (Exception). Bug lived undetected for weeks.

incidents.resolution: Propagated failure as a domain exception; added contract test.

incidents.title: Connection pool exhausted in order-service after OrderService.place leak
incidents.description: Pool usage on order-service ramped linearly from 20% to 100% over 4h. OrderService.place's error path never released the acquired connection. Once saturated, all requests blocked on pool.getConnection().
incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of OrderService.place — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Added defer conn.Release() at top of function and instrumented acquire/release counters.

incidents.title: RecommendationsService.forUser ignores input argument due to shadow
incidents.description: Inside RecommendationsService.forUser, a local variable shadowed the argument of the same name. The caller's value was effectively ignored.

incidents.resolution: Enabled -Werror=shadow; caught two more instances in review.

incidents.title: Variable shadowing in PaymentService.captureWebhook overrides caller value
incidents.description: Linter caught a shadowed variable in PaymentService.captureWebhook that had masked a config-override path for 3 weeks.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in PaymentService.captureWebhook after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Renamed shadow to localUser; added lint rule flagging shadowed params.

incidents.title: CORS preflight failures on PaymentProcessor.persist endpoint

@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain

incidents.title: Contention on cart table blocks UserController.resolve
incidents.description: Two transactions acquired locks in reverse order on the cart and related child tables, producing a classic AB/BA deadlock. Postgres aborted 800 of them per minute.

incidents.resolution: Moved the external call outside the transaction; replaced with outbox pattern.

incidents.title: Deserialization failure in NotificationsService.send after schema change

incidents.resolution: Relaxed to FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=false; documented forward-compat expectation.

incidents.title: OrderService.place regex causes request timeout on long input

incidents.title: Deadlock in PaymentService.captureWebhook during high-concurrency writes
incidents.description: Two transactions acquired locks in reverse order on the reservation and related child tables, producing a classic AB/BA deadlock. Postgres aborted 2400 of them per minute.
incidents.root_cause: PaymentService.captureWebhook performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.
incidents.resolution: Enforced a canonical lock-acquisition order across PaymentService.captureWebhook and the batch job.

incidents.title: Unknown field crashes AnalyticsController.verify JSON parse

incidents.title: OrderService.place drops last element of batch

incidents.title: Unknown field crashes SearchWorker.dispatch JSON parse

dec := json.NewDecoder(r)
dec.DisallowUnknownFields() // breaks on producer adding field
var msg Message
dec.Decode(&msg)

incidents.title: DB connections leaking from UserService.authenticate under error paths

incidents.title: CartHandler.process TLS verification broken after CA rotation

incidents.resolution: Rotated cert; added a synthetic monitor for days-to-expiry at 30/14/7 thresholds.

incidents.title: Unhandled null value crashes InventoryService.release requests

incidents.title: AnalyticsController.reserve scaling linearly with input size

incidents.resolution: Added JPA @EntityGraph to eager-fetch the association.

incidents.title: InventoryService.reserve serves stale event after config change

incidents.title: RecommendationsService.forUser mishandles DST transition

incidents.title: Cold-start latency in RecommendationsService.forUser on recommendations-service autoscale
incidents.description: Post-deploy, cold-started instances of recommendations-service handled traffic before RecommendationsService.forUser had loaded its models.

incidents.resolution: Eager-loaded models in init; readiness probe blocks until ready.

incidents.title: payment-service not reloaded after config change

incidents.title: Log-on-log recursion in InventoryService.reserve fills disk
incidents.description: inventory-service logs grew from 50 MB/h to 50 GB/h within minutes. An appender sent logs to InventoryService.reserve, which itself logged on every call.

log.error("failed: {}", req, e);

incidents.title: order-service not reloaded after config change

incidents.title: FraudService.evaluate over-counts during concurrent requests

row = session.query(Inventory).get(id)
row.count += delta

incidents.title: OrderService.place serves stale item after config change

incidents.title: ShippingService.createLabel mishandles DST transition

repo.Save(Event{Timestamp: now}) // later treated as UTC

incidents.title: SQL injection protection regression in OrderService.place

incidents.title: Cache stampede on CartGateway.deserialize following cache flush

incidents.title: Inconsistent pagination cursor in FraudRepository.rollback

incidents.title: Lost updates in CartService.addItem under parallel load

log.error("failed: {}", req, e);

incidents.title: OrderHandler.consume idempotency key missing

incidents.title: InventoryResolver.rollback over-counts during concurrent requests

incidents.resolution: Re-added @Transactional and added @Version optimistic locking on the entity.

incidents.title: Mutable default argument causes state bleed in RecommendationsService.forUser
incidents.description: Every invocation of RecommendationsService.forUser appended to the same shared list, producing cross-call leakage.

def process(items=[]):  # shared across calls

    return items

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves fraud-service in broken state
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in FraudController.dispatch already referenced the column. Service failed to start.

class Item(Base):
    ext_id = Column(String, nullable=False)  # missing after rollback
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Non-transactional DDL meant the failed migration left an orphaned column.

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate ignores input argument due to shadow

incidents.title: Goroutine leak in InventoryService.reserve eats memory

incidents.title: Exponential backoff missing in RecommendationsWorker.rollback retry path
incidents.description: A transient postgres failure triggered RecommendationsWorker.rollback's retry loop, which fired back-to-back requests with no backoff. Load amplified 8x and postgres returned 429s for 12 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Retry loop added in commit e828438 lacks exponential backoff, amplifying transient errors into sustained load.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a Resilience4j retry policy with 500ms base + jitter and circuit breaker on postgres.

incidents.title: catalog-service not reloaded after config change
incidents.description: A secret rotation for search-service went through everywhere except catalog-service. CatalogWorker.persist continued using the old credential; auth failures started 15 minutes later.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: @Value("${api.key}") private String apiKey; // resolved once at boot

incidents.resolution: Added SIGHUP handler that reloads config.

incidents.title: Variable shadowing in InventoryService.release overrides caller value

incidents.resolution: Enabled -Werror=shadow; caught two more instances in review.

incidents.title: payment-service not reloaded after config change

incidents.title: PaymentService.captureWebhook drops items across page boundaries

incidents.title: Contention on cart table blocks OrderService.cancel

incidents.title: N+1 query in OrderService.place blows up latency

incidents.title: Deserialization failure in OrderService.cancel after schema change

mapper.configure(FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES, true);
var msg = mapper.readValue(body, Message.class); // throws on new field

incidents.title: PaymentService.captureWebhook drops items across page boundaries

incidents.title: Variable shadowing in InventoryService.reserve overrides caller value

incidents.title: Race condition in InventoryScheduler.index yields duplicate item rows

incidents.title: Catch-and-log in InventoryRepository.cache masks real errors

incidents.title: Timeout cascade from elasticsearch saturates FraudWorker.fetch

incidents.title: CartProcessor.dispatch retry loop amplifies elasticsearch load

incidents.resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms, cap 5s) in CartProcessor.dispatch.

incidents.title: Thread leak from SearchScheduler.process saturates search-service

incidents.title: cart-service not reloaded after config change

incidents.title: ReDoS in NotificationsService.send regex triggers CPU spike

var msg Message

incidents.title: JWT verification drift in CatalogWorker.enrich

incidents.title: NotificationsService.send ignores input argument due to shadow

incidents.title: PaymentScheduler.handle async callback swallows errors

incidents.root_cause: Fire-and-forget pattern in PaymentScheduler.handle with no .catch(); rejected promise unhandled.
incidents.resolution: Added await; top-level try/catch; sentry.captureException on reject.

incidents.title: Off-by-one in InventoryService.reserve pagination

incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Loop bound changed from <= to < during a refactor at services/inventory-service/src/main/java/com/swagstore/inventory/InventoryService.java:51.

incidents.title: Goroutine leak in CatalogGateway.commit eats memory
incidents.description: A thread-pool executor in CatalogGateway.commit spawned threads but its submitted tasks never completed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Unbuffered channel in CatalogGateway.commit; goroutine blocks on send when receiver exits early.

incidents.title: Retry storm from PaymentGateway.commit takes down stripe
incidents.description: When stripe started returning slow 5xx, PaymentGateway.commit retried aggressively. The retry storm starved the thread pool and cascaded to upstream callers.
incidents.root_cause: MAX_RETRIES bumped from 3 to 10 without corresponding backoff; under partial failure the amplification crossed the rate-limit threshold.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a Resilience4j retry policy with 500ms base + jitter and circuit breaker on stripe.

incidents.title: Stale config in InventoryService.release after secret rotation
incidents.description: A secret rotation for catalog-service went through everywhere except inventory-service. InventoryService.release continued using the old credential; auth failures started 15 minutes later.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: @Value("${api.key}") private String apiKey; // resolved once at boot
incidents.root_cause: Feature-flag SDK polling interval is 1 hour; InventoryService.release missed the flip.
incidents.resolution: Moved secret lookup inside the request path; fetched from Vault per-minute cache.

incidents.title: DB connections leaking from UserService.authenticate under error paths
incidents.description: Pool usage on user-service ramped linearly from 20% to 100% over 4h. UserService.authenticate's error path never released the acquired connection. Once saturated, all requests blocked on pool.getConnection().
incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of UserService.authenticate — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: NullPointerException in OrderService.cancel under replay path

incidents.root_cause: Missing null-check on config.flags at services/order-service/src/main/java/com/swagstore/order/OrderService.java:236 after a refactor removed the guarding if-block.
incidents.resolution: Re-introduced the defensive guard and annotated config.flags with @NonNull to catch regressions statically.

incidents.title: Unknown field crashes OrderService.cancel JSON parse
incidents.description: A Kafka producer rolled out a new field. Consumers in OrderService.cancel broke because the schema registry was not updated.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
mapper.configure(FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES, true);
var msg = mapper.readValue(body, Message.class); // throws on new field
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: OrderService.cancel used strict deserialization; broke compatibility when producer added a non-nullable field.

incidents.title: Retry storm from PaymentService.execute takes down s3
incidents.description: A transient s3 failure triggered PaymentService.execute's retry loop, which fired back-to-back requests with no backoff. Load amplified 8x and s3 returned 429s for 120 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: MAX_RETRIES bumped from 3 to 10 without corresponding backoff; under partial failure the amplification crossed the rate-limit threshold.
incidents.resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms, cap 5s) in PaymentService.execute.

incidents.title: NotificationsClient.validate re-entrancy produces infinite loop

incidents.root_cause: postgres added a synchronous callback to NotificationsClient.validate, forming a cycle.
incidents.resolution: Refactored to injected interface; broke the tight Spring cycle.

incidents.title: fraud-service fell behind topic by 500 messages

incidents.root_cause: Consumer concurrency set to 1; topic has 8 partitions but only 1 worker thread.
incidents.resolution: Increased consumer concurrency to 8; matched topic partition count.

incidents.title: Deserialization failure in SearchService.query after schema change

var msg Message

incidents.description: order-service consumer lag grew to 2400 messages. OrderService.cancel's per-message processing time exceeded poll interval; single-partition concurrency starved.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }
incidents.root_cause: Consumer concurrency set to 1; topic has 8 partitions but only 1 worker thread.
incidents.resolution: Increased consumer concurrency to 8; matched topic partition count.

incidents.title: CartService.checkout mishandles DST transition
incidents.description: Reports for 1500 customers showed events attributed to the wrong day. CartService.checkout did date arithmetic in local time then wrote UTC.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(); // system-default TZ
repo.save(new Event(now)); // saved as UTC — off by offset
incidents.root_cause: CartService.checkout mixes LocalDateTime with Instant — implicit system-default TZ used in one branch.
incidents.resolution: Switched to Instant/UTC throughout; added lint rule banning LocalDateTime.now().

incidents.title: FraudService.evaluate rejects legitimate cross-origin requests
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach FraudService.evaluate endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in FraudService.evaluate missed PATCH after API migration.
incidents.resolution: Extended allowlist to cover all swagstore.com subdomains via regex; lint-rule banning wildcards.

incidents.title: analytics-service heap grows unbounded in AnalyticsHandler.render cache
incidents.description: analytics-service heap usage grew linearly over 18 hours until OOM. Heap dump fingered a HashMap in AnalyticsHandler.render with no eviction policy.
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded cache in AnalyticsHandler.render — no size cap, no TTL.
incidents.resolution: Switched to LRU with explicit capacity; added metric cache.size for alerting.

incidents.title: PaymentGateway.resolve idempotency key missing
incidents.description: At-least-once queue + no idempotency check in PaymentGateway.resolve produced duplicate emails/charges/orders.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: String idemKey = UUID.randomUUID().toString(); // new per attempt
incidents.root_cause: At-least-once consumer in PaymentGateway.resolve lacks dedup on messageId.
incidents.resolution: Derived idempotency key from (orderId, attempt-bucket).

incidents.title: Cold-start latency in PaymentClient.resolve on payment-service autoscale
incidents.description: Post-deploy, cold-started instances of payment-service handled traffic before PaymentClient.resolve had loaded its models.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
// no warmup queries on pod start
@PostConstruct public void init() { /* nothing */ }
incidents.root_cause: No readiness-probe warmup in payment-service; autoscaler-added pods received traffic immediately.
incidents.resolution: Added 30s warmup phase with representative query replay on readiness probe.

incidents.title: Appender loop in InventoryService.reserve crashes inventory-service
incidents.description: inventory-service logs grew from 50 MB/h to 50 GB/h within minutes. An appender sent logs to InventoryService.reserve, which itself logged on every call.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
log.error("failed: {}", req, e);
// log appender HTTP-posts to /log which calls this very method → infinite
incidents.root_cause: Error handler logged the exception, but the log emitter itself threw the same exception.
incidents.resolution: Excluded the logging endpoint from the HTTP appender's path filter.

incidents.title: Thread leak from CartService.addItem saturates cart-service
incidents.description: A thread-pool executor in CartService.addItem spawned threads but its submitted tasks never completed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: CompletableFuture in CartService.addItem is never completed on the cancellation path.

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: Ingress requests timed out because UserService.authenticate waited the full client timeout for postgres before returning. Retries amplified it.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: No circuit breaker in front of postgres — slow failures consumed all worker threads.
incidents.resolution: Tightened postgres client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: Partial migration in InventoryService.release path after rollback
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in InventoryService.release already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@Column(name = "ext_id", nullable = false) // column not present after rollback
private String extId;
incidents.root_cause: App + schema deployed together; rollback of app didn't include DOWN migration.
incidents.resolution: Added DOWN migration + test; rollout gated on migration success.

incidents.title: Duplicate processing in FraudService.evaluate on retry
incidents.description: Clients retrying after transient errors produced duplicate side effects in FraudService.evaluate. ~120 records affected; remediation required manual refund.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: idem_key = str(uuid.uuid4())  # new every attempt
incidents.root_cause: At-least-once consumer in FraudService.evaluate lacks dedup on messageId.
incidents.resolution: Added Redis-backed dedup on messageId consumer-side.

incidents.title: Goroutine leak in AnalyticsController.enrich eats memory
incidents.description: analytics-service goroutine count grew to 120k over 6 hours. AnalyticsController.enrich spawned a goroutine per request but never drained the blocking channel.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: CompletableFuture in AnalyticsController.enrich is never completed on the cancellation path.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on user-service
incidents.description: Expired intermediate cert caused TLS handshake failures on UserService.authenticate's egress to rabbitmq. All downstream calls failed for 40 minutes.

incidents.title: order-service not reloaded after config change

incidents.offending_code_snippet: @Value("${api.key}") private String apiKey; // resolved once at boot
incidents.root_cause: OrderService.deserialize reads the secret once at boot; no refresh hook.
incidents.resolution: Moved secret lookup inside the request path; fetched from Vault per-minute cache.

incidents.title: Appender loop in PaymentService.captureWebhook crashes payment-service

log.error("failed: {}", req, e);

incidents.resolution: Excluded the logging endpoint from the HTTP appender's path filter.

incidents.title: PaymentService.lookup concatenates user input into SQL
incidents.description: A security audit flagged PaymentService.lookup for concatenating user input into a SQL query. No confirmed exploits but disclosure deadline imposed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
String sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'";
stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: PaymentService.lookup switched to string concatenation when a prepared-statement wrapper was deleted.
incidents.resolution: Reverted to PreparedStatement with ? placeholders. Added SAST gate to CI.

incidents.title: Catch-and-log in AnalyticsService.fetch masks real errors
incidents.description: Exceptions from snowflake in AnalyticsService.fetch were swallowed by a generic catch (Exception). Bug lived undetected for weeks.
incidents.root_cause: Generic catch (Exception) in AnalyticsService.fetch logged and continued instead of propagating.
incidents.resolution: Replaced generic catch with specific TransientException handling.

incidents.title: Mismatched field name in CatalogService.emit after rename

incidents.title: Token validation weakened in FraudService.evaluate

incidents.title: Log-on-log recursion in PaymentService.refund fills disk

log.error("failed: {}", req, e);

incidents.title: PII leak through CartService.checkout debug logs

var msg = mapper.readValue(body, Message.class); // throws on new field

incidents.title: PaymentService.refund idempotency key missing
incidents.description: Clients retrying after transient errors produced duplicate side effects in PaymentService.refund. ~120 records affected; remediation required manual refund.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: String idemKey = UUID.randomUUID().toString(); // new per attempt
incidents.root_cause: Idempotency key generated per-attempt in PaymentService.refund instead of per-order.

incidents.title: Stale cache in SearchService.query after catalog-service update

incidents.description: A cache added to RecommendationsHandler.aggregate used request IDs as keys. Entries never expired. After 36h the retained size exceeded 2 GB.
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded cache in RecommendationsHandler.aggregate — no size cap, no TTL.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with Caffeine cache (max size 10k, 10-min TTL) and added heap-usage SLO.

incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag on fraud-service from FraudService.evaluate bottleneck

incidents.title: Sensitive token logged in PaymentGateway.commit

incidents.offending_code_snippet: log.debug("charge req: {}", chargeRequest); // prints PAN

incidents.title: Stale config in SearchProcessor.dispatch after secret rotation

incidents.root_cause: Feature-flag SDK polling interval is 1 hour; SearchProcessor.dispatch missed the flip.

incidents.title: Shared list default in UserService.authenticate accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Every invocation of UserService.authenticate appended to the same shared list, producing cross-call leakage.

incidents.resolution: Default to None and construct a fresh list inside the function.

incidents.title: payment-service fell behind topic by 120 messages
incidents.description: payment-service consumer lag grew to 120 messages. PaymentService.refund's per-message processing time exceeded poll interval; single-partition concurrency starved.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }

incidents.title: Unknown field crashes SearchService.query JSON parse

dec := json.NewDecoder(r)

incidents.title: payment-service not reloaded after config change
incidents.description: PaymentProcessor.refresh cached the config at boot; operators rotated the flag but payment-service wasn't restarted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: @Value("${api.key}") private String apiKey; // resolved once at boot
incidents.root_cause: PaymentProcessor.refresh reads the secret once at boot; no refresh hook.
incidents.resolution: Added SIGHUP handler that reloads config.

incidents.title: OrderWorker.build TLS verification broken after CA rotation
incidents.description: A CA rotation removed an old root that our pinned truststore still listed. OrderWorker.build's inventory-service client rejected the new chain.
incidents.root_cause: Pinned truststore not updated after inventory-service rotated its CA.
incidents.resolution: Replaced pinned truststore with system default; acme-renew scheduled weekly.

incidents.title: Deadlock in NotificationsService.send during high-concurrency writes
incidents.description: Two transactions acquired locks in reverse order on the event and related child tables, producing a classic AB/BA deadlock. Postgres aborted 3800 of them per minute.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
with session.begin():
    row = session.query(Entity).with_for_update().get(id)
    external_client.notify(row)  # network call inside txn
    session.add(row)
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: NotificationsService.send performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.

incidents.title: Token validation weakened in PaymentService.validate

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits snowflake when InventoryClient.authorize cache expires

incidents.root_cause: InventoryClient.authorize uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.
incidents.resolution: Added TTL jitter ±20% and per-key lock on cache miss.

incidents.title: Thread leak from PaymentService.captureWebhook saturates payment-service
incidents.description: payment-service goroutine count grew to 120k over 6 hours. PaymentService.captureWebhook spawned a goroutine per request but never drained the blocking channel.

incidents.root_cause: Unbuffered channel in PaymentService.captureWebhook; goroutine blocks on send when receiver exits early.
incidents.resolution: Switched to virtual threads; added metric for thread count.

incidents.title: Unknown enum value crashes PaymentService.charge
incidents.description: PaymentService.charge received an enum value kafka had added but payment-service did not know about. Deserialization threw; requests 500'd.
incidents.root_cause: kafka added the PENDING_REVIEW status; payment-service was never updated.
incidents.resolution: Standardized on string-typed enums with a forward-compatible default.

incidents.title: OrderService.cancel exceeded inventory-service quota during burst
incidents.description: OrderService.cancel fan-out multiplied incoming request volume 12x into inventory-service. inventory-service returned 429s for 25 minutes. Customer-visible as slow checkouts.
incidents.root_cause: No request-coalescing in OrderService.cancel; per-sub-item calls instead of batch API.
incidents.resolution: Switched to inventory-service.call_batch(items); reduced RPS 10x.

incidents.title: InventoryService.release exceeded elasticsearch quota during burst
incidents.description: InventoryService.release fan-out multiplied incoming request volume 12x into elasticsearch. elasticsearch returned 429s for 25 minutes. Customer-visible as slow checkouts.
incidents.root_cause: Rate limit config on the client side raised from 50 to 500 rps without coordination with elasticsearch team.
incidents.resolution: Switched to elasticsearch.call_batch(items); reduced RPS 10x.

incidents.title: Circular service dependency involving PaymentController.validate
incidents.description: Boot-time dependency cycle prevented payment-service from starting for 15 minutes after deploy.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in OrderService.cancel for non-UTC customers

incidents.title: Circular service dependency involving FraudScheduler.verify

incidents.title: InventoryService.release concatenates user input into SQL

incidents.title: AnalyticsProcessor.apply first-request latency crosses SLO

incidents.title: Field typo in OrderHandler.handle silently drops data

incidents.title: PaymentService.apply regex causes request timeout on long input

incidents.title: payment-service fell behind topic by 500 messages

incidents.title: DB connections leaking from OrderService.place under error paths

incidents.title: PaymentRepository.verify mishandles DST transition

incidents.title: Variable shadowing in AnalyticsController.cache overrides caller value

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits postgres when InventoryService.reserve cache expires

incidents.title: payment-service fell behind topic by 2400 messages

incidents.title: AnalyticsWorker.cache rejects legitimate cross-origin requests

incidents.title: CartService.addItem scaling linearly with input size
incidents.description: CartService.addItem loads a collection then issues one DB call per item. With input sizes ~200, p99 crossed 8s. Evidence: trace span count scaling linearly with input size.
incidents.root_cause: Batch fetch helper removed during cleanup; CartService.addItem reverted to per-item lookup.
incidents.resolution: Added JPA @EntityGraph to eager-fetch the association.

incidents.title: Enum value mismatch between user-service and s3

incidents.title: OrderService.place first-request latency crosses SLO

incidents.root_cause: MAX_RETRIES bumped from 3 to 10 without corresponding backoff; under partial failure the amplification crossed the rate-limit threshold.
incidents.resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms, cap 5s) in UserProcessor.release.

incidents.title: CORS preflight failures on CartHandler.validate endpoint

incidents.title: Stale cache in PaymentService.refund after fraud-service update

incidents.title: Rate-limit amplification from CartProcessor.emit into user-service
incidents.description: A loop in CartProcessor.emit called user-service per sub-item. At p95 input size, quota tripped within 90 seconds.
incidents.root_cause: No request-coalescing in CartProcessor.emit; per-sub-item calls instead of batch API.
incidents.resolution: Added a token-bucket limiter at the client edge with 100 rps ceiling.

incidents.title: PaymentService.captureWebhook retry loop amplifies kafka load
incidents.description: When kafka started returning slow 5xx, PaymentService.captureWebhook retried aggressively. The retry storm starved the thread pool and cascaded to upstream callers.
incidents.root_cause: MAX_RETRIES bumped from 3 to 10 without corresponding backoff; under partial failure the amplification crossed the rate-limit threshold.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a Resilience4j retry policy with 500ms base + jitter and circuit breaker on kafka.

incidents.title: PaymentGateway.build timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: Ingress requests timed out because PaymentGateway.build waited the full client timeout for user-service before returning. Retries amplified it.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: No circuit breaker in front of user-service — slow failures consumed all worker threads.
incidents.resolution: Tightened user-service client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: analytics-service not reloaded after config change

incidents.offending_code_snippet: var apiKey = os.Getenv("API_KEY") // package init, never re-read
incidents.root_cause: AnalyticsProcessor.reserve reads the secret once at boot; no refresh hook.
incidents.resolution: Moved secret lookup inside the request path; fetched from Vault per-minute cache.

incidents.title: ReDoS in FraudService.evaluate regex triggers CPU spike
incidents.description: A crafted input of 2kB hung a worker in FraudService.evaluate for 30s. Regex exhibited catastrophic backtracking on nested quantifiers.

if re.match(r'^(a+)+$', user_input):  # ReDoS
    pass
incidents.root_cause: Regex `^(a+)+$` in FraudService.evaluate backtracks exponentially on non-matching input.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with a linear-time parser; banned user-input regex matching.

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate rejects legitimate cross-origin requests

incidents.title: FraudClient.serialize async callback swallows errors

incidents.resolution: Replaced with Caffeine cache (max size 10k, 10-min TTL) and added heap-usage SLO.

incidents.title: Enum value mismatch between search-service and catalog-service

incidents.resolution: Added default: return unknown() branch; emit metric on unseen enum.

incidents.title: CatalogHandler.fetch ignores input argument due to shadow
