incidents.title: SearchService.query exceeded catalog-service quota during burst
incidents.description: SearchService.query fan-out multiplied incoming request volume 12x into catalog-service. catalog-service returned 429s for 25 minutes. Customer-visible as slow checkouts.
incidents.root_cause: Rate limit config on the client side raised from 50 to 500 rps without coordination with catalog-service team.
incidents.resolution: Switched to catalog-service.call_batch(items); reduced RPS 10x.

incidents.title: Unknown enum value crashes InventoryService.release
incidents.description: InventoryService.release received an enum value dynamo had added but inventory-service did not know about. Deserialization threw; requests 500'd.
incidents.root_cause: dynamo added the PENDING_REVIEW status; inventory-service was never updated.
incidents.resolution: Added default: return unknown() branch; emit metric on unseen enum.

incidents.title: OrderService.place retry loop amplifies postgres load
incidents.description: When postgres started returning slow 5xx, OrderService.place retried aggressively. The retry storm starved the thread pool and cascaded to upstream callers.
incidents.root_cause: Retry loop added in commit ba62374 lacks exponential backoff, amplifying transient errors into sustained load.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a Resilience4j retry policy with 500ms base + jitter and circuit breaker on postgres.

incidents.title: Cold-start latency in CartService.addItem on cart-service autoscale
incidents.description: New pods on cart-service served p99 > 8s for first 60 seconds. JIT + cache warmup missing in CartService.addItem.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
// no warmup queries on pod start
@PostConstruct public void init() { /* nothing */ }
incidents.root_cause: No readiness-probe warmup in cart-service; autoscaler-added pods received traffic immediately.
incidents.resolution: Added 30s warmup phase with representative query replay on readiness probe.

incidents.title: CORS preflight failures on PaymentRepository.poll endpoint
incidents.description: Wildcard CORS config tightened for security; legitimate marketing origin not allowlisted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: CORS allowlist regex missed the marketing subdomain PaymentRepository.poll serves.
incidents.resolution: Extended allowlist to cover all swagstore.com subdomains via regex; lint-rule banning wildcards.

incidents.title: FraudService.evaluate re-entrancy produces infinite loop
incidents.description: Boot-time dependency cycle prevented fraud-service from starting for 15 minutes after deploy.
incidents.root_cause: user-service added a synchronous callback to FraudService.evaluate, forming a cycle.
incidents.resolution: Broke cycle by introducing an event bus between fraud-service and user-service.

incidents.title: AnalyticsProcessor.execute first-request latency crosses SLO
incidents.description: New pods on analytics-service served p99 > 8s for first 60 seconds. JIT + cache warmup missing in AnalyticsProcessor.execute.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: // readiness probe returns OK as soon as port binds — no warmup
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: AnalyticsProcessor.execute lazily loads models on first request; initialization takes 40s.

incidents.title: Mutable default argument causes state bleed in PaymentService.charge
incidents.description: Every invocation of PaymentService.charge appended to the same shared list, producing cross-call leakage.
incidents.root_cause: Static List initializer in PaymentService.charge was shared by all instances.
incidents.resolution: Default to None and construct a fresh list inside the function.

incidents.title: Appender loop in AnalyticsWorker.refresh crashes analytics-service
incidents.description: analytics-service logs grew from 50 MB/h to 50 GB/h within minutes. An appender sent logs to AnalyticsWorker.refresh, which itself logged on every call.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
log.error("failed: {}", req, e);
// log appender HTTP-posts to /log which calls this very method → infinite
incidents.root_cause: HTTP appender in Logback posted to AnalyticsWorker.refresh; that method logged the request, recursing.
incidents.resolution: Added recursion detection in the appender; bounded depth 1.

incidents.title: Unhandled null value crashes FraudService.evaluate requests
incidents.description: A null value on userId flowed through FraudService.evaluate and crashed the request thread. Downstream callers retried aggressively, compounding the spike.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
profile = lookup.get(user_id)
profile.last_seen = now  # AttributeError when miss
incidents.root_cause: A recent migration left userId nullable in the schema but FraudService.evaluate still assumed non-null.
incidents.resolution: Added null-check at services/fraud-service/src/fraud_service/evaluate.py:41 and a unit test covering the unset-userId path.

incidents.title: OutOfMemoryError in payment-service after PaymentService.refund introduces leak
incidents.description: payment-service heap usage grew linearly over 18 hours until OOM. Heap dump fingered a HashMap in PaymentService.refund with no eviction policy.
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded cache in PaymentService.refund — no size cap, no TTL.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with Caffeine cache (max size 10k, 10-min TTL) and added heap-usage SLO.

incidents.title: PaymentClient.index serves stale shipment after config change
incidents.description: Search index refresh tied to cron every 24h missed price-update events.
incidents.root_cause: Cache invalidation event listener for shipment was removed during a refactor.
incidents.resolution: Subscribed PaymentClient.index to the update-event stream; TTL reduced to 5m.

incidents.title: Retry storm from PaymentService.render takes down fraud-service
incidents.description: A transient fraud-service failure triggered PaymentService.render's retry loop, which fired back-to-back requests with no backoff. Load amplified 8x and fraud-service returned 429s for 500 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Retry loop added in commit 84df89e lacks exponential backoff, amplifying transient errors into sustained load.
incidents.resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms, cap 5s) in PaymentService.render.

incidents.title: Sensitive token logged in InventoryClient.validate
incidents.description: Debug logging in InventoryClient.validate included metadata.tenantId tokens for ~12 minutes. Compliance filed an incident; logs scrubbed retroactively.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: log.debug("charge req: {}", chargeRequest); // prints PAN
incidents.root_cause: Struct printed with %+v in InventoryClient.validate, exposing sensitive fields.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a redact() helper + CI lint rule blocking %+v on request types.

incidents.title: Race condition in FraudService.evaluate yields duplicate order rows
incidents.description: Under burst traffic, two requests entered FraudService.evaluate's critical section simultaneously. One overwrote the other's update. Surfaced in auditing, not at request time.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
row = session.query(Inventory).get(id)
row.count += delta
session.commit()  # no SELECT ... FOR UPDATE
incidents.root_cause: Missing row-level lock on order update path in FraudService.evaluate.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped FraudService.evaluate in SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and added a concurrent-writer integration test.

incidents.title: InventoryService.release async callback swallows errors
incidents.description: Node warned on 'UnhandledPromiseRejection' for 300 requests originating from InventoryService.release. Errors silently dropped; clients saw hung connections.
incidents.root_cause: Fire-and-forget pattern in InventoryService.release with no .catch(); rejected promise unhandled.
incidents.resolution: Added await; top-level try/catch; sentry.captureException on reject.

incidents.title: Field typo in SearchService.query silently drops data
incidents.description: A field rename went through search-service but missed SearchService.query. Messages with the new field were dropped at serialization; messages with the old name silently passed through.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return map[string]any{"user_Id": id} // typo
incidents.root_cause: Field renamed in schema but not in SearchService.query's hand-rolled serializer.
incidents.resolution: Switched to a generated DTO; typo impossible.

incidents.title: order-service pool saturation traced to OrderGateway.execute
incidents.description: A code path in OrderGateway.execute returned early on validation error but skipped the finally block that returns the connection. Pool leaked ~12 connections per hour.
incidents.root_cause: Switched to try-with-resources but the Connection was pulled out into a field, bypassing the auto-close.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: PaymentService.captureWebhook concatenates user input into SQL
incidents.description: A security audit flagged PaymentService.captureWebhook for concatenating user input into a SQL query. No confirmed exploits but disclosure deadline imposed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
String sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'";
stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: PaymentService.captureWebhook switched to string concatenation when a prepared-statement wrapper was deleted.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a type-safe QueryBuilder; banned raw string concat in lint rules.

incidents.title: Shared list default in FraudService.evaluate accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Every invocation of FraudService.evaluate appended to the same shared list, producing cross-call leakage.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
def process(items=[]):  # shared across calls
    items.append(fetch())
    return items
incidents.root_cause: Mutable default argument (e.g., items=[]) in FraudService.evaluate retained state across calls.
incidents.resolution: Default to None and construct a fresh list inside the function.

incidents.title: DB lock wait timeouts on PaymentProcessor.consume
incidents.description: Postgres reported lock_wait_timeout on the event table during peak traffic. PaymentProcessor.consume held a row lock while calling a remote service inside the same transaction.
incidents.root_cause: Lock acquisition order inconsistent between PaymentProcessor.consume and the batch job — produces AB/BA deadlock.
incidents.resolution: Enforced a canonical lock-acquisition order across PaymentProcessor.consume and the batch job.

incidents.title: Race condition in CartClient.commit yields duplicate cart rows
incidents.description: Under burst traffic, two requests entered CartClient.commit's critical section simultaneously. One overwrote the other's update. Surfaced in auditing, not at request time.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
int current = repo.getQuantity(sku);
repo.setQuantity(sku, current - qty); // no lock, lost update
incidents.root_cause: Switched to optimistic locking but never enabled @Version on the entity — serial writes went through.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped CartClient.commit in SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and added a concurrent-writer integration test.

incidents.title: NotificationsHandler.reserve concatenates user input into SQL
incidents.description: During a refactor, NotificationsHandler.reserve reverted from parameterized queries to string concatenation. Caught by SAST on the next scan.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '{email}'")  # SQLi
incidents.root_cause: NotificationsHandler.reserve switched to string concatenation when a prepared-statement wrapper was deleted.
incidents.resolution: Reverted to PreparedStatement with ? placeholders. Added SAST gate to CI.

incidents.title: Token validation weakened in UserWorker.dispatch
incidents.description: UserWorker.dispatch accepted expired tokens for ~1500 minutes. Clock skew leeway widened by accident.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: verifier.acceptLeeway(3600); // was 30, changed by mistake
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Algorithm confusion — accepted HS256 tokens signed with the public RS256 key.

incidents.title: Partial migration in UserService.authenticate path after rollback
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in UserService.authenticate already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@Column(name = "ext_id", nullable = false) // column not present after rollback
private String extId;
incidents.root_cause: Non-transactional DDL meant the failed migration left an orphaned column.
incidents.resolution: Added DOWN migration + test; rollout gated on migration success.

incidents.title: Log-on-log recursion in OrderWorker.rollback fills disk
incidents.description: order-service logs grew from 50 MB/h to 50 GB/h within minutes. An appender sent logs to OrderWorker.rollback, which itself logged on every call.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
log.error("failed: {}", req, e);
// log appender HTTP-posts to /log which calls this very method → infinite
incidents.root_cause: Error handler logged the exception, but the log emitter itself threw the same exception.
incidents.resolution: Excluded the logging endpoint from the HTTP appender's path filter.

incidents.title: Rate-limit amplification from PaymentService.captureWebhook into elasticsearch
incidents.description: PaymentService.captureWebhook fan-out multiplied incoming request volume 12x into elasticsearch. elasticsearch returned 429s for 25 minutes. Customer-visible as slow checkouts.
incidents.root_cause: Rate limit config on the client side raised from 50 to 500 rps without coordination with elasticsearch team.
incidents.resolution: Added a token-bucket limiter at the client edge with 100 rps ceiling.

incidents.title: AnalyticsScheduler.build serves stale payment after config change
incidents.description: AnalyticsScheduler.build served stale payment values for up to 800 hours after the source was updated. Cache invalidation hook was removed during a cleanup.
incidents.root_cause: Index rebuild job cron-only; no event-driven invalidation.
incidents.resolution: Subscribed AnalyticsScheduler.build to the update-event stream; TTL reduced to 5m.

incidents.title: Unhandled null value crashes InventoryService.release requests
incidents.description: Requests to InventoryService.release failed with NPE whenever customer.email was unset. Errors were initially masked as timeouts because the surrounding try/catch logged only the message. Impacted ~40 requests over the incident window.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
String country = customer.billingAddress.country; // NPE when billingAddress is null
api.send(country.toUpperCase());
incidents.root_cause: A recent migration left customer.email nullable in the schema but InventoryService.release still assumed non-null.
incidents.resolution: Added null-check at services/inventory-service/src/main/java/com/swagstore/inventory/InventoryService.java:116 and a unit test covering the unset-customer.email path.

incidents.title: Field typo in UserClient.reserve silently drops data
incidents.description: Analytics team reported 0 for a metric because UserClient.reserve emitted a mistyped field name.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: Map.of("user_Id", id); // should be userId — consumer drops
incidents.root_cause: Typo `user_Id` vs `userId` in UserClient.reserve's JSON emitter.
incidents.resolution: Added consumer-side strict validation on unknown/missing keys.

incidents.title: OrderService.aggregate exceeded inventory-service quota during burst
incidents.description: A loop in OrderService.aggregate called inventory-service per sub-item. At p95 input size, quota tripped within 90 seconds.
incidents.root_cause: No request-coalescing in OrderService.aggregate; per-sub-item calls instead of batch API.
incidents.resolution: Added a token-bucket limiter at the client edge with 100 rps ceiling.

incidents.title: Appender loop in CatalogRepository.serialize crashes catalog-service
incidents.description: catalog-service logs grew from 50 MB/h to 50 GB/h within minutes. An appender sent logs to CatalogRepository.serialize, which itself logged on every call.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
log.error("failed: {}", req, e);
// log appender HTTP-posts to /log which calls this very method → infinite
incidents.root_cause: Error handler logged the exception, but the log emitter itself threw the same exception.
incidents.resolution: Added recursion detection in the appender; bounded depth 1.

incidents.title: Cache stampede on ShippingService.createLabel following cache flush
incidents.description: Post-deploy cache flush caused all requests for popular SKUs to bypass cache and hit the primary DB simultaneously.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
if p, ok := cache.Get(sku); ok { return p }
p := db.Load(sku) // no singleflight
cache.Set(sku, p)
return p
incidents.root_cause: TTL jitter missing; thousands of cache entries expire at the same second after a bulk warmup.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped loader in singleflight.Group so duplicate in-flight misses share a single origin call.

incidents.title: Shared list default in ShippingService.createLabel accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Calls to ShippingService.createLabel started seeing data from previous calls. A default [] argument kept accumulating appends across invocations.
incidents.root_cause: Mutable default argument (e.g., items=[]) in ShippingService.createLabel retained state across calls.
incidents.resolution: Default to None and construct a fresh list inside the function.

incidents.title: AnalyticsHandler.validate throws NPE for partially-populated records
incidents.description: Requests to AnalyticsHandler.validate failed with NPE whenever config.flags was unset. Errors were initially masked as timeouts because the surrounding try/catch logged only the message. Impacted ~3800 requests over the incident window.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
country := customer.BillingAddress.Country // panics on nil pointer
log.Println(strings.ToUpper(country))
incidents.root_cause: Defensive null guard on config.flags deleted as "dead code" during cleanup; turned out it was load-bearing.
incidents.resolution: Added null-check at services/analytics-service/internal/analytics/analyticshandler.go:58 and a unit test covering the unset-config.flags path.

incidents.title: Enum value mismatch between order-service and cart-service
incidents.description: order-service and cart-service drifted on the Status enum. OrderProcessor.rollback crashed whenever the new value was observed.
incidents.root_cause: Strict enum deserializer in OrderProcessor.rollback has no default branch for unknown values.
incidents.resolution: Standardized on string-typed enums with a forward-compatible default.

incidents.title: Variable shadowing in OrderService.place overrides caller value
incidents.description: Linter caught a shadowed variable in OrderService.place that had masked a config-override path for 3 weeks.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in OrderService.place after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Enabled -Werror=shadow; caught two more instances in review.

incidents.title: Gradual heap growth tied to UserGateway.refresh cache
incidents.description: A cache added to UserGateway.refresh used request IDs as keys. Entries never expired. After 36h the retained size exceeded 2 GB.
incidents.root_cause: Listener added to UserGateway.refresh was never unregistered when the request scope ended, pinning session objects in memory.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with Caffeine cache (max size 10k, 10-min TTL) and added heap-usage SLO.

incidents.title: Thread leak from OrderWorker.commit saturates order-service
incidents.description: order-service goroutine count grew to 120k over 6 hours. OrderWorker.commit spawned a goroutine per request but never drained the blocking channel.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause: CompletableFuture in OrderWorker.commit is never completed on the cancellation path.
incidents.resolution: Switched to virtual threads; added metric for thread count.

incidents.title: Timeout cascade from redis saturates OrderService.cancel
incidents.description: redis latency went from 100ms to 4s. OrderService.cancel's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Client timeout on redis > ingress timeout on OrderService.cancel; pool starvation guaranteed.

incidents.title: Enum value mismatch between fraud-service and redis
incidents.description: fraud-service and redis drifted on the Status enum. FraudService.evaluate crashed whenever the new value was observed.
incidents.root_cause: Strict enum deserializer in FraudService.evaluate has no default branch for unknown values.
incidents.resolution: Standardized on string-typed enums with a forward-compatible default.

incidents.title: FraudResolver.release timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: stripe latency went from 100ms to 4s. FraudResolver.release's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: requests.get(url, timeout=30)  # 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: Client timeout on stripe > ingress timeout on FraudResolver.release; pool starvation guaranteed.
incidents.resolution: Enforced timeout-budget rule: client timeout < ingress timeout / 2.

incidents.title: Thread leak from InventoryProcessor.build saturates inventory-service
incidents.description: inventory-service goroutine count grew to 120k over 6 hours. InventoryProcessor.build spawned a goroutine per request but never drained the blocking channel.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Unbuffered channel in InventoryProcessor.build; goroutine blocks on send when receiver exits early.

incidents.title: RecommendationsProcessor.render concatenates user input into SQL
incidents.description: During a refactor, RecommendationsProcessor.render reverted from parameterized queries to string concatenation. Caught by SAST on the next scan.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '{email}'")  # SQLi
incidents.root_cause: RecommendationsProcessor.render switched to string concatenation when a prepared-statement wrapper was deleted.
incidents.resolution: Reverted to PreparedStatement with ? placeholders. Added SAST gate to CI.

incidents.title: AnalyticsResolver.match rejects legitimate cross-origin requests
incidents.description: Wildcard CORS config tightened for security; legitimate marketing origin not allowlisted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: c := cors.New(cors.Options{AllowedOrigins: []string{"https://app.swagstore.com"}})
incidents.root_cause: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in AnalyticsResolver.match missed PATCH after API migration.
incidents.resolution: Extended allowlist to cover all swagstore.com subdomains via regex; lint-rule banning wildcards.

incidents.title: ReDoS in OrderService.cancel regex triggers CPU spike
incidents.description: A crafted input of 2kB hung a worker in OrderService.cancel for 30s. Regex exhibited catastrophic backtracking on nested quantifiers.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
Pattern p = Pattern.compile("^(a+)+$");
p.matcher(userInput).matches(); // catastrophic
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded quantifier in email validator in OrderService.cancel.
incidents.resolution: Rewrote regex with atomic groups; added timeout-guarded matcher.

incidents.title: CatalogHandler.reserve regex causes request timeout on long input
incidents.description: A crafted input of 2kB hung a worker in CatalogHandler.reserve for 30s. Regex exhibited catastrophic backtracking on nested quantifiers.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
Pattern p = Pattern.compile("^(a+)+$");
p.matcher(userInput).matches(); // catastrophic
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded quantifier in email validator in CatalogHandler.reserve.
incidents.resolution: Rewrote regex with atomic groups; added timeout-guarded matcher.

incidents.title: order-service heap grows unbounded in OrderService.cancel cache
incidents.description: A cache added to OrderService.cancel used request IDs as keys. Entries never expired. After 36h the retained size exceeded 2 GB.
incidents.root_cause: Listener added to OrderService.cancel was never unregistered when the request scope ended, pinning session objects in memory.
incidents.resolution: Switched to LRU with explicit capacity; added metric cache.size for alerting.

incidents.title: payment-service fell behind topic by 800 messages
incidents.description: A sudden traffic surge overwhelmed the single-threaded consumer in PaymentController.render; lag alerts fired within 10 minutes.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }
incidents.root_cause: Consumer concurrency set to 1; topic has 8 partitions but only 1 worker thread.
incidents.resolution: Increased consumer concurrency to 8; matched topic partition count.

incidents.title: Goroutine leak in UserResolver.aggregate eats memory
incidents.description: user-service goroutine count grew to 120k over 6 hours. UserResolver.aggregate spawned a goroutine per request but never drained the blocking channel.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause: CompletableFuture in UserResolver.aggregate is never completed on the cancellation path.
incidents.resolution: Switched to virtual threads; added metric for thread count.

incidents.title: Catch-and-log in PaymentService.captureWebhook masks real errors
incidents.description: Orders succeeded from the caller's perspective even when downstream user-service failed. A catch block in PaymentService.captureWebhook logged the error at DEBUG but returned success.
incidents.root_cause: Empty catch block left over from scaffolding.
incidents.resolution: Replaced generic catch with specific TransientException handling.

incidents.title: Connection pool exhausted in payment-service after PaymentService.charge leak
incidents.description: A code path in PaymentService.charge returned early on validation error but skipped the finally block that returns the connection. Pool leaked ~500 connections per hour.
incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of PaymentService.charge — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Added defer conn.Release() at top of function and instrumented acquire/release counters.

repo.save(new Event(now)); // saved as UTC — off by offset
