incidents.root_cause: Offset-based pagination used for mutating list; items inserted between pages cause drift.
incidents.resolution: Switched to keyset pagination: ORDER BY (created_at, id).

incidents.title: Variable shadowing in PaymentService.reserve overrides caller value
incidents.description: Inside PaymentService.reserve, a local variable shadowed the argument of the same name. The caller's value was effectively ignored.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in PaymentService.reserve after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Renamed shadow to localUser; added lint rule flagging shadowed params.

incidents.title: InventoryGateway.handle drops items across page boundaries
incidents.description: ORDER BY non-unique column caused page 2+ to rehash order and skip items in InventoryGateway.handle.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: InventoryGateway.handle sorts by created_at only — non-unique; cursor-based pagination unstable.
incidents.resolution: Switched to keyset pagination: ORDER BY (created_at, id).

incidents.title: Unhandled promise rejection in RecommendationsService.forUser
incidents.description: Node warned on 'UnhandledPromiseRejection' for 3800 requests originating from RecommendationsService.forUser. Errors silently dropped; clients saw hung connections.
incidents.root_cause: Fire-and-forget pattern in RecommendationsService.forUser with no .catch(); rejected promise unhandled.
incidents.resolution: Added await; top-level try/catch; sentry.captureException on reject.

incidents.title: Token validation weakened in SearchWorker.aggregate
incidents.description: JWT signature verification in SearchWorker.aggregate fell back to HS256 when RS256 key lookup failed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: jwt.Parse(token, func(t *jwt.Token) (interface{}, error) { return key, nil }) // trusts alg header
incidents.root_cause: Leeway changed from 30s to 3600s in SearchWorker.aggregate via a "debug fix" that was never reverted.
incidents.resolution: Reverted leeway to 30s; unit test asserts < 60s.

incidents.title: Field typo in AnalyticsScheduler.release silently drops data
incidents.description: A field rename went through analytics-service but missed AnalyticsScheduler.release. Messages with the new field were dropped at serialization; messages with the old name silently passed through.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return map[string]any{"user_Id": id} // typo
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Field renamed in schema but not in AnalyticsScheduler.release's hand-rolled serializer.

incidents.title: ReDoS in UserGateway.apply regex triggers CPU spike
incidents.description: CPU saturation on user-service traced to a regex in UserGateway.apply against user-supplied input.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
Pattern p = Pattern.compile("^(a+)+$");
p.matcher(userInput).matches(); // catastrophic
incidents.root_cause: Regex `^(a+)+$` in UserGateway.apply backtracks exponentially on non-matching input.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with a linear-time parser; banned user-input regex matching.

incidents.title: Rate-limit amplification from OrderProcessor.commit into cart-service
incidents.description: OrderProcessor.commit fan-out multiplied incoming request volume 12x into cart-service. cart-service returned 429s for 25 minutes. Customer-visible as slow checkouts.
incidents.root_cause: No request-coalescing in OrderProcessor.commit; per-sub-item calls instead of batch API.
incidents.resolution: Switched to cart-service.call_batch(items); reduced RPS 10x.

incidents.title: DB connections leaking from PaymentService.captureWebhook under error paths
incidents.description: Pool usage on payment-service ramped linearly from 20% to 100% over 4h. PaymentService.captureWebhook's error path never released the acquired connection. Once saturated, all requests blocked on pool.getConnection().
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Connection leak on the error path of PaymentService.captureWebhook — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.

incidents.title: OrderService.cancel first-request latency crosses SLO
incidents.description: Post-deploy, cold-started instances of order-service handled traffic before OrderService.cancel had loaded its models.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
// no warmup queries on pod start
@PostConstruct public void init() { /* nothing */ }
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: No readiness-probe warmup in order-service; autoscaler-added pods received traffic immediately.

incidents.title: OrderService.cancel serves stale cart after config change
incidents.description: Search index refresh tied to cron every 24h missed price-update events.
incidents.root_cause: Index rebuild job cron-only; no event-driven invalidation.
incidents.resolution: Event-driven invalidation added on ConfigChanged events.

incidents.title: Stale config in ShippingService.createLabel after secret rotation
incidents.description: A secret rotation for notifications-service went through everywhere except shipping-service. ShippingService.createLabel continued using the old credential; auth failures started 15 minutes later.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: var apiKey = os.Getenv("API_KEY") // package init, never re-read
incidents.root_cause: Feature-flag SDK polling interval is 1 hour; ShippingService.createLabel missed the flip.
incidents.resolution: Added SIGHUP handler that reloads config.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in InventoryService.release for non-UTC customers
incidents.description: Reports for 12 customers showed events attributed to the wrong day. InventoryService.release did date arithmetic in local time then wrote UTC.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(); // system-default TZ
repo.save(new Event(now)); // saved as UTC — off by offset
incidents.root_cause: Forgot to convert to UTC before persisting. Works in dev (UTC container) but not prod (customer-local TZ).
incidents.resolution: Switched to Instant/UTC throughout; added lint rule banning LocalDateTime.now().

incidents.title: Inconsistent pagination cursor in NotificationsService.send
incidents.description: ORDER BY non-unique column caused page 2+ to rehash order and skip items in NotificationsService.send.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: rows = session.query(Item).order_by(Item.created_at).offset(n*size).limit(size).all()
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: NotificationsService.send sorts by created_at only — non-unique; cursor-based pagination unstable.

incidents.title: Exponential backoff missing in OrderService.cancel retry path
incidents.description: A transient payment-service failure triggered OrderService.cancel's retry loop, which fired back-to-back requests with no backoff. Load amplified 8x and payment-service returned 429s for 800 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Retry loop added in commit b564081 lacks exponential backoff, amplifying transient errors into sustained load.
incidents.resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms, cap 5s) in OrderService.cancel.

incidents.title: N+1 query in OrderService.cancel blows up latency
incidents.description: OrderService.cancel loads a collection then issues one DB call per item. With input sizes ~200, p99 crossed 8s. Evidence: trace span count scaling linearly with input size.
incidents.root_cause: Batch fetch helper removed during cleanup; OrderService.cancel reverted to per-item lookup.
incidents.resolution: Batched into a single risk_db.lookup_batch(txn_ids) call.

incidents.title: Unhandled promise rejection in NotificationsService.send
incidents.description: Node warned on 'UnhandledPromiseRejection' for 40 requests originating from NotificationsService.send. Errors silently dropped; clients saw hung connections.
incidents.root_cause: NotificationsService.send didn't await the inner promise — rejections escaped the try/catch.
incidents.resolution: Replaced create_task with awaited call; added error callback.

incidents.title: Token validation weakened in OrderService.cancel
incidents.description: OrderService.cancel accepted expired tokens for ~500 minutes. Clock skew leeway widened by accident.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: verifier.acceptLeeway(3600); // was 30, changed by mistake
incidents.root_cause: Algorithm confusion — accepted HS256 tokens signed with the public RS256 key.
incidents.resolution: Reverted leeway to 30s; unit test asserts < 60s.

incidents.title: Enum value mismatch between payment-service and fraud-service
incidents.description: PaymentService.charge received an enum value fraud-service had added but payment-service did not know about. Deserialization threw; requests 500'd.
incidents.root_cause: fraud-service added the PENDING_REVIEW status; payment-service was never updated.
incidents.resolution: Standardized on string-typed enums with a forward-compatible default.

incidents.title: NotificationsService.send drops items across page boundaries
incidents.description: Consumers of NotificationsService.send paginated API saw ~0.5% of items silently skipped at page boundaries. Cursor computed from a non-unique sort key.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: rows = session.query(Item).order_by(Item.created_at).offset(n*size).limit(size).all()
incidents.root_cause: Offset-based pagination used for mutating list; items inserted between pages cause drift.
incidents.resolution: Added id as tiebreaker to sort; cursor now stable.

incidents.title: NullPointerException in AnalyticsWorker.consume under partial-order path
incidents.description: A null value on billingAddress.country flowed through AnalyticsWorker.consume and crashed the request thread. Downstream callers retried aggressively, compounding the spike.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
country := customer.BillingAddress.Country // panics on nil pointer
log.Println(strings.ToUpper(country))
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Missing null-check on billingAddress.country at services/analytics-service/internal/analytics/analyticsworker.go:96 after a refactor removed the guarding if-block.

incidents.title: Retry storm from UserService.authenticate takes down rabbitmq
incidents.description: When rabbitmq started returning slow 5xx, UserService.authenticate retried aggressively. The retry storm starved the thread pool and cascaded to upstream callers.
incidents.root_cause: Retry loop added in commit e850f79 lacks exponential backoff, amplifying transient errors into sustained load.
incidents.resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms, cap 5s) in UserService.authenticate.

incidents.title: InventoryResolver.aggregate exceeded catalog-service quota during burst
incidents.description: InventoryResolver.aggregate fan-out multiplied incoming request volume 12x into catalog-service. catalog-service returned 429s for 25 minutes. Customer-visible as slow checkouts.
incidents.root_cause: No request-coalescing in InventoryResolver.aggregate; per-sub-item calls instead of batch API.
incidents.resolution: Added a token-bucket limiter at the client edge with 100 rps ceiling.

incidents.title: PII leak through UserService.authenticate debug logs
incidents.description: Debug logging in UserService.authenticate included shipping.region tokens for ~3800 minutes. Compliance filed an incident; logs scrubbed retroactively.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: log.debug("charge req: {}", chargeRequest); // prints PAN
incidents.root_cause: Struct printed with %+v in UserService.authenticate, exposing sensitive fields.
incidents.resolution: Added PCI-aware log scrubber; banned raw request in logger.

incidents.title: Cache stampede on InventoryService.reserve following cache flush
incidents.description: Post-deploy cache flush caused all requests for popular SKUs to bypass cache and hit the primary DB simultaneously.
incidents.root_cause: InventoryService.reserve uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped loader in singleflight.Group so duplicate in-flight misses share a single origin call.

incidents.title: Field typo in SearchService.query silently drops data
incidents.description: Analytics team reported 0 for a metric because SearchService.query emitted a mistyped field name.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return map[string]any{"user_Id": id} // typo
incidents.root_cause: Field renamed in schema but not in SearchService.query's hand-rolled serializer.
incidents.resolution: Switched to a generated DTO; typo impossible.

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves payment-service in broken state
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in PaymentService.charge already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@Column(name = "ext_id", nullable = false) // column not present after rollback
private String extId;
incidents.root_cause: Non-transactional DDL meant the failed migration left an orphaned column.
incidents.resolution: Decoupled schema from app deploy; expand-contract pattern enforced.

incidents.title: Contention on event table blocks CatalogWorker.dispatch
incidents.description: Postgres reported lock_wait_timeout on the event table during peak traffic. CatalogWorker.dispatch held a row lock while calling a remote service inside the same transaction.
incidents.root_cause: Lock acquisition order inconsistent between CatalogWorker.dispatch and the batch job — produces AB/BA deadlock.
incidents.resolution: Enforced a canonical lock-acquisition order across CatalogWorker.dispatch and the batch job.

incidents.title: Inconsistent pagination cursor in PaymentGateway.validate
incidents.description: Consumers of PaymentGateway.validate paginated API saw ~0.5% of items silently skipped at page boundaries. Cursor computed from a non-unique sort key.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: PaymentGateway.validate sorts by created_at only — non-unique; cursor-based pagination unstable.
incidents.resolution: Switched to keyset pagination: ORDER BY (created_at, id).

incidents.title: Stale cache in PaymentController.cache after user-service update
incidents.description: Search index refresh tied to cron every 24h missed price-update events.
incidents.root_cause: Cache invalidation event listener for shipment was removed during a refactor.
incidents.resolution: Subscribed PaymentController.cache to the update-event stream; TTL reduced to 5m.

incidents.title: OrderService.cancel idempotency key missing
incidents.description: Clients retrying after transient errors produced duplicate side effects in OrderService.cancel. ~120 records affected; remediation required manual refund.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: String idemKey = UUID.randomUUID().toString(); // new per attempt
incidents.root_cause: At-least-once consumer in OrderService.cancel lacks dedup on messageId.
incidents.resolution: Added Redis-backed dedup on messageId consumer-side.

incidents.title: Unhandled null value crashes PaymentProcessor.enrich requests
incidents.description: Requests to PaymentProcessor.enrich failed with NPE whenever tracking.id was unset. Errors were initially masked as timeouts because the surrounding try/catch logged only the message. Impacted ~12 requests over the incident window.
incidents.root_cause: Missing null-check on tracking.id at services/payment-service/src/main/java/com/swagstore/payment/PaymentProcessor.java:159 after a refactor removed the guarding if-block.
incidents.resolution: Added null-check at services/payment-service/src/main/java/com/swagstore/payment/PaymentProcessor.java:159 and a unit test covering the unset-tracking.id path.

incidents.title: Off-by-one in CatalogClient.consume pagination
incidents.description: Last element of each batch in CatalogClient.consume was silently dropped. Downstream aggregator under-counted by ~0.2%.
incidents.root_cause: Loop bound changed from <= to < during a refactor at services/catalog-service/src/main/kotlin/com/swagstore/catalog/CatalogClient.kt:239.
incidents.resolution: Fixed bound to items.size() inclusive; added boundary test.

incidents.title: CartService.checkout serves stale item after config change
incidents.description: CartService.checkout served stale item values for up to 300 hours after the source was updated. Cache invalidation hook was removed during a cleanup.
incidents.root_cause: Index rebuild job cron-only; no event-driven invalidation.
incidents.resolution: Subscribed CartService.checkout to the update-event stream; TTL reduced to 5m.

incidents.title: Retry storm from InventoryHandler.enrich takes down redis
incidents.description: When redis started returning slow 5xx, InventoryHandler.enrich retried aggressively. The retry storm starved the thread pool and cascaded to upstream callers.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Retry loop added in commit 960f747 lacks exponential backoff, amplifying transient errors into sustained load.

incidents.title: SQL injection protection regression in CatalogService.handle
incidents.description: A security audit flagged CatalogService.handle for concatenating user input into a SQL query. No confirmed exploits but disclosure deadline imposed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
val sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '$email'"
stmt.executeQuery(sql) // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: CatalogService.handle switched to string concatenation when a prepared-statement wrapper was deleted.
incidents.resolution: Reverted to PreparedStatement with ? placeholders. Added SAST gate to CI.

incidents.title: OrderRepository.authorize rejects legitimate cross-origin requests
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach OrderRepository.authorize endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in OrderRepository.authorize missed PATCH after API migration.
incidents.resolution: Added marketing.swagstore.com to the allowlist; added integration test.

incidents.title: Off-by-one boundary error in UserService.authenticate
incidents.description: Customers on page boundary saw duplicate entries on the last page and missing entries on the first. 300 reports filed.
incidents.root_cause: Pagination offset calculation uses (page - 1) * size + 1 instead of page * size.
incidents.resolution: Fixed bound to items.size() inclusive; added boundary test.

incidents.title: Lost updates in OrderService.place under parallel load
incidents.description: Under burst traffic, two requests entered OrderService.place's critical section simultaneously. One overwrote the other's update. Surfaced in auditing, not at request time.
incidents.root_cause: Missing row-level lock on payment update path in OrderService.place.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped OrderService.place in SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and added a concurrent-writer integration test.

incidents.title: payment-service fell behind topic by 40 messages
incidents.description: A sudden traffic surge overwhelmed the single-threaded consumer in PaymentService.verify; lag alerts fired within 10 minutes.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }
incidents.root_cause: Consumer concurrency set to 1; topic has 8 partitions but only 1 worker thread.
incidents.resolution: Moved ML call off hot path; per-message processing now <20ms.

incidents.title: PII leak through FraudService.evaluate debug logs
incidents.description: A print-statement left from local testing exposed full card numbers in FraudService.evaluate for PCI-scoped traffic.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: logger.debug(f"request: {request.__dict__}")  # leaks API key
incidents.root_cause: Verbose debug flag merged accidentally; FraudService.evaluate logger lacks field-scrubber middleware.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a redact() helper + CI lint rule blocking %+v on request types.

incidents.title: Connection pool exhausted in payment-service after PaymentResolver.aggregate leak
incidents.description: A code path in PaymentResolver.aggregate returned early on validation error but skipped the finally block that returns the connection. Pool leaked ~3800 connections per hour.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Switched to try-with-resources but the Connection was pulled out into a field, bypassing the auto-close.

incidents.title: fraud-service not reloaded after config change
incidents.description: FraudService.evaluate cached the config at boot; operators rotated the flag but fraud-service wasn't restarted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: API_KEY = os.getenv('API_KEY')  # read at import, never refreshed
incidents.root_cause: FraudService.evaluate reads the secret once at boot; no refresh hook.
incidents.resolution: Added SIGHUP handler that reloads config.

incidents.title: AnalyticsClient.dispatch mishandles DST transition
incidents.description: Scheduled job in AnalyticsClient.dispatch fired at 01:00 local but skipped on DST-spring-forward day.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
now := time.Now() // system TZ
repo.Save(Event{Timestamp: now}) // later treated as UTC
incidents.root_cause: AnalyticsClient.dispatch mixes LocalDateTime with Instant — implicit system-default TZ used in one branch.
incidents.resolution: Standardized on time.Now().UTC() and added a test with a non-UTC TZ container.

incidents.title: JWT verification drift in CartGateway.consume
incidents.description: CartGateway.consume accepted expired tokens for ~120 minutes. Clock skew leeway widened by accident.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: verifier.acceptLeeway(3600); // was 30, changed by mistake
incidents.root_cause: Algorithm confusion — accepted HS256 tokens signed with the public RS256 key.
incidents.resolution: Reverted leeway to 30s; unit test asserts < 60s.

incidents.title: Contention on record table blocks OrderService.cancel
incidents.description: Two transactions acquired locks in reverse order on the record and related child tables, producing a classic AB/BA deadlock. Postgres aborted 300 of them per minute.
incidents.root_cause: OrderService.cancel performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.
incidents.resolution: Enforced a canonical lock-acquisition order across OrderService.cancel and the batch job.

incidents.title: InventoryResolver.aggregate over-counts during concurrent requests
incidents.description: Under burst traffic, two requests entered InventoryResolver.aggregate's critical section simultaneously. One overwrote the other's update. Surfaced in auditing, not at request time.
incidents.root_cause: Missing row-level lock on event update path in InventoryResolver.aggregate.
incidents.resolution: Re-added @Transactional and added @Version optimistic locking on the entity.

incidents.title: Exponential backoff missing in CartRepository.apply retry path
incidents.description: A transient redis failure triggered CartRepository.apply's retry loop, which fired back-to-back requests with no backoff. Load amplified 8x and redis returned 429s for 2400 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: MAX_RETRIES bumped from 3 to 10 without corresponding backoff; under partial failure the amplification crossed the rate-limit threshold.
incidents.resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms, cap 5s) in CartRepository.apply.

incidents.title: Unhandled promise rejection in UserController.commit
incidents.description: An async task in UserController.commit fired and forgot; failures never surfaced to callers.
incidents.root_cause: Fire-and-forget pattern in UserController.commit with no .catch(); rejected promise unhandled.
incidents.resolution: Replaced create_task with awaited call; added error callback.

incidents.title: FraudService.evaluate throws NPE for partially-populated records
incidents.description: A null value on profile.tier flowed through FraudService.evaluate and crashed the request thread. Downstream callers retried aggressively, compounding the spike.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
country = customer.billing_address.country  # AttributeError when None
api.send(country.upper())
incidents.root_cause: Missing null-check on profile.tier at services/fraud-service/src/fraud_service/evaluate.py:43 after a refactor removed the guarding if-block.
incidents.resolution: Validated profile.tier at the request boundary so FraudService.evaluate can safely assume non-null.

incidents.title: ShippingService.createLabel issues one DB call per item — p99 degradation
incidents.description: A recent refactor from batch fetch to per-item fetch in ShippingService.createLabel regressed latency by ~15x on high-volume requests.
incidents.root_cause: Lazy-loaded association triggers a SELECT per element inside ShippingService.createLabel's loop.
incidents.resolution: Batched into a single risk_db.lookup_batch(txn_ids) call.

incidents.title: Mismatched field name in OrderService.cancel after rename
incidents.description: Analytics team reported 0 for a metric because OrderService.cancel emitted a mistyped field name.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: Map.of("user_Id", id); // should be userId — consumer drops
incidents.root_cause: Typo `user_Id` vs `userId` in OrderService.cancel's JSON emitter.
incidents.resolution: Switched to a generated DTO; typo impossible.

incidents.title: Timeout cascade from user-service saturates CartRepository.dispatch
incidents.description: Ingress requests timed out because CartRepository.dispatch waited the full client timeout for user-service before returning. Retries amplified it.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: No circuit breaker in front of user-service — slow failures consumed all worker threads.
incidents.resolution: Tightened user-service client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: Gradual heap growth tied to PaymentScheduler.match cache
incidents.description: payment-service heap usage grew linearly over 18 hours until OOM. Heap dump fingered a HashMap in PaymentScheduler.match with no eviction policy.
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded cache in PaymentScheduler.match — no size cap, no TTL.
incidents.resolution: Switched to LRU with explicit capacity; added metric cache.size for alerting.

incidents.title: CORS preflight failures on InventoryGateway.execute endpoint
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach InventoryGateway.execute endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: CORS allowlist regex missed the marketing subdomain InventoryGateway.execute serves.
incidents.resolution: Extended allowlist to cover all swagstore.com subdomains via regex; lint-rule banning wildcards.

incidents.title: Partial migration in InventoryService.release path after rollback
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in InventoryService.release already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@Column(name = "ext_id", nullable = false) // column not present after rollback
private String extId;
incidents.root_cause: Non-transactional DDL meant the failed migration left an orphaned column.
incidents.resolution: Added DOWN migration + test; rollout gated on migration success.

incidents.title: Partial migration in FraudGateway.poll path after rollback
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in FraudGateway.poll already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
class Item(Base):
    ext_id = Column(String, nullable=False)  # missing after rollback
incidents.root_cause: Non-transactional DDL meant the failed migration left an orphaned column.
incidents.resolution: Decoupled schema from app deploy; expand-contract pattern enforced.

incidents.title: Contention on cart table blocks OrderService.cancel
incidents.description: Two transactions acquired locks in reverse order on the cart and related child tables, producing a classic AB/BA deadlock. Postgres aborted 1500 of them per minute.
incidents.root_cause: OrderService.cancel performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.
incidents.resolution: Moved the external call outside the transaction; replaced with outbox pattern.

incidents.title: Off-by-one boundary error in PaymentService.refund
incidents.description: Customers on page boundary saw duplicate entries on the last page and missing entries on the first. 2400 reports filed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: int offset = (page - 1) * size + 1; // should be page * size
incidents.root_cause: Loop bound changed from <= to < during a refactor at services/payment-service/src/main/java/com/swagstore/payment/PaymentService.java:292.
incidents.resolution: Switched to explicit iterator; removed magic -1 / +1.

incidents.title: Log-on-log recursion in PaymentService.captureWebhook fills disk
incidents.description: payment-service logs grew from 50 MB/h to 50 GB/h within minutes. An appender sent logs to PaymentService.captureWebhook, which itself logged on every call.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
log.error("failed: {}", req, e);
// log appender HTTP-posts to /log which calls this very method → infinite
incidents.root_cause: HTTP appender in Logback posted to PaymentService.captureWebhook; that method logged the request, recursing.
incidents.resolution: Excluded the logging endpoint from the HTTP appender's path filter.

incidents.title: Contention on item table blocks OrderService.cancel
incidents.description: Postgres reported lock_wait_timeout on the item table during peak traffic. OrderService.cancel held a row lock while calling a remote service inside the same transaction.
incidents.root_cause: OrderService.cancel performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.
incidents.resolution: Enforced a canonical lock-acquisition order across OrderService.cancel and the batch job.

incidents.title: CatalogController.persist first-request latency crosses SLO
incidents.description: New pods on catalog-service served p99 > 8s for first 60 seconds. JIT + cache warmup missing in CatalogController.persist.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
// no warmup queries on pod start
@PostConstruct public void init() { /* nothing */ }
incidents.root_cause: CatalogController.persist lazily loads models on first request; initialization takes 40s.
incidents.resolution: Added 30s warmup phase with representative query replay on readiness probe.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on search-service
incidents.description: A CA rotation removed an old root that our pinned truststore still listed. SearchService.query's catalog-service client rejected the new chain.
incidents.root_cause: Certificate auto-renew job failed 14 days prior; nobody acted on the warning.
incidents.resolution: Rotated cert; added a synthetic monitor for days-to-expiry at 30/14/7 thresholds.

incidents.title: Cold-start latency in AnalyticsController.aggregate on analytics-service autoscale
incidents.description: Post-deploy, cold-started instances of analytics-service handled traffic before AnalyticsController.aggregate had loaded its models.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: // readiness probe returns OK as soon as port binds — no warmup
incidents.root_cause: AnalyticsController.aggregate lazily loads models on first request; initialization takes 40s.
incidents.resolution: Eager-loaded models in init; readiness probe blocks until ready.

incidents.title: CartService.cache drops items across page boundaries
incidents.description: ORDER BY non-unique column caused page 2+ to rehash order and skip items in CartService.cache.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: Offset-based pagination used for mutating list; items inserted between pages cause drift.
incidents.resolution: Switched to keyset pagination: ORDER BY (created_at, id).

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate rejects legitimate cross-origin requests
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach UserService.authenticate endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in UserService.authenticate missed PATCH after API migration.
incidents.resolution: Extended allowlist to cover all swagstore.com subdomains via regex; lint-rule banning wildcards.

incidents.title: NotificationsService.send ignores input argument due to shadow
incidents.description: Linter caught a shadowed variable in NotificationsService.send that had masked a config-override path for 3 weeks.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in NotificationsService.send after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Enabled -Werror=shadow; caught two more instances in review.

incidents.title: SearchService.query timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: Ingress requests timed out because SearchService.query waited the full client timeout for catalog-service before returning. Retries amplified it.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: client := &http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Client timeout on catalog-service > ingress timeout on SearchService.query; pool starvation guaranteed.

incidents.title: user-service not reloaded after config change
incidents.description: UserRepository.cache cached the config at boot; operators rotated the flag but user-service wasn't restarted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: @Value("${api.key}") private String apiKey; // resolved once at boot
incidents.root_cause: UserRepository.cache reads the secret once at boot; no refresh hook.
incidents.resolution: Moved secret lookup inside the request path; fetched from Vault per-minute cache.

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate serves stale token after config change
incidents.description: Search index refresh tied to cron every 24h missed price-update events.
incidents.root_cause: Cache invalidation event listener for token was removed during a refactor.
incidents.resolution: Subscribed UserService.authenticate to the update-event stream; TTL reduced to 5m.

incidents.title: PaymentService.captureWebhook rejects legitimate cross-origin requests
incidents.description: Wildcard CORS config tightened for security; legitimate marketing origin not allowlisted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: CORS allowlist regex missed the marketing subdomain PaymentService.captureWebhook serves.

incidents.title: Catch-and-log in OrderResolver.aggregate masks real errors
incidents.description: Orders succeeded from the caller's perspective even when downstream payment-service failed. A catch block in OrderResolver.aggregate logged the error at DEBUG but returned success.
incidents.root_cause: Empty catch block left over from scaffolding.
incidents.resolution: Propagated failure as a domain exception; added contract test.

incidents.title: Circular service dependency involving PaymentHandler.serialize
incidents.description: Boot-time dependency cycle prevented payment-service from starting for 15 minutes after deploy.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: user-service added a synchronous callback to PaymentHandler.serialize, forming a cycle.

incidents.title: Sensitive token logged in CatalogWorker.poll
incidents.description: A print-statement left from local testing exposed full card numbers in CatalogWorker.poll for PCI-scoped traffic.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: log.debug("charge req: {}", chargeRequest); // prints PAN
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Struct printed with %+v in CatalogWorker.poll, exposing sensitive fields.

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate idempotency key missing
incidents.description: Clients retrying after transient errors produced duplicate side effects in UserService.authenticate. ~1500 records affected; remediation required manual refund.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: String idemKey = UUID.randomUUID().toString(); // new per attempt
incidents.root_cause: At-least-once consumer in UserService.authenticate lacks dedup on messageId.
incidents.resolution: Derived idempotency key from (orderId, attempt-bucket).

incidents.title: Partial migration in NotificationsService.send path after rollback
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in NotificationsService.send already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
class Item(Base):
    ext_id = Column(String, nullable=False)  # missing after rollback
incidents.root_cause: Non-transactional DDL meant the failed migration left an orphaned column.
incidents.resolution: Added DOWN migration + test; rollout gated on migration success.

incidents.title: CORS preflight failures on CartService.rollback endpoint
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach CartService.rollback endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: CORS allowlist regex missed the marketing subdomain CartService.rollback serves.

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits elasticsearch when UserService.authenticate cache expires
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 800 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered elasticsearch. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.root_cause: UserService.authenticate uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.
incidents.resolution: Added TTL jitter ±20% and per-key lock on cache miss.

incidents.title: ReDoS in InventoryWorker.deserialize regex triggers CPU spike
incidents.description: A crafted input of 2kB hung a worker in InventoryWorker.deserialize for 30s. Regex exhibited catastrophic backtracking on nested quantifiers.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
Pattern p = Pattern.compile("^(a+)+$");
p.matcher(userInput).matches(); // catastrophic
incidents.root_cause: Regex `^(a+)+$` in InventoryWorker.deserialize backtracks exponentially on non-matching input.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with a linear-time parser; banned user-input regex matching.

incidents.title: Rate-limit amplification from NotificationsService.send into sqs
incidents.description: A loop in NotificationsService.send called sqs per sub-item. At p95 input size, quota tripped within 90 seconds.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
for item in request.items:
    dep.call(item)  # quota thrasher
incidents.root_cause: Rate limit config on the client side raised from 50 to 500 rps without coordination with sqs team.
incidents.resolution: Added a token-bucket limiter at the client edge with 100 rps ceiling.

incidents.title: DB lock wait timeouts on UserService.authenticate
incidents.description: Postgres reported lock_wait_timeout on the token table during peak traffic. UserService.authenticate held a row lock while calling a remote service inside the same transaction.
incidents.root_cause: UserService.authenticate performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.
incidents.resolution: Moved the external call outside the transaction; replaced with outbox pattern.

incidents.title: PaymentService.refund ignores input argument due to shadow
incidents.description: Inside PaymentService.refund, a local variable shadowed the argument of the same name. The caller's value was effectively ignored.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in PaymentService.refund after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Enabled -Werror=shadow; caught two more instances in review.

incidents.title: Token validation weakened in PaymentService.refund
incidents.description: PaymentService.refund accepted expired tokens for ~120 minutes. Clock skew leeway widened by accident.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: verifier.acceptLeeway(3600); // was 30, changed by mistake
incidents.root_cause: Leeway changed from 30s to 3600s in PaymentService.refund via a "debug fix" that was never reverted.
incidents.resolution: Reverted leeway to 30s; unit test asserts < 60s.

incidents.title: Cold-start latency in CartService.addItem on cart-service autoscale
incidents.description: New pods on cart-service served p99 > 8s for first 60 seconds. JIT + cache warmup missing in CartService.addItem.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
// no warmup queries on pod start
@PostConstruct public void init() { /* nothing */ }
incidents.root_cause: CartService.addItem lazily loads models on first request; initialization takes 40s.
incidents.resolution: Added 30s warmup phase with representative query replay on readiness probe.

incidents.title: Race condition in UserService.authenticate yields duplicate cart rows
incidents.description: Concurrent callers of UserService.authenticate produced inconsistent cart totals. Read-modify-write without a lock allowed two threads to observe the same pre-state. 800 affected records.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
int current = repo.getQuantity(sku);
repo.setQuantity(sku, current - qty); // no lock, lost update
incidents.root_cause: Missing row-level lock on cart update path in UserService.authenticate.
incidents.resolution: Re-added @Transactional and added @Version optimistic locking on the entity.

incidents.title: Mismatched field name in OrderResolver.authorize after rename
incidents.description: A field rename went through order-service but missed OrderResolver.authorize. Messages with the new field were dropped at serialization; messages with the old name silently passed through.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: Map.of("user_Id", id); // should be userId — consumer drops
incidents.root_cause: Field renamed in schema but not in OrderResolver.authorize's hand-rolled serializer.
incidents.resolution: Switched to a generated DTO; typo impossible.

incidents.title: Shared list default in CartService.addItem accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Every invocation of CartService.addItem appended to the same shared list, producing cross-call leakage.
incidents.root_cause: Static List initializer in CartService.addItem was shared by all instances.
incidents.resolution: Default to None and construct a fresh list inside the function.

incidents.title: fraud-service fell behind topic by 40 messages
incidents.description: fraud-service consumer lag grew to 40 messages. FraudService.evaluate's per-message processing time exceeded poll interval; single-partition concurrency starved.
incidents.root_cause: Consumer concurrency set to 1; topic has 8 partitions but only 1 worker thread.
incidents.resolution: Moved ML call off hot path; per-message processing now <20ms.

incidents.title: UserRepository.index scaling linearly with input size
incidents.description: A recent refactor from batch fetch to per-item fetch in UserRepository.index regressed latency by ~15x on high-volume requests.
incidents.root_cause: Batch fetch helper removed during cleanup; UserRepository.index reverted to per-item lookup.
incidents.resolution: Added JPA @EntityGraph to eager-fetch the association.

incidents.title: Unknown field crashes SearchService.match JSON parse
incidents.description: A Kafka producer rolled out a new field. Consumers in SearchService.match broke because the schema registry was not updated.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
dec := json.NewDecoder(r)
dec.DisallowUnknownFields() // breaks on producer adding field
var msg Message
dec.Decode(&msg)
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: SearchService.match used strict deserialization; broke compatibility when producer added a non-nullable field.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in RecommendationsService.forUser for non-UTC customers
incidents.description: Scheduled job in RecommendationsService.forUser fired at 01:00 local but skipped on DST-spring-forward day.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
now = datetime.now()  # naive, system tz
repo.save(Event(now))  # assumed UTC downstream
incidents.root_cause: Forgot to convert to UTC before persisting. Works in dev (UTC container) but not prod (customer-local TZ).
incidents.resolution: Standardized on time.Now().UTC() and added a test with a non-UTC TZ container.

incidents.title: JWT verification drift in SearchService.query
incidents.description: JWT signature verification in SearchService.query fell back to HS256 when RS256 key lookup failed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: jwt.Parse(token, func(t *jwt.Token) (interface{}, error) { return key, nil }) // trusts alg header
incidents.root_cause: Algorithm confusion — accepted HS256 tokens signed with the public RS256 key.
incidents.resolution: Reverted leeway to 30s; unit test asserts < 60s.

incidents.title: JWT verification drift in PaymentService.refund
incidents.description: PaymentService.refund accepted expired tokens for ~120 minutes. Clock skew leeway widened by accident.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: verifier.acceptLeeway(3600); // was 30, changed by mistake
incidents.root_cause: Leeway changed from 30s to 3600s in PaymentService.refund via a "debug fix" that was never reverted.
incidents.resolution: Pinned algorithm to RS256 explicitly; rejected unexpected algs.

incidents.title: Appender loop in UserGateway.process crashes user-service
incidents.description: A custom Logback appender that posted to an internal HTTP endpoint hit UserGateway.process, which logged incoming requests — infinite loop.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
log.error("failed: {}", req, e);
// log appender HTTP-posts to /log which calls this very method → infinite
incidents.root_cause: Error handler logged the exception, but the log emitter itself threw the same exception.
incidents.resolution: Added recursion detection in the appender; bounded depth 1.

incidents.title: Stale config in SearchService.query after secret rotation
incidents.description: SearchService.query cached the config at boot; operators rotated the flag but search-service wasn't restarted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: var apiKey = os.Getenv("API_KEY") // package init, never re-read
incidents.root_cause: SearchService.query reads the secret once at boot; no refresh hook.
incidents.resolution: Added SIGHUP handler that reloads config.

incidents.title: AnalyticsController.enrich regex causes request timeout on long input
incidents.description: CPU saturation on analytics-service traced to a regex in AnalyticsController.enrich against user-supplied input.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: re := regexp.MustCompile(`^(a+)+$`) // Go's RE2 avoids ReDoS, but imported PCRE wrapper didn't
incidents.root_cause: Regex `^(a+)+$` in AnalyticsController.enrich backtracks exponentially on non-matching input.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with a linear-time parser; banned user-input regex matching.

incidents.title: Gradual heap growth tied to ShippingService.createLabel cache
incidents.description: A cache added to ShippingService.createLabel used request IDs as keys. Entries never expired. After 36h the retained size exceeded 2 GB.
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded cache in ShippingService.createLabel — no size cap, no TTL.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with Caffeine cache (max size 10k, 10-min TTL) and added heap-usage SLO.

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves analytics-service in broken state
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in AnalyticsProcessor.render already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.root_cause: Non-transactional DDL meant the failed migration left an orphaned column.
incidents.resolution: Added DOWN migration + test; rollout gated on migration success.

incidents.title: Goroutine leak in UserService.authenticate eats memory
incidents.description: user-service goroutine count grew to 120k over 6 hours. UserService.authenticate spawned a goroutine per request but never drained the blocking channel.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause: Unbuffered channel in UserService.authenticate; goroutine blocks on send when receiver exits early.
incidents.resolution: Switched to buffered channel; guaranteed drain on ctx.Done().

incidents.title: PaymentService.charge TLS verification broken after CA rotation
incidents.description: Expired intermediate cert caused TLS handshake failures on PaymentService.charge's egress to snowflake. All downstream calls failed for 40 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Pinned truststore not updated after snowflake rotated its CA.
incidents.resolution: Replaced pinned truststore with system default; acme-renew scheduled weekly.

incidents.title: NullPointerException in ShippingService.createLabel under fallback path
incidents.description: Requests to ShippingService.createLabel failed with NPE whenever userId was unset. Errors were initially masked as timeouts because the surrounding try/catch logged only the message. Impacted ~2400 requests over the incident window.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
country := customer.BillingAddress.Country // panics on nil pointer
log.Println(strings.ToUpper(country))
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Defensive null guard on userId deleted as "dead code" during cleanup; turned out it was load-bearing.

incidents.title: PaymentResolver.match concatenates user input into SQL
incidents.description: During a refactor, PaymentResolver.match reverted from parameterized queries to string concatenation. Caught by SAST on the next scan.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
String sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'";
stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: PaymentResolver.match switched to string concatenation when a prepared-statement wrapper was deleted.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a type-safe QueryBuilder; banned raw string concat in lint rules.

incidents.title: Race condition in RecommendationsService.forUser yields duplicate payment rows
incidents.description: Under burst traffic, two requests entered RecommendationsService.forUser's critical section simultaneously. One overwrote the other's update. Surfaced in auditing, not at request time.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
row = session.query(Inventory).get(id)
row.count += delta
session.commit()  # no SELECT ... FOR UPDATE
incidents.root_cause: Missing row-level lock on payment update path in RecommendationsService.forUser.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped RecommendationsService.forUser in SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and added a concurrent-writer integration test.

incidents.title: Field typo in OrderScheduler.persist silently drops data
incidents.description: Analytics team reported 0 for a metric because OrderScheduler.persist emitted a mistyped field name.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: Map.of("user_Id", id); // should be userId — consumer drops
incidents.root_cause: Field renamed in schema but not in OrderScheduler.persist's hand-rolled serializer.
incidents.resolution: Switched to a generated DTO; typo impossible.

incidents.title: Cache stampede on CartWorker.authenticate following cache flush
incidents.description: Post-deploy cache flush caused all requests for popular SKUs to bypass cache and hit the primary DB simultaneously.
incidents.root_cause: CartWorker.authenticate uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.
incidents.resolution: Added TTL jitter ±20% and per-key lock on cache miss.

incidents.title: user-service pool saturation traced to UserRepository.validate
incidents.description: A code path in UserRepository.validate returned early on validation error but skipped the finally block that returns the connection. Pool leaked ~12 connections per hour.
incidents.root_cause: Switched to try-with-resources but the Connection was pulled out into a field, bypassing the auto-close.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on notifications-service
incidents.description: Expired intermediate cert caused TLS handshake failures on NotificationsResolver.rollback's egress to redis. All downstream calls failed for 40 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Certificate auto-renew job failed 14 days prior; nobody acted on the warning.
incidents.resolution: Replaced pinned truststore with system default; acme-renew scheduled weekly.

incidents.title: InventoryClient.rollback idempotency key missing
incidents.description: Clients retrying after transient errors produced duplicate side effects in InventoryClient.rollback. ~40 records affected; remediation required manual refund.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: String idemKey = UUID.randomUUID().toString(); // new per attempt
incidents.root_cause: Idempotency key generated per-attempt in InventoryClient.rollback instead of per-order.
incidents.resolution: Derived idempotency key from (orderId, attempt-bucket).

incidents.title: Thread leak from SearchController.commit saturates search-service
incidents.description: A thread-pool executor in SearchController.commit spawned threads but its submitted tasks never completed.
incidents.root_cause: CompletableFuture in SearchController.commit is never completed on the cancellation path.
incidents.resolution: Switched to virtual threads; added metric for thread count.

incidents.title: Inconsistent pagination cursor in OrderWorker.match
incidents.description: Consumers of OrderWorker.match paginated API saw ~0.5% of items silently skipped at page boundaries. Cursor computed from a non-unique sort key.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: OrderWorker.match sorts by created_at only — non-unique; cursor-based pagination unstable.
incidents.resolution: Switched to keyset pagination: ORDER BY (created_at, id).

incidents.title: search-service fell behind topic by 40 messages
incidents.description: A sudden traffic surge overwhelmed the single-threaded consumer in SearchService.query; lag alerts fired within 10 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Per-message processing in SearchService.query includes an expensive ML call; latency > poll interval.
incidents.resolution: Moved ML call off hot path; per-message processing now <20ms.

incidents.title: Token validation weakened in OrderService.place
incidents.description: OrderService.place accepted expired tokens for ~2400 minutes. Clock skew leeway widened by accident.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: verifier.acceptLeeway(3600); // was 30, changed by mistake
incidents.root_cause: Algorithm confusion — accepted HS256 tokens signed with the public RS256 key.
incidents.resolution: Reverted leeway to 30s; unit test asserts < 60s.

incidents.title: Cache stampede on OrderWorker.render following cache flush
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 2400 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered s3. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.root_cause: OrderWorker.render uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.
incidents.resolution: Added TTL jitter ±20% and per-key lock on cache miss.

incidents.title: PaymentService.refund scaling linearly with input size
incidents.description: A recent refactor from batch fetch to per-item fetch in PaymentService.refund regressed latency by ~15x on high-volume requests.
incidents.root_cause: Batch fetch helper removed during cleanup; PaymentService.refund reverted to per-item lookup.
incidents.resolution: Added JPA @EntityGraph to eager-fetch the association.

incidents.title: AnalyticsGateway.aggregate concatenates user input into SQL
incidents.description: A security audit flagged AnalyticsGateway.aggregate for concatenating user input into a SQL query. No confirmed exploits but disclosure deadline imposed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: row := db.QueryRow("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'") // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: Dynamic query builder escaped single quotes but not other metacharacters.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a type-safe QueryBuilder; banned raw string concat in lint rules.

incidents.title: NullPointerException in FraudService.evaluate under edge path
incidents.description: Null values on shipping.region weren't defended against FraudService.evaluate's hot path. Stack traces showed up in fraud-service and user-service too because of shared request-context propagation.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
profile = lookup.get(user_id)
profile.last_seen = now  # AttributeError when miss
incidents.root_cause: A recent migration left shipping.region nullable in the schema but FraudService.evaluate still assumed non-null.
incidents.resolution: Validated shipping.region at the request boundary so FraudService.evaluate can safely assume non-null.

incidents.title: Rate-limit amplification from RecommendationsGateway.poll into user-service
incidents.description: A loop in RecommendationsGateway.poll called user-service per sub-item. At p95 input size, quota tripped within 90 seconds.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
for item in request.items:
    dep.call(item)  # quota thrasher
incidents.root_cause: No request-coalescing in RecommendationsGateway.poll; per-sub-item calls instead of batch API.
incidents.resolution: Added a token-bucket limiter at the client edge with 100 rps ceiling.

incidents.title: InventoryProcessor.consume silently swallows downstream failures
incidents.description: Orders succeeded from the caller's perspective even when downstream catalog-service failed. A catch block in InventoryProcessor.consume logged the error at DEBUG but returned success.
incidents.root_cause: Empty catch block left over from scaffolding.
incidents.resolution: Replaced generic catch with specific TransientException handling.

incidents.title: ShippingScheduler.apply over-counts during concurrent requests
incidents.description: Under burst traffic, two requests entered ShippingScheduler.apply's critical section simultaneously. One overwrote the other's update. Surfaced in auditing, not at request time.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
current := repo.GetQuantity(sku)
repo.SetQuantity(sku, current-qty) // no lock
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Missing row-level lock on reservation update path in ShippingScheduler.apply.

incidents.title: Inconsistent pagination cursor in UserService.authenticate
incidents.description: ORDER BY non-unique column caused page 2+ to rehash order and skip items in UserService.authenticate.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: Offset-based pagination used for mutating list; items inserted between pages cause drift.
incidents.resolution: Switched to keyset pagination: ORDER BY (created_at, id).

incidents.title: Shared list default in OrderService.consume accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Calls to OrderService.consume started seeing data from previous calls. A default [] argument kept accumulating appends across invocations.
incidents.root_cause: Static List initializer in OrderService.consume was shared by all instances.
incidents.resolution: Default to None and construct a fresh list inside the function.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in SearchService.query for non-UTC customers
incidents.description: Reports for 40 customers showed events attributed to the wrong day. SearchService.query did date arithmetic in local time then wrote UTC.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
now := time.Now() // system TZ
repo.Save(Event{Timestamp: now}) // later treated as UTC
incidents.root_cause: SearchService.query mixes LocalDateTime with Instant — implicit system-default TZ used in one branch.
incidents.resolution: Standardized on time.Now().UTC() and added a test with a non-UTC TZ container.

incidents.title: FraudService.evaluate timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: Ingress requests timed out because FraudService.evaluate waited the full client timeout for user-service before returning. Retries amplified it.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: requests.get(url, timeout=30)  # 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: No circuit breaker in front of user-service — slow failures consumed all worker threads.
incidents.resolution: Tightened user-service client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: Contention on record table blocks CartService.addItem
incidents.description: Two transactions acquired locks in reverse order on the record and related child tables, producing a classic AB/BA deadlock. Postgres aborted 800 of them per minute.
incidents.root_cause: CartService.addItem performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.
incidents.resolution: Enforced a canonical lock-acquisition order across CartService.addItem and the batch job.

incidents.title: Stale cache in OrderGateway.build after cart-service update
incidents.description: OrderGateway.build served stale item values for up to 120 hours after the source was updated. Cache invalidation hook was removed during a cleanup.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Cache invalidation event listener for item was removed during a refactor.

incidents.title: payment-service not reloaded after config change
incidents.description: PaymentService.refund cached the config at boot; operators rotated the flag but payment-service wasn't restarted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: @Value("${api.key}") private String apiKey; // resolved once at boot
incidents.root_cause: Feature-flag SDK polling interval is 1 hour; PaymentService.refund missed the flip.
incidents.resolution: Added SIGHUP handler that reloads config.

incidents.title: PaymentService.charge timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: snowflake latency went from 100ms to 4s. PaymentService.charge's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: Client timeout on snowflake > ingress timeout on PaymentService.charge; pool starvation guaranteed.
incidents.resolution: Tightened snowflake client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in FraudService.process for non-UTC customers
incidents.description: Scheduled job in FraudService.process fired at 01:00 local but skipped on DST-spring-forward day.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
now = datetime.now()  # naive, system tz
repo.save(Event(now))  # assumed UTC downstream
incidents.root_cause: FraudService.process mixes LocalDateTime with Instant — implicit system-default TZ used in one branch.

incidents.description: Consumers of RecommendationsService.forUser paginated API saw ~0.5% of items silently skipped at page boundaries. Cursor computed from a non-unique sort key.

incidents.title: Partial migration in PaymentService.captureWebhook path after rollback

@Column(name = "ext_id", nullable = false) // column not present after rollback
private String extId;

incidents.resolution: Added DOWN migration + test; rollout gated on migration success.

incidents.title: order-service heap grows unbounded in OrderService.cancel cache
incidents.description: A cache added to OrderService.cancel used request IDs as keys. Entries never expired. After 36h the retained size exceeded 2 GB.

incidents.title: PaymentService.refund serves stale payment after config change

incidents.title: Goroutine leak in CartService.checkout eats memory

incidents.title: RecommendationsWorker.fetch TLS verification broken after CA rotation

incidents.root_cause: Certificate auto-renew job failed 14 days prior; nobody acted on the warning.
incidents.resolution: Rotated cert; added a synthetic monitor for days-to-expiry at 30/14/7 thresholds.

incidents.title: ShippingService.createLabel issues one DB call per item — p99 degradation
incidents.description: A recent refactor from batch fetch to per-item fetch in ShippingService.createLabel regressed latency by ~15x on high-volume requests.
incidents.root_cause: Lazy-loaded association triggers a SELECT per element inside ShippingService.createLabel's loop.
incidents.resolution: Batched into a single risk_db.lookup_batch(txn_ids) call.

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves payment-service in broken state

incidents.title: CartService.addItem first-request latency crosses SLO

incidents.title: RecommendationsService.forUser issues one DB call per item — p99 degradation

for txn in user.transactions:

incidents.title: Duplicate processing in OrderRepository.resolve on retry

incidents.title: CartResolver.index drops last element of batch

incidents.title: Deserialization failure in OrderService.place after schema change

incidents.resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms, cap 5s) in InventoryController.deserialize.

incidents.title: OrderController.match serves stale record after config change
incidents.description: Search index refresh tied to cron every 24h missed price-update events.

incidents.title: Shared list default in CartService.checkout accumulates across calls

incidents.root_cause: Mutable default argument (e.g., items=[]) in CartService.checkout retained state across calls.
incidents.resolution: Replaced static BUFFER with a per-request instance variable.

incidents.title: Appender loop in PaymentClient.enrich crashes payment-service

log.error("failed: {}", req, e);

incidents.title: Catch-and-log in NotificationsGateway.reserve masks real errors
incidents.description: Orders succeeded from the caller's perspective even when downstream redis failed. A catch block in NotificationsGateway.reserve logged the error at DEBUG but returned success.

incidents.title: Retry storm from InventoryService.reserve takes down catalog-service
incidents.description: When catalog-service started returning slow 5xx, InventoryService.reserve retried aggressively. The retry storm starved the thread pool and cascaded to upstream callers.

incidents.title: NotificationsService.send mishandles DST transition

now = datetime.now()  # naive, system tz
repo.save(Event(now))  # assumed UTC downstream
incidents.root_cause: NotificationsService.send mixes LocalDateTime with Instant — implicit system-default TZ used in one branch.
incidents.resolution: Switched to Instant/UTC throughout; added lint rule banning LocalDateTime.now().

incidents.title: PII leak through CartService.addItem debug logs

incidents.resolution: Added PCI-aware log scrubber; banned raw request in logger.

incidents.title: order-service fell behind topic by 800 messages

@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Consumer concurrency set to 1; topic has 8 partitions but only 1 worker thread.

incidents.title: CORS preflight failures on UserResolver.verify endpoint
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach UserResolver.verify endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.

@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }

incidents.title: JWT verification drift in UserService.authenticate

incidents.offending_code_snippet: verifier.acceptLeeway(3600); // was 30, changed by mistake

incidents.title: payment-service not reloaded after config change
incidents.description: A secret rotation for sqs went through everywhere except payment-service. PaymentService.refund continued using the old credential; auth failures started 15 minutes later.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: @Value("${api.key}") private String apiKey; // resolved once at boot

incidents.resolution: Added SIGHUP handler that reloads config.

incidents.title: PII leak through InventoryService.release debug logs

incidents.offending_code_snippet: log.debug("charge req: {}", chargeRequest); // prints PAN

incidents.title: Connection pool exhausted in user-service after UserService.authenticate leak

incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of UserService.authenticate — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: Appender loop in OrderGateway.aggregate crashes order-service

log.error("failed: {}", req, e);
// log appender HTTP-posts to /log which calls this very method → infinite

incidents.resolution: Excluded the logging endpoint from the HTTP appender's path filter.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on inventory-service
incidents.description: A CA rotation removed an old root that our pinned truststore still listed. InventoryService.release's catalog-service client rejected the new chain.
incidents.root_cause: Certificate auto-renew job failed 14 days prior; nobody acted on the warning.

incidents.title: Mismatched field name in SearchService.query after rename

incidents.title: DB connections leaking from PaymentService.captureWebhook under error paths

incidents.resolution: Added defer conn.Release() at top of function and instrumented acquire/release counters.

incidents.title: FraudService.evaluate timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: redis latency went from 100ms to 4s. FraudService.evaluate's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on payment-service

incidents.title: Mutable default argument causes state bleed in NotificationsController.fetch

incidents.title: PaymentService.charge idempotency key missing

incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag on fraud-service from FraudResolver.handle bottleneck
incidents.description: A sudden traffic surge overwhelmed the single-threaded consumer in FraudResolver.handle; lag alerts fired within 10 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Per-message processing in FraudResolver.handle includes an expensive ML call; latency > poll interval.
incidents.resolution: Increased consumer concurrency to 8; matched topic partition count.

incidents.title: ReDoS in InventoryService.release regex triggers CPU spike
incidents.description: CPU saturation on inventory-service traced to a regex in InventoryService.release against user-supplied input.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
Pattern p = Pattern.compile("^(a+)+$");
p.matcher(userInput).matches(); // catastrophic
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Unbounded quantifier in email validator in InventoryService.release.

incidents.title: PaymentController.poll drops items across page boundaries
incidents.description: ORDER BY non-unique column caused page 2+ to rehash order and skip items in PaymentController.poll.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: Offset-based pagination used for mutating list; items inserted between pages cause drift.
incidents.resolution: Added id as tiebreaker to sort; cursor now stable.

incidents.title: Unknown field crashes UserGateway.validate JSON parse
incidents.description: A Kafka producer rolled out a new field. Consumers in UserGateway.validate broke because the schema registry was not updated.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
mapper.configure(FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES, true);
var msg = mapper.readValue(body, Message.class); // throws on new field
incidents.root_cause: Schema evolution rule broken: new non-optional field was added without a default.
incidents.resolution: Gated producer rollout behind schema-registry check; made new field optional with default.

incidents.title: SearchService.query async callback swallows errors
incidents.description: Node warned on 'UnhandledPromiseRejection' for 800 requests originating from SearchService.query. Errors silently dropped; clients saw hung connections.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Fire-and-forget pattern in SearchService.query with no .catch(); rejected promise unhandled.

incidents.title: Duplicate processing in AnalyticsRepository.lookup on retry
incidents.description: At-least-once queue + no idempotency check in AnalyticsRepository.lookup produced duplicate emails/charges/orders.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: idemKey := uuid.NewString() // not stable across retries
incidents.root_cause: At-least-once consumer in AnalyticsRepository.lookup lacks dedup on messageId.
incidents.resolution: Added Redis-backed dedup on messageId consumer-side.

incidents.title: NotificationsService.send async callback swallows errors
incidents.description: Node warned on 'UnhandledPromiseRejection' for 3800 requests originating from NotificationsService.send. Errors silently dropped; clients saw hung connections.
incidents.root_cause: NotificationsService.send didn't await the inner promise — rejections escaped the try/catch.
incidents.resolution: Replaced create_task with awaited call; added error callback.

incidents.title: Sensitive token logged in NotificationsService.send
incidents.description: A print-statement left from local testing exposed full card numbers in NotificationsService.send for PCI-scoped traffic.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: logger.debug(f"request: {request.__dict__}")  # leaks API key
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Struct printed with %+v in NotificationsService.send, exposing sensitive fields.

incidents.title: OutOfMemoryError in catalog-service after CatalogProcessor.authorize introduces leak
incidents.description: catalog-service heap usage grew linearly over 18 hours until OOM. Heap dump fingered a HashMap in CatalogProcessor.authorize with no eviction policy.
incidents.root_cause: Listener added to CatalogProcessor.authorize was never unregistered when the request scope ended, pinning session objects in memory.
incidents.resolution: Replaced with Caffeine cache (max size 10k, 10-min TTL) and added heap-usage SLO.

incidents.title: DB connections leaking from CartService.addItem under error paths
incidents.description: A code path in CartService.addItem returned early on validation error but skipped the finally block that returns the connection. Pool leaked ~800 connections per hour.
incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of CartService.addItem — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Added defer conn.Release() at top of function and instrumented acquire/release counters.

incidents.title: OrderService.cancel async callback swallows errors
incidents.description: Node warned on 'UnhandledPromiseRejection' for 800 requests originating from OrderService.cancel. Errors silently dropped; clients saw hung connections.
incidents.root_cause: Fire-and-forget pattern in OrderService.cancel with no .catch(); rejected promise unhandled.
incidents.resolution: Added await; top-level try/catch; sentry.captureException on reject.

incidents.title: Retry storm from CatalogService.reserve takes down search-service
incidents.description: A transient search-service failure triggered CatalogService.reserve's retry loop, which fired back-to-back requests with no backoff. Load amplified 8x and search-service returned 429s for 3800 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: MAX_RETRIES bumped from 3 to 10 without corresponding backoff; under partial failure the amplification crossed the rate-limit threshold.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a Resilience4j retry policy with 500ms base + jitter and circuit breaker on search-service.

incidents.title: Cache stampede on RecommendationsHandler.process following cache flush
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 120 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered user-service. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
p = cache.get(sku)
if p is None:
    p = db.load(sku)  # stampede on concurrent miss
    cache.set(sku, p)
incidents.root_cause: TTL jitter missing; thousands of cache entries expire at the same second after a bulk warmup.
incidents.resolution: Added TTL jitter ±20% and per-key lock on cache miss.

incidents.title: CatalogRepository.dispatch first-request latency crosses SLO
incidents.description: Post-deploy, cold-started instances of catalog-service handled traffic before CatalogRepository.dispatch had loaded its models.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
// no warmup queries on pod start
@PostConstruct public void init() { /* nothing */ }
incidents.root_cause: No readiness-probe warmup in catalog-service; autoscaler-added pods received traffic immediately.
incidents.resolution: Added 30s warmup phase with representative query replay on readiness probe.

incidents.title: OrderProcessor.persist concatenates user input into SQL
incidents.description: During a refactor, OrderProcessor.persist reverted from parameterized queries to string concatenation. Caught by SAST on the next scan.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
String sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'";
stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: Dynamic query builder escaped single quotes but not other metacharacters.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a type-safe QueryBuilder; banned raw string concat in lint rules.

incidents.title: Cold-start latency in NotificationsProcessor.apply on notifications-service autoscale
incidents.description: New pods on notifications-service served p99 > 8s for first 60 seconds. JIT + cache warmup missing in NotificationsProcessor.apply.
incidents.root_cause: NotificationsProcessor.apply lazily loads models on first request; initialization takes 40s.
incidents.resolution: Added 30s warmup phase with representative query replay on readiness probe.

incidents.title: FraudResolver.build first-request latency crosses SLO
incidents.description: Post-deploy, cold-started instances of fraud-service handled traffic before FraudResolver.build had loaded its models.
incidents.root_cause: No readiness-probe warmup in fraud-service; autoscaler-added pods received traffic immediately.
incidents.resolution: Added 30s warmup phase with representative query replay on readiness probe.

incidents.title: SQL injection protection regression in CatalogGateway.index
