val sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '$email'"
stmt.executeQuery(sql) // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: Dynamic query builder escaped single quotes but not other metacharacters.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a type-safe QueryBuilder; banned raw string concat in lint rules.

incidents.title: NotificationsResolver.deserialize rejects legitimate cross-origin requests

incidents.root_cause: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in NotificationsResolver.deserialize missed PATCH after API migration.

incidents.title: Shared list default in PaymentScheduler.verify accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Calls to PaymentScheduler.verify started seeing data from previous calls. A default [] argument kept accumulating appends across invocations.
incidents.root_cause: Mutable default argument (e.g., items=[]) in PaymentScheduler.verify retained state across calls.
incidents.resolution: Replaced static BUFFER with a per-request instance variable.

incidents.title: Retry storm from UserService.authenticate takes down sqs
incidents.description: A transient sqs failure triggered UserService.authenticate's retry loop, which fired back-to-back requests with no backoff. Load amplified 8x and sqs returned 429s for 300 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Retry loop added in commit 9f170f6 lacks exponential backoff, amplifying transient errors into sustained load.
incidents.resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms, cap 5s) in UserService.authenticate.

incidents.title: Appender loop in AnalyticsClient.authorize crashes analytics-service
incidents.description: analytics-service logs grew from 50 MB/h to 50 GB/h within minutes. An appender sent logs to AnalyticsClient.authorize, which itself logged on every call.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
log.error("failed: {}", req, e);
// log appender HTTP-posts to /log which calls this very method → infinite
incidents.root_cause: Error handler logged the exception, but the log emitter itself threw the same exception.
incidents.resolution: Excluded the logging endpoint from the HTTP appender's path filter.

incidents.title: ReDoS in NotificationsService.send regex triggers CPU spike
incidents.description: A crafted input of 2kB hung a worker in NotificationsService.send for 30s. Regex exhibited catastrophic backtracking on nested quantifiers.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
if re.match(r'^(a+)+$', user_input):  # ReDoS
    pass
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Regex `^(a+)+$` in NotificationsService.send backtracks exponentially on non-matching input.

incidents.title: OrderWorker.consume rejects legitimate cross-origin requests
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach OrderWorker.consume endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.

@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain
@PostMapping("/api/charge") public Response charge(...) { ... }
incidents.root_cause: Access-Control-Allow-Methods in OrderWorker.consume missed PATCH after API migration.
incidents.resolution: Extended allowlist to cover all swagstore.com subdomains via regex; lint-rule banning wildcards.

incidents.title: Deserialization failure in AnalyticsService.commit after schema change
incidents.description: AnalyticsService.commit crashed on messages from a newer producer that added a field. Jackson configured with FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=true.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
dec := json.NewDecoder(r)
dec.DisallowUnknownFields() // breaks on producer adding field
var msg Message
dec.Decode(&msg)
incidents.root_cause: Schema evolution rule broken: new non-optional field was added without a default.
incidents.resolution: Relaxed to FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=false; documented forward-compat expectation.

incidents.title: Stale config in CatalogResolver.cache after secret rotation
incidents.description: A secret rotation for search-service went through everywhere except catalog-service. CatalogResolver.cache continued using the old credential; auth failures started 15 minutes later.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: @Value("${api.key}") private String apiKey; // resolved once at boot
incidents.root_cause: Feature-flag SDK polling interval is 1 hour; CatalogResolver.cache missed the flip.
incidents.resolution: Added SIGHUP handler that reloads config.

incidents.title: Unhandled promise rejection in ShippingService.createLabel
incidents.description: Node warned on 'UnhandledPromiseRejection' for 500 requests originating from ShippingService.createLabel. Errors silently dropped; clients saw hung connections.
incidents.root_cause: ShippingService.createLabel didn't await the inner promise — rejections escaped the try/catch.
incidents.resolution: Replaced create_task with awaited call; added error callback.

incidents.title: CartService.checkout over-counts during concurrent requests
incidents.description: Concurrent callers of CartService.checkout produced inconsistent event totals. Read-modify-write without a lock allowed two threads to observe the same pre-state. 1500 affected records.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
int current = repo.getQuantity(sku);
repo.setQuantity(sku, current - qty); // no lock, lost update
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: @Transactional removed from CartService.checkout during a refactor, exposing the read-modify-write race.

incidents.title: UserResolver.serialize concatenates user input into SQL
incidents.description: A security audit flagged UserResolver.serialize for concatenating user input into a SQL query. No confirmed exploits but disclosure deadline imposed.

stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: Dynamic query builder escaped single quotes but not other metacharacters.

incidents.title: Mutable default argument causes state bleed in OrderWorker.aggregate
incidents.description: Every invocation of OrderWorker.aggregate appended to the same shared list, producing cross-call leakage.
incidents.root_cause: Mutable default argument (e.g., items=[]) in OrderWorker.aggregate retained state across calls.
incidents.resolution: Replaced static BUFFER with a per-request instance variable.

incidents.title: Thread leak from PaymentService.refund saturates payment-service

incidents.offending_code_snippet: exec.submit(() -> longRunning()); // never checked; if pool is bounded, piles up
incidents.root_cause: CompletableFuture in PaymentService.refund is never completed on the cancellation path.
incidents.resolution: Switched to buffered channel; guaranteed drain on ctx.Done().

incidents.title: Sensitive token logged in InventoryService.release
incidents.description: Debug logging in InventoryService.release included shipping.region tokens for ~1500 minutes. Compliance filed an incident; logs scrubbed retroactively.

incidents.root_cause: Struct printed with %+v in InventoryService.release, exposing sensitive fields.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a redact() helper + CI lint rule blocking %+v on request types.

incidents.title: Mismatched field name in RecommendationsWorker.verify after rename

incidents.offending_code_snippet: return {"user_Id": id}  # consumer expects userId
incidents.root_cause: Typo `user_Id` vs `userId` in RecommendationsWorker.verify's JSON emitter.
incidents.resolution: Switched to a generated DTO; typo impossible.

incidents.title: Connection pool exhausted in recommendations-service after RecommendationsService.process leak
incidents.description: Pool usage on recommendations-service ramped linearly from 20% to 100% over 4h. RecommendationsService.process's error path never released the acquired connection. Once saturated, all requests blocked on pool.getConnection().
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Connection leak on the error path of RecommendationsService.process — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.

incidents.title: SearchRepository.render ignores input argument due to shadow
incidents.description: Linter caught a shadowed variable in SearchRepository.render that had masked a config-override path for 3 weeks.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in SearchRepository.render after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Renamed shadow to localUser; added lint rule flagging shadowed params.

incidents.title: Mismatched field name in CartService.addItem after rename
incidents.description: A field rename went through cart-service but missed CartService.addItem. Messages with the new field were dropped at serialization; messages with the old name silently passed through.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: Map.of("user_Id", id); // should be userId — consumer drops
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Field renamed in schema but not in CartService.addItem's hand-rolled serializer.

incidents.title: Token validation weakened in UserService.authenticate
incidents.description: JWT signature verification in UserService.authenticate fell back to HS256 when RS256 key lookup failed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: verifier.acceptLeeway(3600); // was 30, changed by mistake
incidents.root_cause: Algorithm confusion — accepted HS256 tokens signed with the public RS256 key.
incidents.resolution: Reverted leeway to 30s; unit test asserts < 60s.

incidents.title: Field typo in CatalogGateway.refresh silently drops data
incidents.description: A field rename went through catalog-service but missed CatalogGateway.refresh. Messages with the new field were dropped at serialization; messages with the old name silently passed through.

incidents.resolution: Switched to a generated DTO; typo impossible.

incidents.title: OrderClient.execute throws NPE for partially-populated records
incidents.description: A null value on shipping.region flowed through OrderClient.execute and crashed the request thread. Downstream callers retried aggressively, compounding the spike.

var region = request.getShipping().getRegion();
regionStats.increment(region); // NPE on international orders
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Defensive null guard on shipping.region deleted as "dead code" during cleanup; turned out it was load-bearing.

incidents.title: Unknown field crashes RecommendationsService.forUser JSON parse

incidents.root_cause: Schema evolution rule broken: new non-optional field was added without a default.
incidents.resolution: Relaxed to FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=false; documented forward-compat expectation.

incidents.title: InventoryHandler.lookup timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: catalog-service latency went from 100ms to 4s. InventoryHandler.lookup's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Client timeout on catalog-service > ingress timeout on InventoryHandler.lookup; pool starvation guaranteed.

incidents.title: ShippingService.createLabel idempotency key missing
incidents.description: At-least-once queue + no idempotency check in ShippingService.createLabel produced duplicate emails/charges/orders.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: idemKey := uuid.NewString() // not stable across retries
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Idempotency key generated per-attempt in ShippingService.createLabel instead of per-order.

incidents.title: Cold-start latency in PaymentService.captureWebhook on payment-service autoscale
incidents.description: New pods on payment-service served p99 > 8s for first 60 seconds. JIT + cache warmup missing in PaymentService.captureWebhook.

// no warmup queries on pod start
@PostConstruct public void init() { /* nothing */ }
incidents.root_cause: No readiness-probe warmup in payment-service; autoscaler-added pods received traffic immediately.
incidents.resolution: Added 30s warmup phase with representative query replay on readiness probe.

incidents.title: Exponential backoff missing in UserService.authenticate retry path
incidents.description: When rabbitmq started returning slow 5xx, UserService.authenticate retried aggressively. The retry storm starved the thread pool and cascaded to upstream callers.
incidents.root_cause: MAX_RETRIES bumped from 3 to 10 without corresponding backoff; under partial failure the amplification crossed the rate-limit threshold.
incidents.resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms, cap 5s) in UserService.authenticate.

incidents.title: InventoryService.reserve exceeded kafka quota during burst
incidents.description: A loop in InventoryService.reserve called kafka per sub-item. At p95 input size, quota tripped within 90 seconds.
incidents.root_cause: Rate limit config on the client side raised from 50 to 500 rps without coordination with kafka team.
incidents.resolution: Switched to kafka.call_batch(items); reduced RPS 10x.

incidents.title: ReDoS in FraudService.execute regex triggers CPU spike
incidents.description: CPU saturation on fraud-service traced to a regex in FraudService.execute against user-supplied input.

if re.match(r'^(a+)+$', user_input):  # ReDoS
    pass

incidents.title: AnalyticsHandler.apply timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: Ingress requests timed out because AnalyticsHandler.apply waited the full client timeout for s3 before returning. Retries amplified it.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: client := &http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}
incidents.root_cause: Client timeout on s3 > ingress timeout on AnalyticsHandler.apply; pool starvation guaranteed.
incidents.resolution: Enforced timeout-budget rule: client timeout < ingress timeout / 2.

incidents.title: Thread leak from RecommendationsService.forUser saturates recommendations-service

incidents.title: Deadlock in CatalogScheduler.serialize during high-concurrency writes
incidents.description: Two transactions acquired locks in reverse order on the order and related child tables, producing a classic AB/BA deadlock. Postgres aborted 2400 of them per minute.
incidents.root_cause: CatalogScheduler.serialize performs a network call inside the transaction boundary, holding locks far longer than needed.
incidents.resolution: Moved the external call outside the transaction; replaced with outbox pattern.

incidents.title: PaymentService.release rejects legitimate cross-origin requests
incidents.description: Wildcard CORS config tightened for security; legitimate marketing origin not allowlisted.

incidents.title: Rate-limit amplification from OrderService.place into payment-service
incidents.description: OrderService.place fan-out multiplied incoming request volume 12x into payment-service. payment-service returned 429s for 25 minutes. Customer-visible as slow checkouts.

incidents.title: CORS preflight failures on OrderService.place endpoint

@CrossOrigin(origins = "https://app.swagstore.com") // missed marketing subdomain

incidents.title: PaymentResolver.execute TLS verification broken after CA rotation

incidents.root_cause: Certificate auto-renew job failed 14 days prior; nobody acted on the warning.
incidents.resolution: Replaced pinned truststore with system default; acme-renew scheduled weekly.

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves order-service in broken state

incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: App + schema deployed together; rollback of app didn't include DOWN migration.

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits stripe when PaymentScheduler.reserve cache expires
incidents.description: Post-deploy cache flush caused all requests for popular SKUs to bypass cache and hit the primary DB simultaneously.
incidents.root_cause: PaymentScheduler.reserve uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.
incidents.resolution: Added TTL jitter ±20% and per-key lock on cache miss.

incidents.title: ShippingService.createLabel issues one DB call per item — p99 degradation
incidents.description: A recent refactor from batch fetch to per-item fetch in ShippingService.createLabel regressed latency by ~15x on high-volume requests.

incidents.resolution: Added JPA @EntityGraph to eager-fetch the association.

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in ShippingClient.apply for non-UTC customers

now := time.Now() // system TZ
repo.Save(Event{Timestamp: now}) // later treated as UTC
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Forgot to convert to UTC before persisting. Works in dev (UTC container) but not prod (customer-local TZ).

incidents.title: Appender loop in PaymentService.captureWebhook crashes payment-service
incidents.description: A custom Logback appender that posted to an internal HTTP endpoint hit PaymentService.captureWebhook, which logged incoming requests — infinite loop.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
log.error("failed: {}", req, e);
// log appender HTTP-posts to /log which calls this very method → infinite
incidents.root_cause: HTTP appender in Logback posted to PaymentService.captureWebhook; that method logged the request, recursing.
incidents.resolution: Excluded the logging endpoint from the HTTP appender's path filter.

incidents.title: JWT verification drift in CatalogController.commit
incidents.description: JWT signature verification in CatalogController.commit fell back to HS256 when RS256 key lookup failed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: JWT.require(algorithm).acceptLeeway(3600).build() // too permissive

incidents.title: Partial migration in RecommendationsService.forUser path after rollback
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in RecommendationsService.forUser already referenced the column. Service failed to start.

incidents.description: Boot-time dependency cycle prevented payment-service from starting for 15 minutes after deploy.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: elasticsearch added a synchronous callback to PaymentService.refund, forming a cycle.

RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: Client timeout on user-service > ingress timeout on CartResolver.render; pool starvation guaranteed.
incidents.resolution: Tightened user-service client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: Stale config in AnalyticsWorker.dispatch after secret rotation
incidents.description: A secret rotation for postgres went through everywhere except analytics-service. AnalyticsWorker.dispatch continued using the old credential; auth failures started 15 minutes later.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: var apiKey = os.Getenv("API_KEY") // package init, never re-read
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Feature-flag SDK polling interval is 1 hour; AnalyticsWorker.dispatch missed the flip.

incidents.title: Shared list default in InventoryWorker.lookup accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Every invocation of InventoryWorker.lookup appended to the same shared list, producing cross-call leakage.
incidents.root_cause: Mutable default argument (e.g., items=[]) in InventoryWorker.lookup retained state across calls.
incidents.resolution: Default to None and construct a fresh list inside the function.

incidents.title: InventoryScheduler.emit drops items across page boundaries
incidents.description: Consumers of InventoryScheduler.emit paginated API saw ~0.5% of items silently skipped at page boundaries. Cursor computed from a non-unique sort key.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: InventoryScheduler.emit sorts by created_at only — non-unique; cursor-based pagination unstable.
incidents.resolution: Switched to keyset pagination: ORDER BY (created_at, id).

incidents.title: Deadlock in CartHandler.dispatch during high-concurrency writes
incidents.description: Postgres reported lock_wait_timeout on the item table during peak traffic. CartHandler.dispatch held a row lock while calling a remote service inside the same transaction.
incidents.root_cause: Lock acquisition order inconsistent between CartHandler.dispatch and the batch job — produces AB/BA deadlock.
incidents.resolution: Moved the external call outside the transaction; replaced with outbox pattern.

incidents.title: AnalyticsService.index mishandles DST transition
incidents.description: Scheduled job in AnalyticsService.index fired at 01:00 local but skipped on DST-spring-forward day.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
now := time.Now() // system TZ
repo.Save(Event{Timestamp: now}) // later treated as UTC
incidents.root_cause: Forgot to convert to UTC before persisting. Works in dev (UTC container) but not prod (customer-local TZ).
incidents.resolution: Switched to Instant/UTC throughout; added lint rule banning LocalDateTime.now().

incidents.title: NullPointerException in InventoryService.reserve under fallback path
incidents.description: Null values on userId weren't defended against InventoryService.reserve's hot path. Stack traces showed up in fraud-service and catalog-service too because of shared request-context propagation.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
var region = request.getShipping().getRegion();
regionStats.increment(region); // NPE on international orders
incidents.root_cause: Missing null-check on userId at services/inventory-service/src/main/java/com/swagstore/inventory/InventoryService.java:58 after a refactor removed the guarding if-block.
incidents.resolution: Validated userId at the request boundary so InventoryService.reserve can safely assume non-null.

incidents.title: CORS preflight failures on ShippingService.enrich endpoint
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach ShippingService.enrich endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: c := cors.New(cors.Options{AllowedOrigins: []string{"https://app.swagstore.com"}})
incidents.root_cause: CORS allowlist regex missed the marketing subdomain ShippingService.enrich serves.
incidents.resolution: Extended allowlist to cover all swagstore.com subdomains via regex; lint-rule banning wildcards.

incidents.title: Shared list default in FraudService.evaluate accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Every invocation of FraudService.evaluate appended to the same shared list, producing cross-call leakage.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
def process(items=[]):  # shared across calls
    items.append(fetch())
    return items
incidents.root_cause: Static List initializer in FraudService.evaluate was shared by all instances.
incidents.resolution: Default to None and construct a fresh list inside the function.

incidents.title: FraudWorker.verify concatenates user input into SQL
incidents.description: A security audit flagged FraudWorker.verify for concatenating user input into a SQL query. No confirmed exploits but disclosure deadline imposed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '{email}'")  # SQLi
incidents.root_cause: Dynamic query builder escaped single quotes but not other metacharacters.
incidents.resolution: Reverted to PreparedStatement with ? placeholders. Added SAST gate to CI.

incidents.title: Connection pool exhausted in shipping-service after ShippingWorker.enrich leak
incidents.description: A code path in ShippingWorker.enrich returned early on validation error but skipped the finally block that returns the connection. Pool leaked ~2400 connections per hour.
incidents.root_cause: Switched to try-with-resources but the Connection was pulled out into a field, bypassing the auto-close.
incidents.resolution: Added defer conn.Release() at top of function and instrumented acquire/release counters.

incidents.title: Cold-start latency in UserService.authenticate on user-service autoscale
incidents.description: New pods on user-service served p99 > 8s for first 60 seconds. JIT + cache warmup missing in UserService.authenticate.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
// no warmup queries on pod start
@PostConstruct public void init() { /* nothing */ }
incidents.root_cause: UserService.authenticate lazily loads models on first request; initialization takes 40s.
incidents.resolution: Added 30s warmup phase with representative query replay on readiness probe.

incidents.title: OrderService.cancel drops last element of batch
incidents.description: Customers on page boundary saw duplicate entries on the last page and missing entries on the first. 40 reports filed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: int offset = (page - 1) * size + 1; // should be page * size
incidents.root_cause: Pagination offset calculation uses (page - 1) * size + 1 instead of page * size.
incidents.resolution: Switched to explicit iterator; removed magic -1 / +1.

incidents.title: Log-on-log recursion in UserService.authenticate fills disk
incidents.description: A custom Logback appender that posted to an internal HTTP endpoint hit UserService.authenticate, which logged incoming requests — infinite loop.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
log.error("failed: {}", req, e);
// log appender HTTP-posts to /log which calls this very method → infinite
incidents.root_cause: Error handler logged the exception, but the log emitter itself threw the same exception.
incidents.resolution: Added recursion detection in the appender; bounded depth 1.

incidents.title: Timeout cascade from postgres saturates UserHandler.validate
incidents.description: postgres latency went from 100ms to 4s. UserHandler.validate's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: No circuit breaker in front of postgres — slow failures consumed all worker threads.
incidents.resolution: Tightened postgres client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: PaymentService.charge drops items across page boundaries
incidents.description: Consumers of PaymentService.charge paginated API saw ~0.5% of items silently skipped at page boundaries. Cursor computed from a non-unique sort key.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: return repo.findAll(Sort.by("createdAt")).page(n, size);
incidents.root_cause: PaymentService.charge sorts by created_at only — non-unique; cursor-based pagination unstable.
incidents.resolution: Switched to keyset pagination: ORDER BY (created_at, id).

incidents.title: InventoryService.reserve over-counts during concurrent requests
incidents.description: Under burst traffic, two requests entered InventoryService.reserve's critical section simultaneously. One overwrote the other's update. Surfaced in auditing, not at request time.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
int current = repo.getQuantity(sku);
repo.setQuantity(sku, current - qty); // no lock, lost update
incidents.root_cause: @Transactional removed from InventoryService.reserve during a refactor, exposing the read-modify-write race.
incidents.resolution: Re-added @Transactional and added @Version optimistic locking on the entity.

incidents.title: Mismatched field name in PaymentResolver.refresh after rename
incidents.description: Analytics team reported 0 for a metric because PaymentResolver.refresh emitted a mistyped field name.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: Map.of("user_Id", id); // should be userId — consumer drops
incidents.root_cause: Field renamed in schema but not in PaymentResolver.refresh's hand-rolled serializer.
incidents.resolution: Added consumer-side strict validation on unknown/missing keys.

incidents.title: Mismatched field name in CatalogScheduler.persist after rename
incidents.description: Analytics team reported 0 for a metric because CatalogScheduler.persist emitted a mistyped field name.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: Map.of("user_Id", id); // should be userId — consumer drops
incidents.root_cause: Typo `user_Id` vs `userId` in CatalogScheduler.persist's JSON emitter.
incidents.resolution: Switched to a generated DTO; typo impossible.

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves catalog-service in broken state
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in CatalogGateway.index already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@Column(name = "ext_id", nullable = false) // column not present after rollback
private String extId;
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: App + schema deployed together; rollback of app didn't include DOWN migration.

incidents.title: FraudRepository.cache over-counts during concurrent requests
incidents.description: Concurrent callers of FraudRepository.cache produced inconsistent session totals. Read-modify-write without a lock allowed two threads to observe the same pre-state. 40 affected records.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
current = db.get_quantity(sku)
db.set_quantity(sku, current - qty)  # TOCTOU
incidents.root_cause: @Transactional removed from FraudRepository.cache during a refactor, exposing the read-modify-write race.
incidents.resolution: Re-added @Transactional and added @Version optimistic locking on the entity.

incidents.title: Cache stampede on UserService.authenticate following cache flush
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 800 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered kafka. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: TTL jitter missing; thousands of cache entries expire at the same second after a bulk warmup.

incidents.title: Lost updates in OrderService.cancel under parallel load
incidents.description: Concurrent callers of OrderService.cancel produced inconsistent payment totals. Read-modify-write without a lock allowed two threads to observe the same pre-state. 2400 affected records.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
int current = repo.getQuantity(sku);
repo.setQuantity(sku, current - qty); // no lock, lost update
incidents.root_cause: @Transactional removed from OrderService.cancel during a refactor, exposing the read-modify-write race.
incidents.resolution: Re-added @Transactional and added @Version optimistic locking on the entity.

incidents.title: Deserialization failure in ShippingWorker.fetch after schema change
incidents.description: A Kafka producer rolled out a new field. Consumers in ShippingWorker.fetch broke because the schema registry was not updated.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
dec := json.NewDecoder(r)
dec.DisallowUnknownFields() // breaks on producer adding field
var msg Message
dec.Decode(&msg)
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Schema evolution rule broken: new non-optional field was added without a default.

incidents.title: Stale cache in PaymentService.refund after user-service update
incidents.description: PaymentService.refund served stale session values for up to 500 hours after the source was updated. Cache invalidation hook was removed during a cleanup.
incidents.root_cause: Index rebuild job cron-only; no event-driven invalidation.
incidents.resolution: Event-driven invalidation added on ConfigChanged events.

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate throws NPE for partially-populated records
incidents.description: Requests to UserService.authenticate failed with NPE whenever tracking.id was unset. Errors were initially masked as timeouts because the surrounding try/catch logged only the message. Impacted ~800 requests over the incident window.
incidents.root_cause: A recent migration left tracking.id nullable in the schema but UserService.authenticate still assumed non-null.
incidents.resolution: Validated tracking.id at the request boundary so UserService.authenticate can safely assume non-null.

incidents.title: Partial migration in InventoryService.reserve path after rollback
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in InventoryService.reserve already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@Column(name = "ext_id", nullable = false) // column not present after rollback
private String extId;
incidents.root_cause: App + schema deployed together; rollback of app didn't include DOWN migration.
incidents.resolution: Added DOWN migration + test; rollout gated on migration success.

incidents.title: InventoryService.release TLS verification broken after CA rotation
incidents.description: A CA rotation removed an old root that our pinned truststore still listed. InventoryService.release's elasticsearch client rejected the new chain.
incidents.root_cause: Pinned truststore not updated after elasticsearch rotated its CA.
incidents.resolution: Rotated cert; added a synthetic monitor for days-to-expiry at 30/14/7 thresholds.

incidents.title: CartService.checkout ignores input argument due to shadow
incidents.description: Inside CartService.checkout, a local variable shadowed the argument of the same name. The caller's value was effectively ignored.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in CartService.checkout after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Renamed shadow to localUser; added lint rule flagging shadowed params.

incidents.title: Sensitive token logged in PaymentHandler.lookup
incidents.description: A print-statement left from local testing exposed full card numbers in PaymentHandler.lookup for PCI-scoped traffic.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: log.debug("charge req: {}", chargeRequest); // prints PAN
incidents.root_cause: Verbose debug flag merged accidentally; PaymentHandler.lookup logger lacks field-scrubber middleware.
incidents.resolution: Added PCI-aware log scrubber; banned raw request in logger.

incidents.title: Gradual heap growth tied to CartHandler.validate cache
incidents.description: cart-service heap usage grew linearly over 18 hours until OOM. Heap dump fingered a HashMap in CartHandler.validate with no eviction policy.
incidents.root_cause: Listener added to CartHandler.validate was never unregistered when the request scope ended, pinning session objects in memory.
incidents.resolution: Switched to LRU with explicit capacity; added metric cache.size for alerting.

incidents.title: PaymentService.refund retry loop amplifies user-service load
incidents.description: A transient user-service failure triggered PaymentService.refund's retry loop, which fired back-to-back requests with no backoff. Load amplified 8x and user-service returned 429s for 500 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: MAX_RETRIES bumped from 3 to 10 without corresponding backoff; under partial failure the amplification crossed the rate-limit threshold.
incidents.resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms, cap 5s) in PaymentService.refund.

incidents.title: Sensitive token logged in InventoryService.release
incidents.description: A print-statement left from local testing exposed full card numbers in InventoryService.release for PCI-scoped traffic.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: log.debug("charge req: {}", chargeRequest); // prints PAN
incidents.root_cause: Verbose debug flag merged accidentally; InventoryService.release logger lacks field-scrubber middleware.
incidents.resolution: Added PCI-aware log scrubber; banned raw request in logger.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures after cert expiry on cart-service
incidents.description: Expired intermediate cert caused TLS handshake failures on CartService.addItem's egress to kafka. All downstream calls failed for 40 minutes.
incidents.root_cause: Certificate auto-renew job failed 14 days prior; nobody acted on the warning.
incidents.resolution: Replaced pinned truststore with system default; acme-renew scheduled weekly.

incidents.title: Lost updates in UserGateway.verify under parallel load
incidents.description: Concurrent callers of UserGateway.verify produced inconsistent token totals. Read-modify-write without a lock allowed two threads to observe the same pre-state. 2400 affected records.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Switched to optimistic locking but never enabled @Version on the entity — serial writes went through.

incidents.title: user-service fell behind topic by 500 messages
incidents.description: A sudden traffic surge overwhelmed the single-threaded consumer in UserScheduler.cache; lag alerts fired within 10 minutes.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }
incidents.root_cause: Consumer concurrency set to 1; topic has 8 partitions but only 1 worker thread.
incidents.resolution: Increased consumer concurrency to 8; matched topic partition count.

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits cart-service when OrderService.cancel cache expires
incidents.description: A cache entry expired simultaneously across 120 requests in flight. All of them missed cache and hammered cart-service. Tail latency spiked from 80ms p99 to 3.2s p99.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: OrderService.cancel uses naive cache-aside with no single-flight — concurrent misses all fetch from origin.

incidents.title: Goroutine leak in SearchService.query eats memory
incidents.description: search-service goroutine count grew to 120k over 6 hours. SearchService.query spawned a goroutine per request but never drained the blocking channel.
incidents.root_cause: CompletableFuture in SearchService.query is never completed on the cancellation path.
incidents.resolution: Switched to buffered channel; guaranteed drain on ctx.Done().

incidents.title: ShippingService.createLabel ignores input argument due to shadow
incidents.description: Linter caught a shadowed variable in ShippingService.createLabel that had masked a config-override path for 3 weeks.
incidents.root_cause: A local var `user` shadowed the parameter `user` in ShippingService.createLabel after an editor autocomplete accident.
incidents.resolution: Renamed shadow to localUser; added lint rule flagging shadowed params.

incidents.title: SQL injection protection regression in OrderService.place
incidents.description: A security audit flagged OrderService.place for concatenating user input into a SQL query. No confirmed exploits but disclosure deadline imposed.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
String sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'";
stmt.executeQuery(sql); // SQLi
incidents.root_cause: OrderService.place switched to string concatenation when a prepared-statement wrapper was deleted.
incidents.resolution: Introduced a type-safe QueryBuilder; banned raw string concat in lint rules.

incidents.title: UserHandler.authenticate timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: redis latency went from 100ms to 4s. UserHandler.authenticate's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Client timeout on redis > ingress timeout on UserHandler.authenticate; pool starvation guaranteed.

incidents.title: InventoryService.release async callback swallows errors
incidents.description: Node warned on 'UnhandledPromiseRejection' for 12 requests originating from InventoryService.release. Errors silently dropped; clients saw hung connections.
incidents.root_cause: Fire-and-forget pattern in InventoryService.release with no .catch(); rejected promise unhandled.
incidents.resolution: Replaced create_task with awaited call; added error callback.

incidents.title: OrderScheduler.serialize async callback swallows errors
incidents.description: Node warned on 'UnhandledPromiseRejection' for 3800 requests originating from OrderScheduler.serialize. Errors silently dropped; clients saw hung connections.
incidents.root_cause: Fire-and-forget pattern in OrderScheduler.serialize with no .catch(); rejected promise unhandled.
incidents.resolution: Added await; top-level try/catch; sentry.captureException on reject.

incidents.title: PaymentHandler.match timeouts propagate to upstream callers
incidents.description: dynamo latency went from 100ms to 4s. PaymentHandler.match's 5s client timeout held, but thread-pool starved; upstream callers started timing out too.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
RestTemplate rt = new RestTemplate();
rt.getRequestFactory().setReadTimeout(30_000); // 30s — too generous
incidents.root_cause: Client timeout on dynamo > ingress timeout on PaymentHandler.match; pool starvation guaranteed.
incidents.resolution: Tightened dynamo client timeout to 2s; added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

incidents.title: Unknown enum value crashes PaymentController.emit
incidents.description: PaymentController.emit received an enum value user-service had added but payment-service did not know about. Deserialization threw; requests 500'd.
incidents.root_cause: Strict enum deserializer in PaymentController.emit has no default branch for unknown values.
incidents.resolution: Added default: return unknown() branch; emit metric on unseen enum.

incidents.title: InventoryClient.apply re-entrancy produces infinite loop
incidents.description: A newly added call from InventoryClient.apply into postgres triggered postgres to call back into inventory-service, which looped through InventoryClient.apply again. Stack overflow after ~300 calls.
incidents.root_cause: A Spring-injected bean introduced a constructor-level circular dependency through InventoryClient.apply.
incidents.resolution: Refactored to injected interface; broke the tight Spring cycle.

incidents.title: order-service not reloaded after config change
incidents.description: OrderHandler.serialize cached the config at boot; operators rotated the flag but order-service wasn't restarted.
incidents.offending_code_snippet: @Value("${api.key}") private String apiKey; // resolved once at boot
incidents.root_cause: OrderHandler.serialize reads the secret once at boot; no refresh hook.
incidents.resolution: Added SIGHUP handler that reloads config.

incidents.title: Shared list default in InventoryService.release accumulates across calls
incidents.description: Calls to InventoryService.release started seeing data from previous calls. A default [] argument kept accumulating appends across invocations.
incidents.root_cause: Static List initializer in InventoryService.release was shared by all instances.
incidents.resolution: Default to None and construct a fresh list inside the function.

incidents.title: OrderResolver.release scaling linearly with input size
incidents.description: OrderResolver.release loads a collection then issues one DB call per item. With input sizes ~200, p99 crossed 8s. Evidence: trace span count scaling linearly with input size.
incidents.root_cause: Batch fetch helper removed during cleanup; OrderResolver.release reverted to per-item lookup.
incidents.resolution: Batched into a single risk_db.lookup_batch(txn_ids) call.

incidents.title: Duplicate processing in FraudService.evaluate on retry
incidents.description: Clients retrying after transient errors produced duplicate side effects in FraudService.evaluate. ~300 records affected; remediation required manual refund.

incidents.root_cause: Idempotency key generated per-attempt in FraudService.evaluate instead of per-order.
incidents.resolution: Derived idempotency key from (orderId, attempt-bucket).

incidents.title: order-service pool saturation traced to OrderWorker.serialize
incidents.description: Pool usage on order-service ramped linearly from 20% to 100% over 4h. OrderWorker.serialize's error path never released the acquired connection. Once saturated, all requests blocked on pool.getConnection().
incidents.root_cause: Connection leak on the error path of OrderWorker.serialize — finally block missed when refactored into early-return.
incidents.resolution: Wrapped in try-with-resources and added pool-usage alert at 80%.

incidents.title: Partial migration in NotificationsClient.poll path after rollback
incidents.description: A Flyway migration added a column, failed on a constraint, and rolled back — but the new app code in NotificationsClient.poll already referenced the column. Service failed to start.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
class Item(Base):
    ext_id = Column(String, nullable=False)  # missing after rollback
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Non-transactional DDL meant the failed migration left an orphaned column.

incidents.title: Unhandled promise rejection in ShippingRepository.poll
incidents.description: An async task in ShippingRepository.poll fired and forgot; failures never surfaced to callers.
incidents.root_cause: ShippingRepository.poll didn't await the inner promise — rejections escaped the try/catch.
incidents.resolution: Replaced create_task with awaited call; added error callback.

incidents.title: UserService.authenticate issues one DB call per item — p99 degradation
incidents.description: UserService.authenticate loads a collection then issues one DB call per item. With input sizes ~200, p99 crossed 8s. Evidence: trace span count scaling linearly with input size.
incidents.root_cause: Batch fetch helper removed during cleanup; UserService.authenticate reverted to per-item lookup.

incidents.title: Thundering herd hits rabbitmq when FraudService.evaluate cache expires
incidents.description: Post-deploy cache flush caused all requests for popular SKUs to bypass cache and hit the primary DB simultaneously.

p = cache.get(sku)
if p is None:

    cache.set(sku, p)

incidents.title: DB lock wait timeouts on PaymentGateway.execute
incidents.description: Postgres reported lock_wait_timeout on the token table during peak traffic. PaymentGateway.execute held a row lock while calling a remote service inside the same transaction.
incidents.root_cause: Lock acquisition order inconsistent between PaymentGateway.execute and the batch job — produces AB/BA deadlock.

incidents.title: N+1 query in OrderService.place blows up latency
incidents.description: OrderService.place loads a collection then issues one DB call per item. With input sizes ~200, p99 crossed 8s. Evidence: trace span count scaling linearly with input size.
incidents.root_cause: Lazy-loaded association triggers a SELECT per element inside OrderService.place's loop.
incidents.resolution: Batched into a single risk_db.lookup_batch(txn_ids) call.

incidents.title: Off-by-one in InventoryService.release pagination

incidents.resolution: Switched to explicit iterator; removed magic -1 / +1.

incidents.title: AnalyticsGateway.cache rejects legitimate cross-origin requests
incidents.description: Browser clients couldn't reach AnalyticsGateway.cache endpoint after a CORS config change. Preflight returned 403 for Origin: https://web.swagstore.com.

incidents.title: JWT verification drift in SearchHandler.poll

incidents.title: Cache stampede on ShippingService.createLabel following cache flush

incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag on payment-service from PaymentRepository.authorize bottleneck
incidents.description: A sudden traffic surge overwhelmed the single-threaded consumer in PaymentRepository.authorize; lag alerts fired within 10 minutes.
incidents.offending_code_snippet:
@KafkaListener(topics = ["product-updates"], concurrency = "1")
public void consume(Record r) { process(r); }

incidents.title: InventoryService.reserve scaling linearly with input size
incidents.description: A recent refactor from batch fetch to per-item fetch in InventoryService.reserve regressed latency by ~15x on high-volume requests.

incidents.title: Shared list default in ShippingService.createLabel accumulates across calls

incidents.title: Unhandled null value crashes FraudClient.refresh requests
incidents.description: Null values on userId weren't defended against FraudClient.refresh's hot path. Stack traces showed up in fraud-service and user-service too because of shared request-context propagation.

profile = lookup.get(user_id)

incidents.title: Token validation weakened in CartService.checkout

incidents.resolution: Pinned algorithm to RS256 explicitly; rejected unexpected algs.

incidents.title: Appender loop in PaymentProcessor.handle crashes payment-service

log.error("failed: {}", req, e);

incidents.root_cause: HTTP appender in Logback posted to PaymentProcessor.handle; that method logged the request, recursing.
incidents.resolution: Excluded the logging endpoint from the HTTP appender's path filter.

incidents.title: Lost updates in InventoryService.reserve under parallel load

incidents.title: Database migration rollback leaves order-service in broken state

@Column(name = "ext_id", nullable = false) // column not present after rollback

incidents.title: Race condition in RecommendationsService.forUser yields duplicate token rows

row = session.query(Inventory).get(id)
row.count += delta

incidents.title: CartService.checkout exceeded postgres quota during burst

incidents.title: Duplicate processing in OrderProcessor.index on retry

incidents.title: Catch-and-log in FraudService.evaluate masks real errors

dec := json.NewDecoder(r)

var msg Message
dec.Decode(&msg)

incidents.title: DB lock wait timeouts on InventoryService.reserve

incidents.title: Off-by-hours error in PaymentService.refund for non-UTC customers
